admin_audit_http_client.description:
Extends admin_audit with logging of all outgoing HTTP requests made by Nextcloud's internal Guzzle-based HTTP client. Logs include method, URI, status code, HTTP version, request and response headers, cURL transfer statistics, and compression metrics. Credential-bearing headers such as Authorization and Cookie are always redacted.
No UI, no routes — pure audit logging into per-host JSON and plain-text files below a configurable log directory.

agenda_bot.description:
### 🚀 Meeting Manager for Nextcloud Talk

Tired of unproductive meetings that run overtime? The Agenda Bot transforms chaotic discussions into structured, efficient sessions with intelligent automation and real-time insights.
**⚠️ Requires Nextcloud Talk app to be installed and enabled**

### ✨ Key Features

#### 🎯 Effortless Agenda Creation
- Natural language: `agenda: Project review (15 min)` 
- Multiple formats: `topic:`, `item:`, `add:`, `insert:`
- Create multiple items at once from structured lists
- Smart time parsing: `(5 min)`, `(1h)`, `(90 min)`, `(2 hours)`
- Automatic positioning or manual `#2.` syntax

#### ⏰ Intelligent Time Management
- Background monitoring tracks time automatically
- Smart warnings at 80%, 100%, and overtime thresholds  
- Call-aware notifications (only during active meetings)
- Custom time monitoring configuration per room
- Visual progress tracking with ✅ 📍 🗣️ indicators

#### 🔥 Seamless Meeting Flow
- **`done:` command** - Complete current item and auto-advance!
- Real-time status shows actual vs. planned time
- Automatic progression through agenda items
- Live updates for all participants

#### ⚙️ Room-Level Bot Configuration
- **Time Monitoring**: Custom warning thresholds and overtime alerts per room
- **Auto-behaviors**: Control automatic start, cleanup, and summary generation
- **Response-behaviors**: Choose between full responses or minimal emoji-only mode
- **Agenda Limits**: Configure max agenda items, max bulk additions, and default durations
- **Custom Emojis**: Personalize agenda item status indicators

#### 🌍 Multi-Language Support (NEW in v1.5.0!)
- **German Language Variants**: Support for both informal (Du) and formal (Sie) German communication
- **Automatic Migration**: Seamless upgrade handling with intelligent migration framework
- **Professional Settings**: Perfect for corporate environments requiring formal language
- **User Choice**: Select the communication style that fits your team culture

#### 🔐 Smart Permission System
- Role-based access: Owners, Moderators, Users, Guests
- Flexible control: Who can add, manage, or view items
- Guest moderator support for external facilitators

#### 📊 Meeting Analytics & Insights
- Completion tracking with timing statistics
- Efficiency reports: On-time 👍 vs. overtime ⏰ 
- Comprehensive summaries with actionable data
- Optional cleanup of completed items

### 💫 Why Using Agenda Bot?

- ✅ **Boost Productivity** - Stay focused with structured agendas
- ✅ **Save Time** - Automated tracking and progress management  
- ✅ **Improve Accountability** - Clear completion tracking
- ✅ **Reduce Overruns** - Smart time warnings keep meetings on track
- ✅ **Easy Setup** - Works instantly in any Talk room

### 🏆 Perfect For
- Team standups and regular check-ins
- Project planning sessions
- Client meetings with tight schedules  
- Board meetings requiring structure
- Training sessions with timed modules

#### Start having better meetings - Add the Agenda Bot to your Talk rooms and experience the difference!

ai_hub.description:
**AI-Hub** is one AI gateway for every app on your Nextcloud.

An app does not talk to a model. It registers a **scenario** — what the assistant is, what tools it may run and what shape its answers take — and then sends the user's words. AI-Hub chooses the engine, runs the conversation and the tools the scenario allows, checks the answer against the shape, and hands it back. The same scenario works whatever the administrator has connected: Claude, Gemini, an OpenAI-compatible service, or a command-line subscription on the server.

### Three ways in
- **From an app on the same server (PHP):** register a scenario, `ask()`, `result()`.
- **Over HTTP (OCS):** `/ocs/v2.php/apps/ai_hub/api/v1/ask` and `…/result/{id}`.
- **Through Nextcloud's Task Processing API:** AI-Hub is a provider for text-to-text and chat tasks, so Nextcloud Assistant and other apps written against the standard API can use the connected model.

### Engines
Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini through their own APIs; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Mistral, Groq, OpenAI, or Ollama / vLLM / LM Studio on your own server); or a Claude Code / Gemini CLI subscription installed on the server, so a flat-rate plan answers everyone.

### One settings page for all apps
The engine, its key and the model (picked from the list the key can really use, with a connection test); who may ask, which apps may ask, questions per minute and answers in progress at once. Each app that connects can be given an AI and a model of its own.

### Safety
An app reaches only its own scenarios and the tools it registered. Tools run with the rights of the person asking, through the app's own code. Web search, where allowed, runs on the provider's side. Keys are stored encrypted and never leave the server.

Talk-Bot and EditBase from the same makers are moving their AI onto AI-Hub.

aiquila.description:
**AIquila** brings AI into your [Nextcloud](https://nextcloud.com) — private, self-hosted, and under your control. You choose which AI provider processes your data, including models running entirely on your own hardware.

### Nextcloud App

- **Chat** — Converse with an AI assistant about your files and documents
- **Projects** — Scope a conversation to selected folders, so the assistant only sees what you choose
- **Coworkers** — Save repeatable AI jobs and run them on demand or on a schedule
- **Summarise & rewrite** — Condense, draft, rephrase and proofread text
- **Model picker** — Switch provider and model per conversation
- **Usage metrics** — Token and conversation counters exported via OpenMetrics

### Choose your AI provider

Admins enable the providers they want, and can restrict them per user or group:

- **Claude (Anthropic)** — The default, and the most deeply integrated: vision, thinking budgets, native MCP connector, and PDF handling with citations.
- **Hetzner Inference** — OpenAI-compatible API from the German provider Hetzner. Currently an experimental service, free while experimental; Hetzner states it does not store request and response content.
- **Mistral** — French provider, also supporting the native MCP connector. EU-only processing is available through Mistral's regional inference endpoints.
- **Local model** — Ollama, LM Studio or llama.cpp on your own hardware. Nothing leaves your infrastructure.
- **DeepSeek** — OpenAI-compatible API.

API keys are stored encrypted, and base URLs are admin-only settings. Provider choice
applies to chat and to the Nextcloud Assistant integrations alike. Assistant actions
that send images need a vision-capable provider.

### MCP Server

AIquila includes a [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server with 316 tools that gives any MCP client — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Claude.ai and the Claude mobile app, Cursor, VS Code and others — direct access to your Nextcloud:

- **Files & sharing** — Browse, read, write, search, share, tag, and restore from trash or older versions
- **Calendar, Tasks & Contacts** — Events, to-dos and address books over CalDAV and CardDAV, plus Deck boards and Projects
- **Talk, Mail & Notifications** — Conversations, polls and reactions, mail accounts and messages, notification triage
- **Photos & Maps** — Albums and metadata, GPS tracks and devices, favourites, and photo geotagging
- **Notes, News, Recipes & Bookmarks** — Markdown notes, RSS feeds, recipes, and bookmark folders and tags
- **Coworkers & administration** — Run saved AI jobs, manage users, groups and apps, run `occ`, and check integrity

### Resources

- [Documentation](https://github.com/elgorro/aiquila/blob/main/docs/README.md)
- [Source Code](https://github.com/elgorro/aiquila)
- [Report Issues](https://github.com/elgorro/aiquila/issues)
- [Discussions](https://github.com/elgorro/aiquila/discussions)

---

Built on the [Nextcloud](https://nextcloud.com) open-source community, the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io), and the open and commercial AI providers listed above.

apple_photos_connector.description:
Photos Connector imports photos and videos from Apple Photos into Nextcloud Photos and can transfer their album memberships. The separate macOS companion app is required and is not included in this server app.

Repeated imports are incremental: only new or missing files are transferred, while already confirmed files are recognized and not uploaded again. Existing files are protected from unintended overwrites, and the configured destination structure is preserved.

Imports are non-destructive. Files already stored in Nextcloud are not deleted or overwritten, and items missing from Apple Photos do not remove existing files or album memberships. Requirements: Nextcloud 35, Nextcloud Photos, and the separate Photos Connector companion app. The current release supports Nextcloud 35 and Photos 7.0.0–8.0.0.

approval_signature.description:
# Approval Signature

Organize **controlled document approval** right inside Nextcloud Files. Admins define workflow rules, and users approve or reject documents with a single click — all in the file list, the details/sidebar view, and the activity feed.

## What it does

- **Workflow-based control** — admins create `Approval workflows` in the administration settings, choosing who can request approval and who approves or rejects (users, groups, circles).
- **One-click approve/reject** — approve or reject buttons appear right on a file that is pending review; the result is applied instantly.
- **Automatic tags** — files get a *pending* tag when approval is requested and an *approved / rejected* tag once a decision is made.
- **Activity feed** — every request, approval and rejection is logged in the Activity app so the whole history stays traceable.
- **Full visibility for admins** — overview of pending requests and their status across the instance.

## Typical use cases

- **ОТ (Occupational Safety) / HR departments** — approvals of instructions, programs and local normative acts.
- **Contracts & legal** — review-and-sign workflows for agreements and invoices.
- **Production / project documents** — sign-off on plans, drawings and technical documentation.
- **Internal regulation** — approval of orders, policies and quality-system documents.

## Getting started

1. Install the app and open **Administration settings → Approval workflows**.
2. Create a workflow: name, who can request, who can approve/reject, and which tags mark pending / approved / rejected states.
3. Users select a file → **Request approval** → the approver sees **Approve / Reject** buttons and acts.

## Notes

- The **DocuSign integration** is no longer part of this app. To sign documents with DocuSign install [this app](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/integration_docusign).
- Compatible with Nextcloud 30 — 35.

arbeitszeitcheck.description:
# Clock in. Stay within the rules you set.

ArbeitszeitCheck records clock-in, clock-out and breaks on the Nextcloud you already host. Pick a country profile for Germany (ArbZG), Austria (AZG/ARG) or Switzerland (ArG), match holiday regions, approve absences, run reports (including DATEV) and keep an audit log.

Also listed as **TimeGuard** in some App Store searches.

**Free web app** (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Companion apps: https://nextcloud.software-by-design.de/

## Why teams install it

- **Start and stop work cleanly** — pauses, resume, manual entries with a reason
- **Match your country** — DE / AT / CH profiles with Länder, Bundesländer or cantons
- **See break and rest issues early** — technical checks against the profile you configured
- **Run absences properly** — vacation, illness, special and unpaid leave with approval; entitlement modes and CSV import via `occ`
- **Report what happened** — employee, team and manager views; overtime and absence reports; DATEV export
- **Lock a month when you need to** — optional finalization with snapshot, hash and PDF; admin reopen with a reason
- **Control access** — open to all users or allow-lists; Nextcloud admins keep access

## Clear limits

- This app is **not legal advice**. You stay responsible for working-time models, collective agreements, configuration and how recorded data is used. Ask counsel when needed.
- Technical violation reports against your profile are not a third-party certification.
- Declared databases: MySQL and PostgreSQL. Nextcloud 32–35, PHP 8.1–8.5.

## Feedback welcome

We improve this app with real-world use. Bug reports, rough edges, and ideas help — open a GitHub Issue (https://github.com/aSoftwareByDesignRepository/nextcloud-arbeitszeitcheck/issues) or write to info@software-by-design.de. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

## Requirements

- Nextcloud 32–35 · PHP 8.1–8.5 · MySQL or PostgreSQL

assistant.description:
This app brings a user interface to use the Nextcloud text processing feature.

It allows users to launch AI tasks, be notified when they finish and see the results.
The assistant also appears in others apps like Text to easily process parts of a document.

More details on the assistant OCS API and frontend integration possibilities in the
[developer doc](https://github.com/nextcloud/assistant/raw/main/docs/developer)

### How to use it

A new right header menu entry appears. Once clicked, the assistant is displayed and you can select and task type and
set the input you want to process.

The task might run immediately or be scheduled depending on the time estimation given by the AI provider.
Once a task is scheduled, it will run as a background job. When it is finished, you will receive a notification
from which the results can be displayed.

Other apps can integrate with the assistant. For example, Text will display an inline button besides every paragraph
to directly select a task type to process this paragraph. Selecting a task this way will open the assistant with the task
being pre-selected and the input text set.

More details and screenshots in the [user doc](https://github.com/nextcloud/assistant/raw/main/docs/user).

## Features

In the assistant, the list of available tasks depends on the available providers installed via other apps.
This means you have complete freedom over which service/software will actually run your AI tasks.

### Text processing providers

So far, the [Local Large language model](https://github.com/nextcloud/llm2#readme)
and the [OpenAi/LocalAI integration](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/integration_openai) apps
include text processing providers to:
* Summarize
* Extract topics
* Generate a headline
* Get an answer from a free prompt
* Reformulate (OpenAi/LocalAi only)
* Context writer: Generate text with a specified style. The style can be described or provided via an example text.

### Text to image (Image generation)

Known providers:
* [OpenAi/LocalAI integration](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/integration_openai)
* [Text2Image Stable Diffusion](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/text2image_stablediffusion)

### Speech to text (Audio transcription)

Known providers:
* [OpenAi/LocalAI integration](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/integration_openai)
* [Local Whisper Speech-To-Text](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/stt_whisper)

More details on how to set this up in the [admin docs](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/admin_manual/ai/index.html)

astrolabe.description:
# Astrolabe - Semantic Search for Nextcloud

Find your content by meaning, not just keywords. Astrolabe brings AI-powered semantic search to your Nextcloud, helping you discover documents, notes, calendar events, and files through natural language.

## Features

- **Semantic Search**: Search across Notes, Files, Calendar, Deck, and more using natural language queries
- **Unified Search Integration**: Results appear in Nextcloud's global search bar alongside traditional results
- **Background Indexing**: Your content is automatically indexed for instant semantic search
- **Vector Visualization**: Explore your content in an interactive 2D visualization showing semantic relationships
- **Hybrid Search**: Combines semantic understanding with keyword matching for best results

## How It Works

Astrolabe connects to a semantic search service that understands the meaning of your content. Instead of exact keyword matches, you can search for concepts - ask "meeting notes from last week" or "recipes with chicken" and find relevant documents even if they don't contain those exact words.

## Getting Started

1. Install and enable the app
2. Grant background access to allow indexing of your content
3. Start searching with natural language in Nextcloud's search bar

See [documentation](https://github.com/cbcoutinho/astrolabe) for configuration details.

attendance.description:
Know who is coming – to every rehearsal, training session and meeting. Attendance collects RSVPs up front, records who actually turned up at check-in, and breaks every response down by your Nextcloud groups. Made for choirs, orchestras, sports clubs, volunteer crews, congregations and every other group that needs to know not just how many are coming, but who.

Free, open source, and every reply, attendance list and comment stays on your own server.

## Collecting replies

- **One click:** Yes, No or Maybe, with an optional comment – drop "Maybe" for appointments that need a clear answer
- **Attendance limit with a waitlist:** cap an appointment at a number of spots, extra yes-repliers queue up and move in when a spot frees
- **Vacation:** members enter their absences, new appointments warn about people on vacation, and existing ones can be answered with "No" automatically – optionally written to a calendar
- **Changed plans:** update or withdraw a reply any time before the appointment
- **Quick-reply links:** answer straight from the notification email, no login needed
- **Dashboard widget:** reply from the Nextcloud dashboard without opening the app
- **Guests without an account:** invite people by email address through the Nextcloud Guests app
- **Reminders:** automatic nudges for everyone who has not replied yet, plus manual reminders

## Organising appointments

- **All-day appointments:** for outings, camps and festivals, also as a series
- **Category templates:** every category can prefill name, description, location, deadline, limit and access for new appointments
- **Recurring appointments:** create daily, weekly or monthly series in one go, then edit or delete this one, this and following, or all of them
- **Import from your calendar:** pull events out of Nextcloud Calendar, with optional automatic sync (Nextcloud 32+)
- **Closing and deadlines:** close an inquiry by hand, on a deadline, or automatically once it starts
- **Cancel and reactivate:** cancelling is a state of its own, and plans can change back
- **Scheduling:** mark the yes-repliers you actually need and notify exactly those people
- **Attachments:** attach sheet music, agendas or minutes straight from Nextcloud Files
- **Visibility:** restrict an appointment to individual people, groups or Nextcloud Teams (Circles)
- **Copy:** duplicate an appointment with all of its settings

## Seeing what you need

- **Response summary by group:** your Nextcloud groups and Teams appear as separate sections, each with its own counts
- **Check-in:** tick off who actually turned up, in bulk if you like, with a note per person
- **Unanswered:** a section that shows only what still waits for your reply
- **Activity history:** every reply, change, withdrawal and check-in with who, when and from where
- **Export:** all data as an ODS spreadsheet, filtered by series, with switchable columns
- **Filters:** show only the appointments you organise or only those you answer
- **Calendar subscription:** a personal iCal feed for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook or Thunderbird
- **Permissions:** group-based permissions decide who may manage appointments, see all appointments, check people in, see summaries, read comments and see the team's vacation

## Optional: a mobile app for iOS and Android

Everything above works entirely in the browser. If you want more, there is a companion app that talks to your own Nextcloud and adds the two things a browser cannot do:

- **Self-check-in by QR code or NFC:** people scan a printed QR code or tap an NFC tag as they arrive, and the attendance list fills itself
- **Push notifications:** new appointments and reminders reach the phone straight away – through Google or Apple, or without either via UnifiedPush

It also puts your appointments, replies and comments in your pocket and holds several Nextcloud accounts in one app. The mobile app is free for 30 days per Nextcloud instance, then one yearly subscription covers the whole instance – this Nextcloud app stays free and open source, with or without it.

[App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759988681) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.krautnerds.attendance) · [F-Droid](https://fdroid.anwesenheit.app/repo?fingerprint=4E1BFBC669A19270E83E6FF960B1F9C9E2AF6C824DE79D975888B36C85F33D0E) · [What the app does](https://anwesenheit.app/mobile)

Documentation, use cases and roadmap: [anwesenheit.app](https://anwesenheit.app)

audioarchive.description:
**Audio Archive** turns a folder of recordings in your Nextcloud – sermons, talks, lectures, concerts, podcasts, rehearsals – into a simple audio player for everyone.

* **Browse the real folder structure**, however deeply nested, with search, sorting (name, newest, shuffle) and favourites
* **Plays in the background** with lock-screen and headset controls, remembers where you stopped, continues with the next folder
* **Many formats:** MP3, M4A/AAC, Ogg Vorbis, Opus, FLAC, WAV, WebM, AIFF – optionally converted to MP3 on the fly (needs ffmpeg on the server)
* **Installable as an app** (PWA) on phones and desktops, with **offline** listening of saved folders
* **Share without an account:** a public link with password, plus links that users create for single folders (expiry date, own design, offline/download allowed or not)
* **Comments and ratings** per recording, overview and Excel export for admins
* **Designs:** own colours, background image, cover images, or Nextcloud's look
* **Help and contact** button that notifies a group in Nextcloud

The user interface is currently in **German** only; an English translation is planned.

Optional: ffmpeg in the Nextcloud container for MP3 conversion; a working background job (cron) speeds up reading title/artist of large archives.

audiocheck.description:
# AudioCheck — your audio library inside Nextcloud

Your audio files already live in Files. AudioCheck indexes the folders you choose and streams them with live permission checks.

The app is **free** under AGPL-3.0-or-later. There is no seat license for this web app in the shipped package.

## What you get

- Separate music and audiobook library roots; collections, albums and folder browsing
- Multi-file audiobooks as one queue; resume stored on your server per account
- Durable playback queue; optional resume on open; Continue listening on Home and the dashboard widget
- Playlists; Favorites synced with Files stars
- Chapter jumps on M4B (and tagged chapter metadata); playback speed 0.5×–4.0×
- Files actions: Play in AudioCheck / Play folder as album
- Browse by artists, authors, genres, series, folders, tags and favorites
- Optional access restriction (Nextcloud admins always retain access)
- UI languages: German (Sie-Form), English, French, Spanish, Danish, Dutch, Italian, Polish, Swedish, Norwegian Bokmål, and Brazilian Portuguese (every shipped UI string lives in `l10n`)
- Accessibility foundations aimed at WCAG 2.1 AA (not a third-party certification)

## Formats

**Indexed and streamed on the server:** MP3, MP4/M4A/M4B (including podcasts tagged as video/mp4), OGG, Opus, FLAC, WAV, AAC and other common `audio/*` types.

**Browser playback** depends on the browser: MP3, M4A, M4B, AAC, OGG, Opus and WAV usually work; FLAC and some others may need a different browser.

## Get started

1. Open **Library**, add music and audiobook folders, then **Scan now** (or `occ audiocheck:scan`).
2. In **Settings**, enable **Resume where you left off** if you want that behaviour.
3. Open **Music** or **Audiobooks** and press Play.

## Honest limits

- Playback bytes go through a single file-access gate with live permission checks; revoked shares stop playback. The app makes no outbound HTTP calls for playback.
- After a full browser navigation away from AudioCheck, browsers may require a click to resume audio.
- Scan depth is capped (32 folder levels). Playlist play/shuffle has a documented track cap (2000).
- Declared databases: MySQL and PostgreSQL only.

## Feedback welcome

We improve this app with real-world use. Bug reports, rough edges, and ideas help — open a GitHub Issue (https://github.com/aSoftwareByDesignRepository/nextcloud-audiocheck/issues) or write to info@software-by-design.de. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

## Requirements

- Nextcloud 32–35
- PHP 8.2–8.5
- MySQL or PostgreSQL

audiolog.description:
**Audiolog** is a Nextcloud app to record, transcribe and process audio with AI models (Gemini, OpenAI/Whisper, Ollama).

## Features

- **Audio and video files** accepted by content: MP3, M4A (iPhone), OPUS/OGG (WhatsApp), WAV, WebM, MP4 and more
- **In-browser recording** with pause, resume and a real-time size/duration indicator
- **Auto-recovery** if the tab closes or the network drops mid-recording (IndexedDB-backed)
- **Live transcription** via the browser's Web Speech API (free) or Google Cloud Speech-to-Text
- **AI analysis**: summary, formal meeting minutes, agenda, task extraction
- **Speaker diarization** in the post-stop refine pass with Gemini
- **Multi-provider**: pick Gemini, OpenAI/Whisper, or Ollama (local) — no hidden cross-provider fallbacks
- **Large audios** (>20 MB) supported via Gemini's Files API resumable upload
- **Files integration**: recordings live under `Audiolog/`, fully manageable from the Files app
- **Markdown or DOCX export** for Office/Collabora editing

## Privacy

- API keys encrypted at rest via `OCP\Security\ICrypto`
- Per-group access control (`Allowed Groups` setting)
- Google Cloud Speech-to-Text live transcription goes through a server-side proxy: the API key never reaches the browser, and each user has a per-minute request limit
- Web Speech API runs entirely in the browser — no key ever leaves the server

auto_groups.description:
Automatically add users to the specified Auto Groups, except those users belonging to one of the specified Override Groups. 
Optionally, the group assignment can be triggered on every successful login, which is useful for external user backends.

## Configuration

- Go to "Settings > Administration > Additional settings"
- Configure the Auto Groups
- If required, configure the Override Groups (e.g., for Service Accounts)
- Optionally, enable the Login Hook, which will enforce correct group membership on every successful login

Note that this app prevents group deletions for groups referenced as Auto Groups or Override Groups.

## Comparison to similar Apps

* [Everyone Group](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/group_everyone): The "Everyone Group" app adds a virtual Group Backend, always returning all users. In contrast, "Auto Groups" operates on "real" groups in your normal Group Backend. Additionally, it is possible to specify Override Groups which will prevent users from being added to the Auto Group(s).
* [Default Group](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/defaultgroup): "Auto Groups" is actually a modernized and maintaned fork of "Default Group", which seems to be abandoned since NC12 or so. In terms of functionality, they are almost identical.

batch_renamer.description:
Easily batch rename, renumber, and organize multiple files at once directly inside the Nextcloud Files app.

### Key Features
- **Flexible Pattern Numbering:** Customize naming schemes with hash placeholders (e.g. `Photo_###` becomes `Photo_001`, `Photo_002`).
- **Custom Start Number:** Start counting from any custom number.
- **Live Progress Bar:** Real-time visual progress indicator for bulk operations.
- **Change Log Review:** Scrollable list to inspect old and new filenames before finishing.
- **Instant Undo:** Revert changes with a single click if you made a mistake.
- **Conflict & Collision Safety:** Two-phase renaming prevents accidental file overwrites.
- **Multilingual:** Native support for English and German.

### Ideal For
- Renaming camera imports, photos, and images (`Photo_001.jpg`)
- Organizing digitized PDF documents, scans, and invoices
- Sorting and sequentially numbering large file collections

---

### Deutsch / German
Komfortables Durchnummerieren und Umbenennen mehrerer Dateien auf Knopfdruck direkt in der Nextcloud-Dateiansicht. 

**Funktionen:**
- Flexible Ziffernmuster mit Raute-Platzhaltern (z. B. `Bild_###` zu `Bild_001`)
- Frei wählbare Startnummer
- Live-Fortschrittsanzeige während des Umbenennens
- Änderungsprotokoll mit vorher/nachher Gegenüberstellung
- Sofortige Rückgängig-Funktion (Undo / Rollback)
- Sicherer Kollisionsschutz gegen unbeabsichtigtes Überschreiben

**Ideal für:** Fotos, Bilder, Dokumente, Rechnungen und Scans schnell in einem Schritt sortieren und fortlaufend nummerieren.

*Keywords: batch rename, bulk renamer, mass rename, multi rename, file numbering, renumber, sequential numbering, image renamer, photo renamer, Stapel umbenennen, Stapelumbenennung, Massenumbenennung, mehrere Dateien umbenennen, durchnummerieren, fortlaufend nummerieren, Fotos umbenennen, Bilder nummerieren, Dateien umbenennen, Rückgängig, Rollback, Undo.*

budget.description:
# Budget - Financial Tracking for Nextcloud

Track your spending habits, manage savings, and forecast future account balances with intelligent analysis of your financial history.

## Features

* **Import Bank Statements**: Support for CSV, Excel and LibreOffice spreadsheets (.xls, .xlsx, .ods), OFX, QIF and ISO 20022 camt.053 XML formats, plus exports from Firefly III, YNAB, Actual Budget, Mint and Monarch Money
* **Import Folder**: Drop a statement into a folder in your Files and it is imported in the background, or held for you to review first
* **Bank Sync (beta)**: Pull transactions in automatically through GoCardless (UK/EU) or SimpleFIN (US)
* **Smart Categorization**: Automatic vendor matching and transaction categorization
* **Auto-Categorization Rules**: Apply rules to existing transactions anytime with preview
* **Split Transactions**: Allocate single transactions across multiple categories
* **Transfer Detection**: Automatic matching of transfers between accounts
* **Statement Reconciliation**: Tick transactions off against a bank statement until the difference reaches zero
* **Receipt Scanning**: Attach receipt photos to transactions and, once an admin sets it up, read the amount and items from them (OCR)
* **Android App, Quick Add and a Public API**: Budget Companion for Android (on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.otherworld.budget) to photograph receipts and check your balances, a fast entry page for your phone, and a REST API for scripts and automation
* **Budget Tracking**: Set spending limits with alerts when approaching or exceeding budgets
* **Rollover Budgets**: Envelope budgeting, where unspent money (or overspending) carries into the next month
* **Project Budgets**: One budget for a job that runs over months, such as a renovation or a wedding
* **Balance Forecasting**: Predict future balances based on historical data
* **Recurring Bills**: Track bills with due date monitoring and Nextcloud notifications
* **Subscription Detection**: Spots payments that look recurring but are not tracked yet, and turns them into bills in one click
* **Recurring Income**: Track expected income sources with receipt tracking
* **Split Expenses**: Share expenses with one or several people and track who owes whom
* **Debt Payoff Planner**: Plan repayment using avalanche or snowball strategies
* **Savings Goals**: Set targets with progress tracking and achievement forecasting
* **Pension Tracker**: Track retirement accounts with growth projections
* **Net Worth History**: Track assets and liabilities over time
* **Year-over-Year Reports**: Compare spending across multiple years
* **Money Flow Report**: A Sankey diagram of where a period's money came from and went
* **Digest and Unusual Spending Alerts**: An optional weekly or monthly summary, and a notification when a category runs well above its usual level
* **Scheduled PDF Reports**: Last month's report saved to your Files or emailed to you automatically
* **Multi-Account Support**: Manage multiple bank accounts and currencies
* **Custom Categories**: Create your own category hierarchy
* **Reports & Charts**: Visualize your financial data with interactive charts
* **Getting Started Checklist**: A first-run checklist, with sample data to explore before adding your own

## Documentation

Full user documentation: https://budget.otherworld.dev/docs/

## Requirements

* Nextcloud 30 or higher
* PHP 8.1 or higher
* PHP BCMath extension (`php-bcmath`)

budgetcheck.description:
# BudgetCheck

Scoped finance for Nextcloud. Each **workspace** is either a **household** (recurring monthly rhythm with budgets, savings targets, and yearly overview) or a **bounded project** (project window, period overview, optional cap warning).

Every workspace has its own ledger, categories, members, and tax settings. The **server is the source of truth** for all calculations; amounts are stored in **minor units**, never as floating-point. **Monthly close** produces an immutable snapshot with a verifiable calculation hash; controlled reopen restores editing. Optional **tax-aware** mode supports net or gross entry with deterministic VAT conversion.

The UI is **workspace-scoped** (household and project totals never mix), targets **WCAG 2.1 AA**, full keyboard use, and responsive layouts from **320px** width.

## Feedback welcome

We improve this app with real-world use. Bug reports, rough edges, and ideas help — open a GitHub Issue (https://github.com/aSoftwareByDesignRepository/nextcloud-budgetcheck/issues) or write to info@software-by-design.de. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

## Requirements

- Nextcloud 32–35
- PHP 8.2–8.5
- MySQL or PostgreSQL

calcbase.description:
CalcBase is a spreadsheet whose workbooks are ordinary web pages. Every workbook is saved to your Nextcloud Files as a single self-contained .html file with its stylesheet inside it, so it opens in any browser, on any device, for as long as browsers exist — the sheets are shown as tables, with their values, formulas, formats and styles written into the page itself.

Formulas are written as in LibreOffice Calc and Excel: =SUM(B2:B5), Sheet2.A1 or Sheet2!A1, absolute references with $, whole columns and rows. Where Calc and Excel differ, CalcBase follows LibreOffice Calc. Workbooks are calculated in the browser; nothing is sent anywhere.

CalcBase is derived from EditBase, the word processor whose documents are plain HTML. With the free AI-Hub app it can also use a large language model (LLM) as an assistant, set up once for every app on the server. It is a young program, so bugs may remain.

Features:
- Workbooks are plain HTML files in your own Files, editable and shareable like any other file; versions are kept beside the workbook
- Sheets, merged cells, frozen panes, column widths and row heights, number formats (numbers, currency, percent, dates, times, Japanese era dates), fonts, colours, borders and alignment
- About 500 functions as in LibreOffice Calc: mathematics, statistics, text, lookup, date and time, logic, information and finance
- Import of CSV and TSV (UTF-8 and Shift_JIS), ODS and XLSX — values, formulas, number formats, styles, column widths and merged cells, several sheets
- Export to CSV, ODS and XLSX with formulas, values, formats and styles kept
- Import also from RegiBase, FormulaBase, EditBase, NetBase, Tables, Contacts and Calendar, from a web page and from a Markdown file
- For tables kept by hand, not bulk data: 100,000 cells a book by default, 30,000 rows a sheet, 24 MB a file — raised in the settings at your own risk
- An AI assistant, through the AI-Hub app: a chat beside the sheet that knows spreadsheets and Calc formulas, and proposes changes to cells that are applied as one undoable step
- Japanese and English interface; light and dark themes
- HTML5 and CSS first: a workbook is readable without any program but a browser; JavaScript is used only for what HTML and CSS cannot do

cospend.description:
# Nextcloud Cospend 💰

Nextcloud Cospend is a group/shared budget manager. It was inspired by the great [IHateMoney](https://github.com/spiral-project/ihatemoney/).

You can use it when you share a house, when you go on vacation with friends, whenever you share expenses with a group of people.

It lets you create projects with members and bills. Each member has a balance computed from the project bills. Balances are not an absolute amount of money at members disposal but rather a relative information showing if a member has spent more for the group than the group has spent for her/him, independently of exactly who spent money for whom. This way you can see who owes the group and who the group owes. Ultimately you can ask for a settlement plan telling you which payments to make to reset members balances.

Project members are independent from Nextcloud users. Projects can be shared with other Nextcloud users or via public links.

[MoneyBuster](https://gitlab.com/eneiluj/moneybuster) Android client is [available in F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/net.eneiluj.moneybuster/) and on the [Play store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.eneiluj.moneybuster).

[PayForMe](https://github.com/mayflower/PayForMe) iOS client is currently under developpement!

The private and public APIs are documented using [the Nextcloud OpenAPI extractor](https://github.com/nextcloud/openapi-extractor/). This documentation can be accessed directly in Nextcloud. All you need is to install Cospend (>= v1.6.0) and use the [the OCS API Viewer app](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/ocs_api_viewer) to browse the OpenAPI documentation.

## Features

* ✎ Create/edit/delete projects, members, bills, bill categories, currencies
* ⚖ Check member balances
* 🗠 Display project statistics
* ♻ Display settlement plan
* Move bills from one project to another
* Move bills to trash before actually deleting them
* Archive old projects before deleting them
* 🎇 Automatically create reimbursement bills from settlement plan
* 🗓 Create recurring bills (day/week/month/year)
* 📊 Optionally provide custom amount for each member in new bills
* 🔗 Link personal files to bills (picture of physical receipt for example)
* 👩 Public links for people outside Nextcloud (can be password protected)
* 👫 Share projects with Nextcloud users/groups/circles
* 🖫 Import/export projects as csv (compatible with csv files from IHateMoney and SplitWise)
* 🔗 Generate link/QRCode to easily add projects in MoneyBuster
* 🗲 Implement Nextcloud notifications and activity stream

This app usually support the 2 or 3 last major versions of Nextcloud.

This app is under development.

🌍 Help us to translate this app on [Nextcloud-Cospend/MoneyBuster Crowdin project](https://crowdin.com/project/moneybuster).

⚒ Check out other ways to help in the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/julien-nc/cospend-nc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Documentation

* [User documentation](https://github.com/julien-nc/cospend-nc/blob/master/docs/user.md)
* [Admin documentation](https://github.com/julien-nc/cospend-nc/blob/master/docs/admin.md)
* [Developer documentation](https://github.com/julien-nc/cospend-nc/blob/master/docs/dev.md)
* [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/julien-nc/cospend-nc/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#change-log)
* [AUTHORS](https://github.com/julien-nc/cospend-nc/blob/master/AUTHORS.md#authors)

## Known issues

* It does not make you rich

Any feedback will be appreciated.



## Donation

I develop this app during my free time.

* [Donate with Paypal](https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=66PALMY8SF5JE) (you don't need a paypal account)

cpanelmailsync.description: Manages CPanel mail accounts from Nextcloud user creations, deletions and updates, using the CPanel UAPI.

crate.description:
Crate is a personal physical media catalogue for Nextcloud — browse and manage your music, films, books, games and comics in one place, with everything stored on your own server.

Add items manually or by barcode scan. Pull rich metadata automatically from Discogs (music), TMDB (films), Open Library (books), RAWG (games) and ComicVine (comics). Track market values from Discogs and PriceCharting alongside what you originally paid. Attach the cover art plus two extra user photos per item (receipts, sleevenotes, disc shots).

Owned vs. wanted, star ratings, playlists, sharing with other Nextcloud users, full CSV and XLSX import / export. There's a native Android companion at https://github.com/megamaced/crate-android.

cristal.description:
The [Cristal integration](https://github.com/xwiki-contrib/cristal-integration-nextcloud) for Nextcloud adds a modern, wiki-style note-taking interface on top of your Nextcloud files.

Cristal is designed for flexibility, a user-friendly UI, and organized knowledge, without lock-in or unnecessary complexity.

## Features

With the Cristal integration in Nextcloud you can:

* **Write notes and organize your thoughts** in pages.
* **Structure pages into a hierarchy** (as many levels as you want).
* **Link pages** together.
* **Manage your attachments**.
* **Navigate** with the navigation tree.
* **Use auto-suggestion** to find content.
* **Keep your wiki content in Markdown files**.

If you uninstall Cristal, all your data, pages and attachments, remain accessible in Nextcloud.

## How to start

Admins logged into the Nextcloud App Store can install Cristal in one click from this page. The installation is done for all the users of the instance. No need for complex configs or setups.

## Contribute to the Cristal integration

Cristal is open source and any contributions are welcome!

You can help improve the application, leave feedback in the comments, report [issues](https://jira.xwiki.org/projects/CRISTALNC/), or [discuss with us](https://dev.xwiki.org/xwiki/bin/view/Community/Chat).
You can also fill the [Feedback survey](https://cryptpad.fr/form/#/2/form/view/5-s0TWMJIQ8mFBtRcezNa-YvqtAo5JUvyeeAA5NoMDA/).

## What is Cristal?

[Cristal](https://cristal.xwiki.org/xwiki/bin/view/Main/) is an open-source, modern, modular wiki UI that is able to connect to various back-ends (e.g., a Nextcloud or a [XWiki](https://xwiki.org/xwiki/bin/view/Main/) instance, or GitHub, or a local folder). It focuses on offline editing with sync, and embeddability. This makes your content portable and accessible anywhere: in the browser, on your desktop, or inside another platform.

cromcull.description:
CromCull finds byte-identical duplicate files across your Nextcloud storage and lets you decide what to do about them.

**How it works:**
- Size-bucket pre-filter using Nextcloud's existing file cache (no re-scanning)
- Partial hash (first 64KB, SHA-256) to cheaply eliminate non-matches
- Full-file SHA-256 to confirm exact duplicates
- Persistent hash cache uses Nextcloud's edit tracking to skip re-hashing unchanged files — repeat scans are significantly faster, especially on external storage
- The first scan reads and hashes every file (a good overnight task for large libraries); after that, the cache keeps things fast

**Safety first:**
- CromCull never deletes anything automatically
- Every deletion is an explicit, per-file human decision
- All deletions go through Nextcloud's own trash bin, protected by live re-verification before every delete
- Group folders and shared files are blocked from deletion
- A permanent CSV audit log records every action

**Features:**
- Chunked scanning with progress bar and cancel support
- Per-group Recheck button to re-verify a single group without a full rescan
- Hide/Un-Hide duplicate groups per-user, keyed on content hash so future copies are automatically hidden
- Configurable size filters and extension ignore lists
- Folder exclusions via marker files that travel with renamed/moved folders
- Review UI with per-file external links for side-by-side comparison
- Batch delete across multiple groups with confirmation modal
- Admin hash cache management panel with entry count and full cache clear
- `cromcull:status` occ command for CLI visibility into scan state and cache stats

cromqr.description:
CromQR is a personal QR code library and generator for Nextcloud.

Generate QR codes from seven data types — URLs, plain text, contact cards (vCard), Wi-Fi credentials, email addresses, SMS messages, and geographic coordinates. Customize foreground and background colors, preview codes live, and save them to your personal library.

**Features:**
- 7 QR code types: URL, Text, vCard, Wi-Fi, Email, SMS, Geo
- Live preview with custom color pickers
- Personal library with list and grid views
- Save, edit, and soft-delete library entries
- Download as SVG or PNG
- Export directly to Nextcloud Files
- Per-user isolation — each user has their own private library
- Fully client-side QR generation — no external services

csp_editor.description:
# Description

This app allows to edit Nextcloud's default CSP policy.

cups_print.description:
Adds a **Print** action to the file menu in the Files app.

Select a PDF, PNG, JPEG or text file and it is sent to a small relay service
running next to your CUPS server. The relay runs `lp` and hands the document to
the configured print queue. Only the selected file is transmitted, and it stays
inside your own network.

The relay URL and its shared token are configured by an administrator under
*Administration settings → CUPS Print*. The relay itself is a small
standard-library Python service and ships in the `server/` directory of this
app's repository; a `compose.yaml` is included so it can be started with
Docker.

Requirements:
- Nextcloud 33 or newer
- A CUPS print relay reachable from the Nextcloud server (see `server/`)

Privacy: when a user triggers the action, the selected file is sent to the
relay URL configured by the administrator. No other data is transmitted.

curio.description:
Curio turns the images, links, videos and notes you collect into visual boards you can filter, tag and share. Paste a link from Pinterest, Instagram, YouTube or any website and it pulls in the picture, title and a snapshot for you. Upload your own photos, drop in a PDF, or jot a quick note.

## Bring everything together

Add references from wherever you find them:

- Photos and images uploaded straight from your device
- Links from Pinterest, Instagram, YouTube and any website, with the image, title and a saved snapshot grabbed automatically
- Videos, either embedded from a provider or uploaded directly
- PDFs, shown with a page preview
- Plain text notes for the ideas that do not have a link yet

Hashtags are recognized and are suggested and the ones you already have are automatically added, but you can easily remove those you don't want during the reference import.

When a page offers more than one image, you choose which one becomes the tile.

## Organize the way you think

Sort references into boards, one per project, mood or topic. Tag them with colored labels and group those labels into folders, so a growing collection stays easy to navigate.

Switch between layouts and filter by file type, boards and/or tags to view your references however you like.

## Collaborate

Share a board with anyone on your Nextcloud, with view-only or full edit access. Sharing uses Nextcloud's own sharing and permissions, so collaborators' changes are attributed to them. Leave comments on a reference to discuss it in context.

## How files are handled

- On first launch you choose the Nextcloud folder where Curio keeps its boards. Your references can be found in that folder and subfolders and removal of curio will not delete them.
- Files can be dropped into those folders from the nextcloud file manager and they will appear on the board. Renaming or removing from outside the app also works.
- Imported images will be converted to .webp to save up on space on your cloud.
- Videos are not converted and will be links to the site so they may break if site removes the videos or moves them
- A button in the settings lets you export or import a board as CSV of references.
- Everything remains on your server, nothing is sent to a third party. Your references live on your server, under your control.

customercheck.description:
# CustomerCheck

The Nextcloud-native CRM for customer work: one place where a workspace
shares a customer book, shared mailbox, account plans, and operating rituals —
so the team can see what’s going on, decide what’s next, chase deals and renewals,
coach the team, and measure the book by joining Check apps and Groupware.

A focused CRM — not Salesforce. Ledgers stay in ProjectCheck, InvoiceCheck, TicketCheck, Files, Mail, Tasks.

## Highlights

- **Today / Pulse / Brief** — act now, measure the book, weekly owned commitments
- **Company 360** — Ten Command Questions with honest sibling mute reasons
- **Workspaces** — roles, switcher, fail-closed directory allowlists
- **My Chase & Pipeline** — next action, quote age, sequences, loss codes, forecast labels (not cash)
- **KAM coverage** — buying roles, next touch, customer promises
- **Team coaching** — stuck board, OOO backup (non-stealing), bulk reassign
- **Universal Review & Conflicts** — shared mail + platform candidates; three-way edit conflicts with reason
- **Renewal engine** — 60/30/7/0/+7 exactly-once remlog + ICS
- **Shared mailbox** — folder IMAP + SMTP send with unavoidable shared disclosure
- **Check Partner hours** — 15-minute quota log with 80 % alert
- **Integrations** — optional ProjectCheck, InvoiceCheck, TicketCheck, SbdLicenseOps
- **Accessibility** — WCAG 2.1 AA; responsive from 320 px · EN + DE
- **Web free (AGPL)** — companion seats never gate the web app

## Feedback welcome

We improve this app with real-world use. Bug reports, rough edges, and ideas help — open a GitHub Issue (https://github.com/aSoftwareByDesignRepository/nextcloud-customercheck/issues) or write to info@software-by-design.de. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

## Requirements

- Nextcloud 32–35
- PHP 8.2+
- MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL

dailyverses.description:
# **Daily Verses for Nextcloud**
Displays a daily or random Bible verse from dailyverses.net on your Nextcloud dashboard, with support for 26 languages and multiple Bible translations.

---

## **Features**
- **Daily or random Bible verse** from dailyverses.net  
- **26 supported languages**  
- **Multiple Bible translations**  
- **Dashboard widget** for quick inspiration  
- **Admin settings** for global defaults  
- **Personal settings** for user‑specific preferences  
- Optional **links to full verse context**  
- Lightweight, fast, and privacy‑friendly (no tracking)

---

## **Configuration**

### **Admin Settings**
Admins can configure:
- Default language  
- Default Bible translation  
- Whether verse links should be shown  
- Whether users may override global settings  

Available under:  
**Settings → Administration → Daily Verses**

### **Personal Settings**
Each user can override:
- Language  
- Translation  
- Link visibility  

Available under:  
**Settings → Personal → Daily Verses**

---

## **Dashboard Widget**
The widget displays:
- Today’s verse (or a random verse, if selected)
- Translation and language
- Optional link to dailyverses.net for full context

The widget updates automatically every day. In daily mode, the text is cached for one day.

---

## **Supported Languages**
The app supports 26 languages, including English, Dutch, German, Danish, and more.  
Translations are provided directly by dailyverses.net.

The backend supports the languages ​​German, English, Danish, and Dutch.

dailyzenquote.description:
This dashboard widget shows either an inspirational quote or notable historical events, births and deaths on the calendar day. This can be configured is the user's Personal Settings.

The content is provided by [ZenQuotes.io](https://zenquotes.io/). It uses the "Zen Quote of the Day" and "On This Day" APIs and is refreshed daily. 

The developer has no affiliation with ZenQuotes.io and is not responsible for the content.

dashboard_links.description:
Company links on the Dashboard: the handbook, the help desk, the tools people should open.

An administrator keeps one catalog. The same links appear in the tile and on the All links page.

* **Categories** are headings. Links without a category stay in one list. The line under a link is the host.
* **Icons** come from Nextcloud, from an uploaded image, or from the site's favicon.
* **https only.** A link can be switched off without deleting it.
* **Show the tile.** After the app is enabled, each person adds Company links under Customize.

**Privacy.** This app stores no user accounts and sends no catalog to the author. Opening a link sends the browser to the https address an administrator saved. The response sets Referrer-Policy to no-referrer. The destination can still see the IP address and the usual browser headers. Name those destinations in the instance privacy notice.

Fetch favicon runs only when an administrator presses the button. The server then requests that site. If the site returns no image, the server requests a favicon for the hostname from Google. Removing the app deletes the catalog and the stored icons.

dashlink.description:
DashLink provides a dashboard widget that displays external website links configured by administrators or users.

Core Features:
- Dashboard widget displaying external links (max 10 visible)
- Custom icon/logo upload for each link (PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG, WebP up to 2MB)
- Group-based visibility control (show links to specific user groups)
- Three modular hover animation effects (Blur Overlay, 3D Card Flip, Slide Panel)
- Responsive grid layout (1-2 columns) with full dark mode support
- User-private links: users can create personal links visible only to themselves (admin-configurable)

Admin Panel:
- Complete CRUD operations for link management
- Drag & drop reordering with visual position badges
- Export/Import links to/from JSON with icon URL support
- Automatic icon downloading from external URLs during import
- Duplicate detection on import (by title or URL)
- Live preview panel with group filter simulation
- Modern Nextcloud UI (toggle switches, modals, autocomplete pickers)
- Toggle to enable/disable user-private links (disabled by default)
- Configurable maximum links per user (1-50, default 10)

data_request.description: Enable your users to request an export or deletion of their data. According options are added to the personal settings section. Administrators will be notified by email about the request.

dav_push.description:
In proprietary environments, changes in events and contacts are nowadays usually pushed to other clients so that they can update their views almost in real-time.

WebDAV however (and in this context, especially CalDAV and CardDAV) doesn't currently support push notifications of clients when a collection has changed. So clients have to periodically ask the server for changes. This causes unnecessary delays and battery usage.

The WebDAV-Push standard, which is currently in development, wants to solve this problem with an open protocol, too.

This is the server part of these efforts to draft a standard and provide a working implementation (server + client) in order to demonstrate it.


The current WebDAV-Push draft is provided by [@bitfireAT](https://github.com/bitfireAT).
          
This Nextcloud extension has been developed by [@verdigado](https://github.com/verdigado).

deck.description:
Deck is a kanban style organization tool aimed at personal planning and project organization for teams integrated with Nextcloud.


- 📥 Add your tasks to cards and put them in order
- 📄 Write down additional notes in Markdown
- 🔖 Assign labels for even better organization
- 👥 Share with your team, friends or family
- 📎 Attach files and embed them in your Markdown description
- 💬 Discuss with your team using comments
- ⚡ Keep track of changes in the activity stream
- 🚀 Get your project organized

deck_trello.description: Creates a new Deck board from a Trello JSON export: lists, cards, labels, checklists, comments and members.

deckchecklist.description: Adds Trello-style checklists to Nextcloud Deck cards: several lists per card, checkboxes, progress and a badge on the board.

deckgithubsync.description:
Connect a Nextcloud Deck board to a GitHub Project and keep cards and project items aligned.

* Sync cards and project items in both directions, or choose one direction per field.
* Map Deck stacks to the GitHub Project Status field.
* Sync titles, descriptions, labels, assignees, dates, completion state and comments.
* Use GitHub Issues when a repository is selected, or Project draft items without one.
* Connect with GitHub OAuth or a personal access token; optional GitHub App credentials support server-side sync.
* Run scheduled syncs, trigger a manual sync, or use a GitHub webhook for faster updates.

Requires the Nextcloud Deck app. Deck attachments remain in Nextcloud and are not uploaded to GitHub.

deferendum.description: A read-only Dashboard and a mobile-first glass workspace for selected Deferendum groups, with a guide, searchable help and explicit action previews. Optional explicit permissions enable discussion reading and participation: concerns and urgency ratings, arguments and reactions, wording proposals and support, governing rules and voting. Each member connects separately; existing read-only grants are never upgraded automatically. Actions require confirmation and source role, phase and version checks. Connect an existing Deferendum account from a compatible public HTTPS Nextcloud instance. Each user selects accessible groups and separately authorizes optional discussion and participation permissions. No persistent private-content cache or default telemetry is maintained. The hosted service and the Nextcloud administrator remain separate trust boundaries.

deliver.description:
**Multimedia review tool for creatives.** 100% free, feature-complete alternative to Frame.io, but aspiring for more.

**Note:** Deliver is approaching v1.0 and will still have some bugs. Please help by [creating an issue](https://github.com/joshuabke/nextcloud-deliver/issues/new) for everything you find!

- 📂 **Review in place** from the Files sidebar, or a whole folder as a Project. Nothing is copied or moved.
- 🎯 **Comments on the Frame** or a Range, with Drawings, Replies, Reactions, Mentions and Attachments
- 🗂️ **Versions** stack by name (`…_v1`, `…_v2`) and compare side by side or under a wipe
- ✅ **Sign-off** with Approvals, Due Dates and reminders
- 🔗 **Clients without accounts** on Review Links: password, expiry, Watermark, downloads, and who watched what
- ⬆️ **Uploads in Deliver** that resume after an interruption, run in the background and show the processing until it is done
- 🎬 **Back into the edit:** export comments as markers for
  - Video: DaVinci Resolve (EDL), Premiere Pro (FCP7 XML), Final Cut Pro (FCPXML), CSV
  - Audio: WAV markers, MIDI, REAPER regions, Ableton Live Set
- 🎞️ **Supported files**
  - Video: MP4 and MOV (H.264), WebM
  - Audio: WAV, FLAC, MP3, AAC, Ogg
  - Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF
  - Everything else (ProRes, H.265, MXF, AVI …) needs ffmpeg
- 🌊 **Waveforms, thumbnails and scrubbing** by hovering over a video
- 📱 **Fully mobile ready:** use it as a web app on iOS and Android, and get notifications through the official Nextcloud app
- ⚡ **With ffmpeg on the server**
  - Proxies, thumbnails and waveforms for every format ffmpeg reads
  - Hardware encoding: VAAPI, NVENC, VideoToolbox

**Roadmap**

- **1.0:** the 0.x pre-releases settle, srt subtitles support
- **1.1 – Takes:** compare the Takes of a recording session on one timeline, jump between them at the same position and comment on the one that works

Screenshots: footage from Tears of Steel, (CC) Blender Foundation | mango.blender.org.

desktop_workspace.description:
Desktop Workspace adds a browser-contained workspace to Nextcloud with app windows, a taskbar, app pinning, desktop icons, saved window/app-menu/icon state, and optional desktop-folder/file-manager features.

Admins can enable the app like any other Nextcloud app and configure decorations, the experimental file manager, multiple-window behavior, and per-user resets from the Desktop Workspace admin settings. Users can adjust their own desktop icons, desktop folder, decoration, experimental opt-ins, window state, and reset options from the Desktop personal settings.

digikam_face_sync.description:
The Nextcloud half of DigiMem, which keeps face names and rectangles in step
between a local digiKam library and Nextcloud Memories, in both directions.

Adds authenticated APIs for importing digiKam face rectangles and reading
named Recognize faces. Face descriptors are generated locally with the model
installed by Recognize.

Also reports a cheap fingerprint of your named faces, so Face Sync can tell
whether anything changed without reading the whole library, and whether
Recognize is busy so it can wait its turn.

This app does nothing on its own. DigiMem itself is a desktop application for
Linux, macOS and Windows, and is what talks to it.

diskmap.description:
DiskMap shows where storage is going across your Nextcloud instance — per user and per team
folder — without scanning anything.

Nextcloud already tracks aggregated folder sizes in its file cache, updated on every operation.
DiskMap is a visualizer over data that already exists: it never triggers a filesystem scan.

Each view pairs a WinDirStat-style treemap with an expandable folder tree, kept in sync both
ways: click a tile on the map and the tree opens to that file, click a row in the tree and the
map highlights its region. A File age view swaps the map for a breakdown of files by
last-modified date, following the selected folder and category filter.

**For administrators:**
- Whole-server view: every account, team folder and external storage as a top-level entry,
  browsable down to individual files.
- Team folders overview: used space, quota and occupancy, with a files / trash / versions
  breakdown for each folder.

**For every user:**
- The same treemap and folder tree over your own storage, with quota occupancy and a
  files / trash / versions breakdown.

All figures show the timestamp of the underlying file cache entry, so it's always clear this
reflects what Nextcloud's cache knows, not a live disk read.

dkmunicipalorganisation.description:
Our app integrates Nextcloud with the municipal access management and organizational service, providing access to shared municipal systems.

The app supports integration with the two central services in the municipal infrastructure:
- Access Management
- Organization

The organizational structure is synchronized once every 24 hours. For each department, the app automatically creates a team folder and a corresponding user group in Nextcloud.

When users log in to Nextcloud via the municipal access management system, they are automatically created as users in Nextcloud if they have one of the two defined system roles: User or System Administrator.

Users with the System Administrator role are automatically assigned to Nextcloud's admin group and are thereby granted permissions to perform administrative tasks.

Users with the User role are assigned the User role with the organization as their data scope restriction. They are granted access to the team folders associated with the organizations included in their data scope.

The team folders are available in the Files app, where documents can be created, edited, and shared.

doconext_finder.description:
Finder is a search app for your Nextcloud files, built for people who look
things up all day.

- **Structured search** — combine conditions on name, size, created and
  modified date. Match all of them, or any of them.
- **Saved searches** — name a search you run often and get back to it in one
  click. Recent searches are kept automatically.
- **Configurable columns** — choose which columns the result grid shows, in
  which order, and rename them to your own vocabulary.
- **Grouping** — group results by type, folder or date to see the shape of a
  result set instead of a flat list.
- **Favorites** — browse and toggle your favorite files from the same grid.
- **File commands** — open in Files or in the desktop app, jump to the
  containing folder, preview, download, upload a new version or add files to a
  folder, straight from the result row.

Everything works on a plain Nextcloud; nothing else needs to be installed.
Where DoCoNEXT Core also runs (available from DoCoNEXT, not from this store),
Finder additionally filters and groups on Core's metadata fields.

documentserver_community.description:
Document server for OnlyOffice, community edition.

The community document server is designed to make it easy to get OnlyOffice running in a Nextcloud instance without the need to setup an external document server,
the community document server does not support all features of the official OnlyOffice document server and does not provide the same performance and scalability.

It bundles Euro-Office (https://github.com/Euro-Office/DocumentServer), a fork of ONLYOFFICE DocumentServer, and plugs into the OnlyOffice connector app as before.

If you are setting up a larger instance or require the additional performance, please see https://onlyoffice.com for options for getting the official document server.

The community document server will automatically be configured if no other document server is configured for OnlyOffice.

Additionally, the community document server only supports running on x86-64 Linux servers.

dokuwiki.description: Embed an existing DokuWiki instance into Nextcloud, potentially with SSO. For SSO DokuWiki users and Nextcloud users have to coincide, e.g. by using a common authentication backend like LDAP, or with an appropriate auth plugin on either side of the integration.

domus.description:
Domus bündelt die Verwaltung Ihrer Mietobjekte in Nextcloud: von Objekten und Einheiten über Mietverhältnisse und Kontakte bis zu Buchungen, Dokumenten und Aufgaben.

Ob einzelne Wohnung oder mehrere Objekte: Sie finden die zugehörigen Informationen an einem Ort und behalten anstehende Arbeiten im Blick.

## Warum Sie es nutzen
- Verknüpfen Sie Einheiten, Mietverhältnisse, Kontakte, Buchungen und Dokumente.
- Vergleichen Sie vereinbarte Mieten mit erfassten Buchungen und sehen Sie offene Aufgaben.
- Finden Sie Dokumente und Notizen im Zusammenhang mit dem jeweiligen Objekt wieder.
- Nutzen Sie Dashboard und Auswertungen für den Überblick über Ihre Vermietungen.

Entwickelt für Vermieter und kleine Hausverwaltungen, die einen klaren Überblick im Alltag wollen und ihre Daten trotzdem privat in Nextcloud behalten möchten.

## Was Sie damit tun können
- Für jedes Objekt oder jede Einheit eine klare Übersicht führen.
- Mietverhältnisse, Kontakte und Mietzeiträume im Blick behalten.
- Einnahmen und Ausgaben als Buchungen erfassen und Dokumente zuordnen.
- Einzelne Aufgaben und mehrstufige Prozesse verfolgen.
- Buchungen nach Jahr, Einheit und Konto auswerten.

done.description:
**Stop guessing where your team's time goes.** Done turns everyday time tracking into a clear picture of your projects, people and profitability, right inside your Nextcloud.

No new SaaS account, no data leaving your server. Employee profiles are built from your Nextcloud users, so your team can start logging time in minutes.

## Why teams choose Done

- 🔒 **Your data stays yours.** Everything lives in your own Nextcloud, not in someone else's cloud.
- ⏱️ **Logging time takes seconds.** Quick entry, a fast time picker, repeating entries and remembered recent projects mean people actually keep their timesheets up to date.
- 📊 **Reports without spreadsheets.** Look at effort by project, employee or period, and drill down from the big picture to single records.
- 💰 **From hours to margin.** Link actual effort to labour cost, client price and extra expenses, so you know which projects really make money.
- 🧩 **Pay only for what you use.** Start free and add modules as your processes grow.

## Free: everything you need to start

- **Time tracking** by project and task, with comments and personal statistics
- **Projects** with team members, roles, stages and custom fields
- **Employees** in a smart table (drag-and-drop columns, multi-level sorting and filtering) or as cards
- **Reports**: overall, by project and by employee

## Professional: run the whole team

- 👩‍💻 **Teams**: group people and see workload and utilization at a glance
- 💼 **Finance**: payments, contracts and contract parameters with calculation formulas
- 🌴 **Leave**: balances, requests and a team availability schedule, plus leave reports
- ✅ **Approvals**: employee requests submitted and reviewed in one place, instead of getting lost in email and chats

## AI: ask your data in plain language

- 💬 **AI chat**: *"What did Anna work on in project X this month?"* The answer comes from your Done data.
- 📅 **My day**: suggested time entries based on your calendar events

## Built for project-driven teams

Agencies, development studios, consultancies and internal project offices use Done to answer three questions every manager asks: *Who is working on what? Where is the time going? Is this project profitable?*

Flexible permissions, custom fields and configurable interface visibility let you fit Done to your structure, not the other way round.

## Get started

1. Click **Enable** in your Nextcloud Apps.
2. Open **Done**. Your Nextcloud users are ready to become employees.
3. Create a project and log your first hour.

🌐 [the-done.app](https://the-done.app) · 💳 [Pricing](https://the-done.app/en/pricing/) · 📖 [Support](https://the-done.app/en/support/) · 🐞 [GitHub](https://github.com/the-done)

dutycheck.description:
# Plan shifts. Catch conflicts. Publish with a trail.

DutyCheck builds duty rosters inside your self-hosted Nextcloud. Open a planning period, assign people to locations, see hard blocks and soft warnings while you edit — then publish, close and keep a snapshot when someone asks who was on duty.

**Free web app** (AGPL-3.0-or-later).

## Why teams install it

- **Edit with confidence** — overlaps, understaffing, short breaks and period totals surface before you publish
- **A flow everyone understands** — open → published → closed (with reopen); conflict thresholds freeze when the period is created
- **Fill faster** — employee×day grid and list, shift templates, bulk fill, printable roster with integrity hash
- **Staff self-service** — my roster, absences, acknowledge, claim open shifts, swap requests, per-person iCal feed
- **Prove what was planned** — snapshots with hash chain, period audit trail, Activity and Notifications
- **Stay scoped** — planner vs employee roles, optional location scope, optional companies/workspaces
- **Optional ArbeitszeitCheck** — mirror absences for conflict checks (off until you enable it; DutyCheck never writes back)

## Clear limits

- HR CSV exports minutes — not salaries.
- Audit entries are append-only.
- Conflict checks are ArbZG-oriented and configurable — not a legal certification.
- Declared databases: MySQL and PostgreSQL.

## Feedback welcome

We improve this app with real-world use. Bug reports, rough edges, and ideas help — open a GitHub Issue (https://github.com/aSoftwareByDesignRepository/nextcloud-dutycheck/issues) or write to info@software-by-design.de. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

ebookreader.description:
Library, reader and editor for e-books and comics. Your books stay ordinary files in Nextcloud. The app indexes them and syncs your reading position across devices. No extra container or external service needed.

**Reading**
- EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT
- Opens from the Files app, paginated or scrolled, light, sepia and dark themes
- Comics as single or double pages, right-to-left for manga
- Highlights, notes and bookmarks, exportable as Markdown
- Large files open fast: pages and chapters are streamed

**Library**
- Cover grid or list with "Continue reading" and series progress
- Filter by genre, tag, author, series, format, rating and status
- Manual and smart shelves
- Share books, shelves, series and folders with other users
- Bulk editing and drag-and-drop upload
- Dashboard widget and OPDS catalog for e-reader apps

**Editing**
- Metadata, cover, chapters, pages and table of contents

The app is in beta. The editor modifies files, so keep a backup of your books.

editbase.description:
EditBase is a word processor whose documents are ordinary web pages. Every document is saved to your Nextcloud Files as a single self-contained .html file with its stylesheet inside it, so it opens in any browser, on any device, for as long as browsers exist — no import, no export, no proprietary format in between.

Because the document is HTML and CSS, printing is typesetting: paper size, orientation and margins are set in millimetres, page breaks are explicit, and your browser's own "Save as PDF" produces the finished result. The editor lays the pages out itself and draws them as sheets of paper, so what is on the screen is what comes off the printer.

EditBase is a program for writing documents with HTML, CSS and JavaScript alone, without relying on any external program. It is made to work like LibreOffice Writer, with handling close to that of DTP software. It has grown into a very large program, so many bugs may remain.

Features:
- Documents are plain HTML files in your own Files, editable and shareable like any other file
- Paper setup in millimetres — A3, A4, A5, B4, B5, Letter and Legal, portrait or landscape — with page guides, a ruler and a grid
- A running header and footer on every printed page, carrying the page number, the title, the file name or the date
- Headings, lists, tables, quotations, callout boxes, footnotes, a table of contents, columns and vertical writing
- Readings over words (ruby), emphasis dots, highlighting and text colour, applied as clean HTML rather than editor cruft
- Pictures, shapes, tables, rules and embedded pages placed by hand: standard placement keeps clear of the text and of other objects by the rules of HTML; free placement puts it anywhere with CSS
- Tables that calculate like a small spreadsheet: formulas as in LibreOffice Calc, a formula bar, column letters and row numbers
- Cell properties in tabs as in Excel: number format, alignment, font, borders and fill, for a block of cells at once
- Twenty heading designs drawn with CSS alone
- Frames that carry their writing on into the next page, cut at the line rather than at the edge of the paper
- Mathematics written as native MathML — no images, no external renderer
- Formulas made in FormulaBase inserted into the document as they are
- An AI assistant, through the AI-Hub app: a chat beside the pages that knows EditBase, changes the open document when asked (every change undoable with Ctrl+Z) and reads from the other apps of the series only as the administrator allows
- Styles for each kind of block, and the document's own stylesheet for anything they cannot say
- A check over the document that finds what is wrong with the page before it is printed
- Find and replace, recorded changes, mail merge, and an undo history kept by the editor itself
- HTML5 and CSS first: JavaScript is used only for what they cannot do (text on both sides of an object, photographs enlarged with an effect, table calculation), and can be turned on or off for each document
