end_to_end_encryption.description:
## **End-to-End Encryption**

### For End Users

**Protect your most sensitive files with strong encryption.**

The End-to-End Encryption app gives you complete control over your data privacy.
With this app, you can encrypt specific folders so that only you (and those you trust) can access their contents.
Your files are encrypted on your device before they reach the server, ensuring that no one—not even the server administrator—can read them.

**Benefits:**
- 🔒 **True privacy**: Files are encrypted on your device and can only be decrypted by you
- 📱 **Works across all platforms**: Fully supported on desktop, Android, iOS clients, and as you wish even in the browser
- 🎯 **Selective encryption**: Choose which folders to encrypt
- 🛡️ **Secure sharing**: Share encrypted files with other users or even secure public upload using the encrypted file drop

---

### For Administrators

**Enterprise-ready end-to-end encryption infrastructure for your Nextcloud instance.**

This app provides all the necessary server-side APIs and infrastructure to enable End-to-End encryption (E2EE) for your users.
It ensures that encrypted data remains secure throughout its lifecycle on your server.

**Technical highlights:**
- 🔐 **Complete API suite**: Provides all client-side APIs needed for E2EE implementation
- 🔒 **Secure FileDrop integration**: Enables secure file sharing with encryption
- 🛡️ **Zero-knowledge architecture**: Server never has access to encryption keys
- ⚙️ **Group restrictions**: Limit app usage to specific user groups if needed
- 🔄 **Background job management**: Automatic rollback handling for failed operations

### Setup
This application provides the server-side infrastructure for end-to-end encryption, but it requires client support to function.
To enable end-to-end encryption, users will need to install the corresponding client-side app on their devices (desktop, Android, iOS) or use the web client.

Using the web interface, after enabling it in the personal settings, allows you to encrypt files and folders directly in the browser,
providing a seamless experience without needing additional software. But also requires some kind of trust in the server as the code is delivered by the server and could be manipulated.

Once enable through clients or the web interface, you can create encrypted folders and upload or move files into them.
The clients and the web interface will handle the encryption and decryption processes automatically.

⚠️ This comes with some limitations and caveats, as only normal file operations can be handled.
Meaning that some apps in the web interface do not work with encrypted files.

epubviewer.description:
# EPUB Viewer
EPUB Viewer is an ebook reader based on pure javascript renderers. It works for publications formatted according to the following standards:

 - [EPUB]
 - [PDF]
 - [CBR and CBZ] ('comics')

EPUB files are displayed using the futurepress [epub.js] renderer to provide near-native looks, especially when used full-screen. Turn pages by pressing the left/right hand side of the screen/window or using the cursor keys (if you have those), use the sidebar to browse through chapters or bookmarks and add annotations.

PDF is handled by Mozilla's [pdf.js] renderer in combination with a custom reader app to enable side-by-side display, batch search and more. Controls are like those used in the Epub renderer with a few exceptions, e.g. night mode has not been implemented yet.

CBR and CBZ are supported using a custom renderer inspired by [balaclark]'s work. As with Epub, books can be navigated using the keyboard as well as mouse or touch navigation. Reader generates a visual index of all pages, show in the sidebar (thumbnail generation can be disabled for low-memory and/or -speed devices). As CBx files are often of varying quality, a set of image enhancement filters are provided.

Comic pages may use static JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP images. PDF and comic documents are limited to 1,000 pages. Animated images and TIFF pages are not supported.

Nextcloud file thumbnails use the first naturally ordered supported image in CBZ archives. CBR thumbnails are enabled when the optional PHP `rar` extension is installed. Unsupported, encrypted, multi-volume, malformed, or over-limit archives retain Nextcloud's generic file icon.

See [README] for more exhaustive information on features and potential misfeatures of this app.

   [epub.js]: https://github.com/futurepress/epub.js
   [EPUB]: http://idpf.org/epub
   [CBR and CBZ]: https://wiki.mobileread.com/wiki/CBR_and_CBZ
   [balaclark]: https://github.com/balaclark/HTML5-Comic-Book-Reader
   [PDF]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portable_Document_Format
   [pdf.js]: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
   [README]: https://github.com/devnoname120/epubviewer#readme

eva_ai.description:
Eva AI turns your Nextcloud into a private, searchable knowledge base powered by Large Language Models. Ask questions in natural language and get instant, cited answers drawn from your own files — fully local with Ollama, or optionally via Groq for cloud-hosted inference.

## Why Eva AI?

Your data stays yours. No third-party indexing, no external databases, no cloud required. Eva runs entirely within your Nextcloud instance, giving you full control over your files and conversations.

## Key Features

**Intelligent File Indexing**
Eva automatically reads, chunks, and embeds your files for semantic search. Supports a wide range of formats: plain text (txt, md, csv, json, xml, yaml, sql, ...), PDF, Microsoft Office (docx/xlsx/pptx with macros and templates), OpenDocument (odt/ods/odp), EPUB, saved mail (eml, mbox), web archives (mht/mhtml), Jupyter notebooks (ipynb), and many more. A file that cannot be read is skipped instead of stopping the run.

**Hybrid Retrieval Engine**
Combines vector-based semantic search with lexical search (BM25) using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to deliver the most relevant results — even for exact-match queries.

**Cited Sources**
Every answer includes the exact file path where the information was found, so you can always verify the source. Answers that used the web list the pages they actually retrieved, with their site and an excerpt, marked as web sources.

**Nextcloud Integration**
Eva can perform actions directly within Nextcloud: search for files, create documents, rename items, and work with templates across your entire home space — including Notes and Contacts.

**Ollama and Groq Support**
Start fully local with Ollama (no configuration required) or optionally connect to Groq for cloud-hosted inference. Embeddings always run locally via Ollama.

**Zero Configuration**
Just install and go. Eva automatically detects your local Ollama instance and selects appropriate models.

**Talk Integration**
Optionally integrate with Nextcloud Talk for conversational AI within your chat rooms.

## Requirements

- Nextcloud 30–35
- PHP 8.2+
- [Ollama](https://ollama.com) running locally (default: http://localhost:11434)
- Optional: Groq API key for cloud-hosted inference

## Get Started

1. Install the app
2. Ensure Ollama is running on your server
3. Open Eva from the left sidebar
4. Start chatting with your files

## Privacy

With Ollama, all processing happens on your server. Your files never leave your infrastructure. No analytics, no telemetry, no external calls.

## Support

- GitHub: https://github.com/SchBenedikt/nextcloud-ai
- Issues: https://github.com/SchBenedikt/nextcloud-ai/issues

Licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later.

extended_occweb.description:
A terminal in the browser for Nextcloud administrators: run occ commands and query the database without shell access to the server. Handy on Nextcloud All-in-One (AIO) and other container setups, where occ otherwise needs `docker exec`.

**occ mode**

- Run any occ command, with tab completion of command names and colored output.
- Every command is logged with the user who ran it, in the Nextcloud log and, when enabled, in the admin_audit log.

**SQL mode** (type `sql`)

- Run SQL against the Nextcloud database. Statements separated by `;` run as one batch on one connection, and the batch is rolled back if a statement fails.
- Results are shown as tables (up to 1000 rows per query).
- Statements that change data or the schema ask for confirmation before the batch runs. Reading or writing files on the database server and starting programs through SQL are blocked.
- Ready-made scripts: type `templates`, for example to look up or completely delete a local user. A template only fills the command line; nothing runs until you review it and press Enter.

**Security**

- Only members of the Nextcloud admin group can use the app; every request is checked and CSRF-protected.
- Treat access to it like shell access to the server, and run the database as a user without superuser or server file/program rights. See the Security section in the README.

**Limitations**

- Not an interactive terminal: long-running commands (like `files:scan` on a large instance) time out, and commands that ask questions cannot be answered (use `-n`).

file_checksum_search.description:
Indexes file checksums, so a file can be found by its checksum, and its duplicates at once.

- A **Duplicates** page: every group of identical files you hold, and, for those allowed to look across accounts, other accounts' files too.
- **Rules** decide what is hashed and when: instance-wide or per account, by path pattern, computed in the background.
- A stable **REST API (v1)** and a stable **PHP API** for other apps and integrations.
- **occ commands** for hashing, searching, duplicates, rules, backup and import.
- Storage in Nextcloud's own files metadata index: no custom tables, nothing to migrate.

files_accesscontrol.description:
Nextcloud's File Access Control app enables administrators to protect data from unauthorized access or modifications.

## How it works
The administrator can create and manage a set of rule groups. Each of the rule groups consists of one or more rules. If all rules of a group hold true, the group matches the request and access is being denied or the upload is blocked. The rules criteria range from IP address, MIME type and request time to group membership, tags, user agent and more.

An example would be to deny access to MS Excel/XLSX files owned by the "Human Resources" group accessed from an IP not on the internal company network or to block uploads of files bigger than 512 mb by students in the "1st year" group.

Learn more about File Access Control on [https://nextcloud.com/workflow](https://nextcloud.com/workflow)

files_antivirus.description:
Antivirus for files is an antivirus app for Nextcloud.

* 🕵️‍♂️ When the user uploads a file, it's checked
* ☢️ Uploaded and infected files will be deleted and a notification will be shown and/or sent via email
* 🔎 Background Job to scan all files
* ❓ Use ClamAV (open source), Kaspersky Scan Engine or an ICAP compatible scanner

This application inspects files that are uploaded to Nextcloud for viruses before they are written to the Nextcloud storage. If a file is identified as a virus, it is either logged or not uploaded to the server. The application relies on the underlying ClamAV virus scanning engine, which the admin points Nextcloud to when configuring the application. Alternatively, a Kaspersky Scan Engine can be configured, which has to run on a separate server.
For this app to be effective, the ClamAV virus definitions should be kept up to date. Also note that enabling this app will impact system performance as additional processing is required for every upload. More information is available in the Antivirus documentation.

files_automatedtagging.description:
An app for Nextcloud that automatically assigns tags to newly uploaded files based on some conditions.

The tags can later be used to control retention, file access, automatic script execution and more.

## How it works
To define tags, administrators can create and manage a set of rule groups. Each rule group consists of one or more rules combined through operators. Rules can include criteria like file type, size, time and more. A request matches a group if all rules evaluate to true. On uploading a file all defined groups are evaluated and when matching, the given tags are assigned to the file.

files_autorename.description:
AutoRename is a Nextcloud app that renames and organizes newly added or moved files based on user-defined rules.
By placing a `.rename.conf` file in a folder, users can specify regex-based patterns to rename or move files.

Renaming is handled by a background job that runs every few minutes, so changes may not be immediate.

Features:
- 📝 Define renaming rules using powerful regular expressions.
- 📂 Move files to subfolders specified in the new name (e.g., `subfolder/new_name`).
- 📅 Insert metadata like dates, EXIF data, or file modification times into filenames using [placeholders](https://github.com/powerflo/files_autorename/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#what-placeholders-can-i-use-in-the-replacement-string).
- 🔍 Extract [text from PDFs](https://github.com/powerflo/files_autorename/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#pdfPatternMatch) for custom filenames.
- 🔄 Transform filenames to [uppercase or lowercase](https://github.com/powerflo/files_autorename/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#how-do-i-rename-files-with-upperlowercase-changes).

Quick Start

1. Place a `.rename.conf` file in the desired folder.
2. Add a rule like this:
    ```
    ^Invoice_(\d{4})_(\d{2})\.pdf$:Invoices/$1/$2/$0
    ```
3. Upload a matching file (e.g., `Invoice_2025_04.pdf`) — it will be renamed to `Invoices/2025/04/Invoice_2025_04.pdf` during the next background job run.

Check out the [full documentation on GitHub](https://github.com/powerflo/files_autorename).

files_confidential.description:

files_emailviewer.description:
### Email Viewer lets you view `.eml` and `.msg` files in Nextcloud.

It renders the email as a PDF in your browser and opens it in the PDF Viewer.

#### Requirements

- Nextcloud 28 or newer
- Viewer and PDF Viewer for Nextcloud

#### Installation

- Download and enable files_emailviewer
- Upload a `.eml` or `.msg` file and view it directly in Nextcloud 🙌

#### Limitations

- **Images from the internet are not shown.** Only images that are part of the email itself are shown.
- **Interactive content is removed.** Forms and similar content do not appear.
- **Some `.msg` files show no text.** Outlook can save the text of an email in its "Rich Text" format. This format is not supported, so a note is shown instead of the text. Other `.msg` files are shown as usual.
- **Attachments are only listed.** The PDF names the attachments, but they cannot be opened from it.

files_excludedirs.description:
This application allows administrators to exclude specific directories and files from being added to the Nextcloud database file cache based on string patterns or glob wildcards.

This is extremely useful when using External Storages or shared folders that contain massive directories (like snapshot folders, node_modules, or cache folders) which can otherwise severely slow down the synchronization scanner.

**Features:**
- Universal storage wrapping for local, shared, and external storage mounts.
- Safe, real-time background file scanner exclusion.
- Beautiful built-in Web Administration interface to manage patterns, run dry-run previews of affected files, and safely trigger cache purges.
- Native `occ files_excludedirs:clean-cache` command-line utility for high-speed cache database cleanup.

files_external_ethswarm.description:

This plugin integrates [Swarm](https://www.ethswarm.org/) (a decentralized, blockchain-connected file storage system) directly into your [Nextcloud ](https://nextcloud.com/)instance.

## Table of Contents

- Usage
  - Settings
  - Using HejBit Swarm
  - Additional Integration with Moodle
- HejBit Free Trial

## Dependencies

Before using the plugin, ensure you have the following:

-   An active Nextcloud instance (version 33-35)
-   A valid subscription on [app.hejbit.com](https://app.hejbit.com)
    -   [Get Your Free Trial for the Nextcloud Swarm Plugin](https://app.hejbit.com/register)

## Setup and Installation

Follow these steps to configure HejBit Swarm in Nextcloud:

1. Install the "External Storage: HejBit Swarm" app from the Nextcloud App Store.
2. As a signed in user, use [Quick Connect](https://app.hejbit.com/plugin/setup) to setup the storage on your Nextcloud instance

## Usage

Once installed, HejBit integrates Swarm directly with Nextcloud’s "Files" section, allowing seamless file operations:

- **Upload:** Transfer files to decentralized storage.
- **Download/View:** Retrieve and view files from decentralized storage.
- **Copy/Move:** Shift files between any external storage and decentralized storage.
- **Rename:** Change file names as needed.
- **Archive/Restore:** Manage your files by archiving or restoring them.
- **Hide/Show:** Control the visibility of files in your storage.
- **View Swarm Reference:** Access the unique Swarm reference for each file.
- **Export all Swarm References:** Backup all your Swarm references easily.

Additionally, we have introduced a HejBit Feedback button that appears in the bottom left corner when you are inside a HejBit folder. This feature allows users to easily send feedback regarding general inquiries, ideas, or issues directly from the plugin.

### Settings

Users with administrative credentials can configure the plugin through the standard External Storage settings. Here, you can input your Access Key and URL for HejBit.

### Using HejBit Swarm

Once setup and configured, the Decentralized Storage is ready to use.

- Access the Decentralized Storage folder under "All Files" or via the "Files" menu under "External Storage."
- Once uploaded, it can be viewed internally or downloaded. It can also be copied to another storage.
- Files from another Nextcloud storage can also be copied/moved to the decentralized storage. Choose the decentralized storage folder as the target Folder.
- To access a file's Swarm reference (its unique swarm network address), you have two options: right-click directly on the file and select the reference option, or use the three-dot Actions menu and choose 'View Swarm Reference.' Both methods will display the hash, which you can then copy to your clipboard for sharing or future access.
- To effectively organize your files, you can utilize the Archive and Restore features for both folders and individual files, allowing for better management of your storage.
- For a comprehensive backup of all your Swarm hashes, you can easily export all Swarm references directly from the menu located in the root HejBit Swarm folder.
- We encourage you to share your thoughts and experiences with us! A **HejBit Feedback** button is conveniently located in the bottom left corner when you are inside a HejBit folder. This feature allows you to provide feedback on any inquiries, suggestions, or issues you may encounter, helping us enhance your experience and improve the plugin for all users.




### Additional Integration with Moodle

You can also enhance your experience by integrating the HejBit Swarm plugin with the **Moodle Nextcloud plugin**. This integration allows users to access decentralized storage directly within the Moodle environment, providing a seamless experience for educational content management. For more information on how to set up this integration, visit the [Moodle Nextcloud repository documentation](https://docs.moodle.org/405/en/Nextcloud_repository).

For detailed guidance on using the integrated features, please refer to the [Metaprovide Learning Platform](https://learning.metaprovide.org/login/index.php).

files_set_target.description:
Share Target adds one field to the sharing sidebar: the path the share gets
in the account of the recipient.

Nextcloud puts every incoming share in the share folder of the recipient,
under the name of the file or folder. This app lets the sharer pick the path
instead. A folder `Docs` sent to `Work/Client Files` shows as `Client Files`
inside `Work`.

- The field shows for account shares and for group shares.
- An administrator decides who may use it: everybody, or a list of accounts
  and groups.
- The app can make the parent folder in the account of the recipient, and
  remove it again when the share goes and the folder is empty. Both switches
  are off by default.
- Every path passes the same check in the browser and on the server: no
  traversal, no reserved name, no control character, no empty segment.
- The recipient gets a notification that names the new path.

files_sharing_raw.description:
Raw Fileserver (**`files_sharing_raw`**) serves files **as-is** so you can link directly to the file itself (i.e. without any of Nextcloud's UI). This makes it easy to host static web pages, RSS feeds, images, or other assets and embed/link them elsewhere.

## Design goals

* **Minimal**: deliver bytes, not UI.
* **Fast**: keep server work low (good for assets).
* **Quiet failures**: plain 404 Not found (text/plain) for invalid/missing public shares (no Nextcloud HTML error pages), ideal for asset fetches.
* **Privacy-friendly**: **cookie-free responses** (best effort).
* **Allowlist-gated:** public raw access is opt-in — only explicitly enabled public share tokens are served.
* **Secure by default**: strict CSP with optional per-scope overrides. *)
* **Streaming by default**: for normal `GET` (`200`) responses, the body is streamed whenever possible instead of loading the entire file into memory.

*) For security and privacy, the content is served with a configurable [Content-Security-Policy][] (CSP) header, allowing different policies per share token, path, file extension, or MIME type (with a safe hardcoded fallback).

[Content-Security-Policy]: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Content-Security-Policy

## Usage

The common usage is to first share a file and enable public access through a link. In the Advanced settings of this share (in the right sidebar), the Raw link must be enabled. If the share link is `https://my-nextcloud/s/aBc123DeF456xyZ`, then this app will provide access to the raw file at `https://my-nextcloud/raw/aBc123DeF456xyZ`. If the share is a folder, the files within it are accessible as e.g. `https://my-nextcloud/raw/aBc123DeF456xyZ/path/to/file`.

A user can also access their own private files. For example, a file named `test.html` in anansi's Documents folder would be available at `https://my-nextcloud/raw/u/anansi/Documents/test.html`.

files_snapshots.description: Allows using filesystem snapshots (from btrfs, zfs, etc) as versions trough the Nextcloud web interface. A full description can be found [in the README](https://github.com/icewind1991/files_snapshots)

files_versions_s3.description:
Use S3 object versioning for file versioning.

## Warning

This app does not include any mechanism for expiring old s3 versions,
you should setup your own version expiry (also called "Lifecycle management" in S3)
to prevent versions from taking up an ever increasing amount of space.

## Usage

- install the app
- check if bucket versioning is enabled for your storage using `occ files_versions_s3:status`
- enable bucket versioning if not yet enabled using `occ files_versions_s3:enable <id>`

Clicking that item will open the file in LibreOffice via WebDAV (the file can then be edited and saved back directly in LibreOffice).

This greatly improves the user experience when working with Office files in the browser. No need to download, edit, reupload. Instead use the "Edit with LibreOffice" item.

This app requires at least LibreOffice 7.2 on Linux and macOS. On Windows it also works with older LibreOffice versions (since LibreOffice 5.3).

fileviewer.description:
# Universal File Viewer

Universal File Viewer is a Nextcloud app that registers [Flyfish File Viewer](https://github.com/flyfish-dev/file-viewer) as a handler for
the 200+ file types supported by Flyfish.

The app renders files in a sandboxed iframe. The parent Nextcloud Viewer component
fetches the selected file with the authenticated Viewer URL and transfers the file
Blob over a document-bound `MessageChannel`. The default sandbox intentionally does
not include `allow-same-origin`. EPUB files use a two-stage bootstrap that commits
the renderer to an opaque `blob:null` document before any file bytes are transferred.
The renderer cannot read the parent Nextcloud document, while EPUB chapter content
stays in a nested iframe that allows its own origin but deliberately does not allow
scripts.

## Compatibility

The app supports Nextcloud **33, 34, and 35** with PHP **8.2 through 8.5**.
Nextcloud 35 itself requires PHP **8.3 or later**, so its effective supported PHP
range is 8.3 through 8.5. Nextcloud 36 is not included in the supported range.

The integration has been checked against the
[Nextcloud 35 release notes](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/stable/developer_manual/release_notes/index.html).
It uses the typed app-config API available since Nextcloud 29 and the complete MIME
mapping API available since Nextcloud 32; it does not require a Nextcloud 35-only
API. When adopting an API introduced after the declared minimum, raise the
Nextcloud minimum in `appinfo/info.xml` in the same change.

## Supported Formats

Universal File Viewer uses [Flyfish Viewer](https://github.com/flyfish-dev/file-viewer) and thus supports 200+ formats:
[supported formats](https://github.com/flyfish-dev/file-viewer/blob/main/README.en.md#supported-formats)
matrix.

| Category | Extensions |
| --- | --- |
| Word | `docx`, `docm`, `dotx`, `dotm` |
| Legacy Word | `doc`, `dot` |
| Compatible documents | `rtf`, `odt` |
| Excel | `xlsx`, `xltx` |
| Excel-compatible | `xlsm`, `xlsb`, `xls`, `xlt`, `xltm`, `csv`, `tsv`, `ods`, `fods`, `numbers` |
| PowerPoint | `ppt`, `pptx`, `pptm`, `potx`, `potm`, `ppsx`, `ppsm`, `odp` |
| PDF | `pdf` |
| OFD | `ofd` |
| Typst | `typ`, `typst` |
| Archives | `zip`, `zipx`, `7z`, `rar`, `tar`, `gz`, `tgz`, `bz2`, `xz`, `zst`, `cab`, `iso`, `jar`, `apk`, `cbz`, `cbr`, and more |
| Compiled HTML Help | `chm` |
| Binary inspection | `bin`, `hex`, `elf`, `exe`, `dll`, `class`, `macho` |
| Email | `eml`, `msg`, `mbox` |
| EDA | `olb`, `dra`, `gds`, `oas`, `oasis` |
| CAD | `dwg`, `dxf`, `dwf`, `dwfx`, `xps` |
| Geospatial data | `geojson`, `kml`, `gpx`, `shp` |
| 3D models | `glb`, `gltf`, `obj`, `stl`, `ply`, `fbx`, `dae`, `3ds`, `3mf`, `amf`, `usd`, `usda`, `usdc`, `usdz`, `kmz`, `pcd`, `wrl`, `vrml`, `xyz`, `vtk`, `vtp`, `step`, `stp`, `iges`, `igs`, `ifc`, `3dm` |
| XMind mind maps | `xmind` |
| Excalidraw | `excalidraw` |
| draw.io | `drawio`, `dio` |
| Mermaid | `mermaid`, `mmd` |
| PlantUML | `plantuml`, `puml` |
| EPUB | `epub` |
| UMD ebook | `umd` |
| LRC lyrics | `lrc` |
| Markdown | `md`, `markdown` |
| Images | `gif`, `jpg`, `jpeg`, `bmp`, `tiff`, `tif`, `png`, `svg`, `webp`, `avif`, `ico`, `heic`, `heif`, `jxl` |
| Source and text | `txt`, `json`, `jsonc`, `json5`, `ipynb`, `js`, `mjs`, `cjs`, `css`, `java`, `py`, `html`, `htm`, `jsx`, `ts`, `tsx`, `xml`, `log`, `vue`, `yaml`, `yml`, `toml`, `ini`, `proto`, `hcl`, `tex`, `gv`, `http`, `sh`, `bash`, `sql`, `go`, `rs`, `rb`, `swift`, `kt`, `react`, `php`, `c`, `cpp`, `cc`, `h`, `hpp`, `cs`, `diff`, `patch`, `bundle`, `bdl` |
| Audio | `mp3`, `mpeg`, `wav`, `ogg`, `oga`, `opus`, `m4a`, `aac`, `flac`, `weba`, `midi`, `mid` |
| Video | `mp4`, `webm`, `m3u8` |
| Adobe and design assets | `psd`, `psb`, `pdd`, `psdt`, `ai`, `ait`, `eps`, `ps`, `idml`, `icml`, `idms`, `inx`, `fla`, `xfl`, `xd`, `indd`, `indt`, `ase`, `aco`, `abr`, `csh`, `pat`, `grd`, `asl` |
| Medical images | `dcm`, `dicom` |
| Signatures and evidence containers | `p7m`, `p7s`, `p7c`, `p7b`, `pkcs7`, `cms`, `cmsc`, `tsd`, `tst`, `tsq`, `tsr`, `asics`, `scs`, `asice`, `sce`, `ers`, `asc`, `sig`, `pgp`, `gpg`, `jws` |
| Fonts and data assets | `ttf`, `otf`, `woff`, `woff2`, `sqlite`, `wasm`, `parquet`, `avro`, `webarchive` |

## File format settings

The administration page exposes human-readable format groups such as JPEG (`.jpg`,
`.jpeg`), Markdown (`.md`, `.markdown`), and EPUB (`.epub`). It does not expose raw
MIME type strings.

Universal File Viewer keeps Flyfish's supported-extension inventory, then resolves
those extensions through Nextcloud's effective extension-to-MIME mapping using
`OCP\Files\IMimeTypeDetector::getAllMappings()`. During installation, upgrades, and
re-enabling, the app adds fallback mappings for supported extensions that are absent
from both Nextcloud core and the administrator's `mimetypemapping.json`.
Administrator entries always win. The app tracks its exact additions, yields when
Nextcloud later gains a core mapping, and removes only unchanged app-owned entries during uninstall. The
resulting deduplicated MIME types are used internally when registering the Viewer
handler.

When several supported extensions resolve to the same MIME type, Nextcloud Viewer
cannot dispatch them independently. The settings page therefore combines them into
one option and lists every affected extension. Shared aliases keep their format name,
such as JPEG, while distinct formats use an explicit label such as `DOC/DOT`. Saved
preferences use stable app-specific format identifiers; existing `disabled_mimes`
preferences are migrated against the current Nextcloud mapping.

MIME lifecycle operations hold `config/mimetypemapping.json.lock` across the
mapping, ownership, and filecache updates. Administrator automation that edits the
mapping file must take the same exclusive lock for its complete read/modify/write
operation. Updates use an atomic replacement that preserves file permissions and
ownership, and abort when an uncoordinated edit changes the loaded snapshot.

## Geospatial basemap settings

Custom basemap URLs and API keys are public browser configuration, visible to
geospatial viewers and public-share visitors. Only use provider keys restricted to
this Nextcloud instance, map access, and appropriate quotas; secret server tokens
are unsupported. The administrator must explicitly confirm this contract before a
custom basemap is enabled. Existing custom configurations use an offline basemap
until that confirmation is saved. Configuration is fetched only when opening a
geospatial file and is excluded from general Viewer initial state and console logs.

## Sandbox

The default sandbox is:

```text
allow-scripts allow-downloads allow-forms allow-modals allow-popups allow-presentation
```

For `.epub` files, an HTTP bootstrap starts with the stricter `allow-scripts`
sandbox and creates the final renderer Blob from a fixed application template. The
parent briefly grants `allow-same-origin` only while that already-opaque bootstrap
navigates to its `blob:null` URL. A small renderer gate establishes a
document-bound `MessageChannel`; the parent then restores the strict sandbox before
loading Flyfish or transferring the EPUB. The gate probes whether the browser can
still create the readable nested chapter iframe EPUB.js requires. Chromium and
Firefox pass this probe. Current WebKit/Safari fails closed with an explanatory
error instead of retaining an outer sandbox configuration that could become
same-origin after a later navigation.

Flyfish and EPUB.js render untrusted chapter content in a nested iframe whose
sandbox contains `allow-same-origin` but not `allow-scripts`, so chapter scripts and
event handlers cannot run. The outer renderer remains opaque and cannot read the
parent Nextcloud document. Once its final load is confirmed over the bound channel,
any later outer-frame navigation disconnects and removes the viewer. The browser
test suite checks the origin boundary, publisher styling, script isolation,
fail-closed behavior, and unexpected-navigation handling; Flyfish and EPUB.js
upgrades should be treated as security-sensitive changes.

Other file types keep the configured outer sandbox unchanged. Switching across the
EPUB boundary closes the old channel, rotates its token, and replaces the iframe so
the browser applies the new origin policy to a fresh document.

Parser workers do not run in the parent Nextcloud page. For PDF, DOCX-family,
PPTX-family, DWG, STEP/IGES/BREP, specialist binary/design/DICOM/signature formats,
and spreadsheet files of at least 1 MiB, the frame fetches the
exact configured bundled worker without credentials, creates a frame-owned `blob:`
URL, and starts the worker from inside the sandbox. Under the default sandbox these
workers have the opaque `null` origin. Libarchive formats use the same frame-owned
`blob:` isolation model. Legacy PPT uses Flyfish's asynchronous direct path because
its integrity-verifying Worker requires Web Crypto, which Chromium does not expose
to an opaque `blob:null` Worker. Smaller spreadsheet files and legacy PPT parse on
the iframe's main thread, which is also sandboxed.

The only default-page CSP additions are `frame-src 'self' blob:`, and they are added
only to responses that dispatch Nextcloud's Viewer-loading event. The app does not
add instance-wide worker, connection, WebAssembly-eval, style, image, font, or media
allowances. The direct iframe response has its own scoped CSP for local assets,
frame-owned `blob:` workers, renderer-required evaluation and WebAssembly, and the
configured geospatial tile origin. The EPUB bootstrap uses a separate, narrower CSP
without geospatial origins.

If a deployment needs to trade isolation for non-EPUB compatibility with specific
browser worker or WASM behavior, administrators can override the general sandbox.
EPUB always uses the hardened bootstrap and does not fall back to a same-origin
Nextcloud document:

```bash
occ config:app:set fileviewer sandbox --value="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-downloads allow-forms allow-modals allow-popups allow-presentation"
```

findling.description:
What Findling does:
- Full text search in the normal Nextcloud search bar
- Filter by file type or folder directly in the Nextcloud search
- OCR for scanned PDFs and images: ten languages available, German, English and French are the default
- Semantic search: finds documents through paraphrases
- Similar documents: a link at every hit on the results page lists files with related content
- Every result is permission-checked by Nextcloud
- No configuration: the first index run starts on its own
- Exclude folders or patterns such as *.photoslibrary from the index
- Performance profiles: Economy by default, Standard and Performance after a pre-check of the hardware
- Search model: int8 built in, the more accurate fp32 can be downloaded once under Standard and Performance
- Privacy: everything runs locally, no telemetry, nothing leaves your server
- Search languages: German and English by default, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese and Czech available

Switching from fulltextsearch/Elasticsearch: [steps in the documentation](https://github.com/street1983nk/nextcloud-search/blob/v1.5.1/docs/migrate-from-fulltextsearch.en.md)

Known limitations:
- Spanish: año and ano are treated as the same word
- Portuguese: spellings before and after the spelling reform are not unified
- Compound words are split for German and Dutch only
- French has no full text analysis chain for document text
- Czech: no stemming, inflected forms count as separate words

Together with the [Nextcloud MCP Connector](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/mcp_connector), Findling forms the retrieval layer for your own RAG: AI assistants search your document contents with exactly the rights of the asking user, and no content leaves your server.

Supported file types:
- PDF (scanned too), DOC, DOCX, PPTX, XLS, XLSX, ODT, ODS, ODP
- HTML, RTF, TXT, Markdown, CSV, mails (EML)
- ZIP files: the files inside, without OCR
- Images through OCR: JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, HEIC

Requirements:
- Nextcloud 33 to 35, apps: AppAPI, Findling Backend (External Apps), Findling
- RAM: 4 GB is enough, 730.2 MB resident after an index run, under a hard 2 GB limit (measured)
- CPU: 2 cores are enough, amd64 and arm64

Without any change on your side, Findling keeps running as economically as before. Anyone with more hardware can use a profile to free at most half of the machine the backend runs on (Standard profile) or everything but one core (Performance profile).

Enterprise support and paid add-ons: request a quote at admin@infranode.dev

fintrack.description:
FinTrack is a full-featured personal finance tracking application integrated into Nextcloud.
**Features:**
- Asset, Expense, Revenue and Liability accounts
- Multi-currency support with online live conversion rates
- Income and expense transaction tracking
- Inter-account transfers with automatic currency conversion
- Recurring transactions posted automatically in the background
- Budget management with progress tracking
- Categories and tags for transactions
- Financial reports and analytics
- External URL for remote transaction entry
- CSV/JSON import and export, with automatic duplicate detection and rule-based auto-categorization on CSV import
- Dashboard preview of upcoming recurring transactions due
- Full backup & restore options
- An optional PIN lock with session timeout and lockout, layered on top of your Nextcloud login
- All data stored securely in your Nextcloud database
- Clients:
  - Installable Progressive Web App (PWA) for desktop and mobile devices
  - Android app currently available in beta testing
  - Responsive web interface optimized for all screen sizes
- Support development via PayPal or Ko-fi (see Settings → About FinTrack)

**What's new:**
- Foreign-currency transactions stay correct when you change your base currency
- Budget alerts: a Nextcloud notification at 80% and 100% of a budget; quarterly and foreign-currency budgets now count correctly
- A notice explains what changes (and how to fix old exchange rates via CSV) when you change your base currency
- Full changelog shown once after each update, and in Settings → About
- Report an Issue asks for confirmation and reminds you to attach logs
- Weekly automatic backups to your Files (you choose how many to keep), plus a backup before every update
- CSV export and import carry the currency and exchange-rate columns; simpler mobile app sign-in; base-currency guidance
- Compatible with Nextcloud 32 to 34

fit_tracker.description:
FIT Tracker is a Nextcloud app for tracking your fitness activities and sleep — powered by Garmin .fit files stored in your Nextcloud filesystem.

Simply point the app at a folder containing your exported .fit files and it will automatically import and parse them.

🏃 **Activity tracking**
Recognizes the full Garmin FIT sport list — Running, Cycling, Hiking, Walking, Swimming, Gym, Breathwork, Meditation, Skiing, and dozens more (sailing, golf, rowing, kayaking, tennis, climbing, and others). Each activity shows distance, duration, average heart rate, and calories. The detail view includes an interactive map with GPS route, charts for heart rate, elevation, power and pace or speed, a per-lap breakdown, and a Share button that generates a shareable image card. Activities can be re-imported from their file or deleted, which moves the .fit file to the Nextcloud trash. The dashboard shows a monthly activity calendar and a last-7-days bar chart, with sidebar navigation limited to the sport types you actually have data for.

😴 **Sleep tracking**
Automatically detects Garmin sleep and nap files and separates them from activity files. View all sleep sessions with a monthly stacked bar chart (Deep / REM / Light / Awake), navigable month by month. Each sleep detail page shows total duration, sleep score, HRV score, a full sleep timeline with stage transitions, and a per-stage table.

📷 **Photo integration**
For any activity with a GPS track, FIT Tracker automatically finds JPEG photos stored in your Nextcloud whose GPS coordinates fall within 200 m of the activity route. Photos appear as a thumbnail strip below the map and as clickable pins on the route map. Clicking a photo opens it in a viewer with previous/next navigation. Only GPS-tagged photos are shown.

⚙️ **Settings**
Choose any folder in your Nextcloud as the source for .fit files. New files are imported automatically every time the app is opened, or on demand with "Sync now". A "Re-check sport types" button lets you reclassify already-imported activities under the current sport detection logic, including moving mis-imported sleep/nap files over to Sleep, and "Re-import all files" reads every file again from scratch.

flow_notifications.description:
Enable users to configure notifications with customized conditions in their Flow configuration.

Users are empowered to configure a "Send a notification" Flow in their personal settings. They can choose between the events being triggered, and other conditions like filetypes, assigned tags, time ranges and more. They can specify an inscription so that when the notification appears they will have context.

To use the `Flow Notifications` app, ensure that the `Notifications` app is installed and enabled. The `Notifications` app provides the necessary APIs for the `Flow Notifications` app to work correctly.

![Notification Flow Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextcloud/flow_notifications/master/screenshots/configuration.png)

When an event happens where all conditions are apply, the user will receive a regular Nextcloud notification.

![Flow Notification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextcloud/flow_notifications/master/screenshots/notification.png)

flowline.description: FlowLINE brings your remote support workspace into Nextcloud. Link your FlowLINE account, see your machines and sessions, invite a computer and receive notifications — without leaving your Nextcloud. Requires a FlowLINE account and connects only to the FlowLINE API you configure.

folder_protection.description:
Stop the folders that matter from being moved, copied or deleted by accident.

Moving or deleting a folder with hundreds of gigabytes can keep a Nextcloud server busy for hours, and one wrong drag in the desktop client is enough to start it. Folder Protection lets administrators mark the folders that must stay where they are.

## What protection does

- **A protected folder can't be deleted, moved or copied**, whether from the web interface, the desktop and mobile clients or plain WebDAV. Its parent folders can't be deleted either, since that would take it along.
- **Work inside it carries on as usual.** Users can still create folders, add and edit files, and rename things inside a protected folder.
- **The desktop client plays along.** Protected folders are reported without the delete permission, so the client never tries to delete them, and a blocked move shows up as a clear error in its sync activity.
- **Users can see it.** Protected folders get a lock icon in the Files list, the actions that would fail are hidden, and a blocked attempt sends the user a notification explaining why.

## Managing protections

- **Admin page** (Administration settings → Folder Protection) with a folder tree picker: protect several folders at once and record why each one is protected.
- **Team folders**: protect any Team folder (Group Folders app) from the admin page, without being a member of it.
- **External storage**: folders on SMB, S3, WebDAV or local mounts are supported.
- **Dashboard widget** listing every protected folder with its size and reason.
- **occ commands** to protect, unprotect, list and check folders from scripts.

Protection is checked at two layers (WebDAV and storage). A distributed cache (Redis or Memcached) is recommended: without it, protections added with occ can take up to five minutes to apply.

Available in English, Portuguese, German, Spanish and French.

folder_retention.description:
**Retention periods attached to folders: expired files go to the trash bin, automatically.**
Admins attach a retention period ("delete after 2 weeks", "never delete") to
folders — personal folders, folders of shared work accounts and Team folders
(groupfolders). Subfolders inherit the rule or carry their own exceptions. A
daily background job looks at every file in its current location and moves
expired files to the trash bin.

### Safe by default
- **Simulation mode is on after installation.** Expired files are only logged;
  nothing is deleted until an admin switches simulation off (with password
  confirmation).
- **Both default rules start with "never delete".** Files are only deleted once
  a period has been set on purpose.
- **Trash bin only, never a permanent delete.** After each deletion the app
  checks that the file has arrived in the trash bin. If it cannot verify the
  trash entry, it logs the file as permanently deleted and blocks that area:
  nothing is deleted there again until an admin has looked into it.
- **Real deletion only with system cron or occ.** With the AJAX or Webcron
  background job modes the app neither deletes nor simulates and says so on
  its settings page; `occ folder_retention:run` keeps working.
- Location, rule and date are checked again right before each deletion; a file
  that was moved or changed in the meantime stays.

### How the date is counted
By default a period counts from the moment the file **arrived in Nextcloud**
(uploaded, or first seen by the app) — not from the creation date a sync client
sends along, which could lie years back. Alternatively it counts from the last
modification. A file restored from the trash bin starts a new period.

### Also included
- Folder tree with the rule that applies to each folder, preview of the
  affected files, a log by day and folder with CSV export
- The deletion date in the Files app: next to the file name ("Oct 29", "in 3
  days") and in a sidebar tab with the rule and where it is set
- Optional system tags such as "Retention: 2 weeks" on files and folders — for
  information only, they do not control anything; in a shipped language or
  neutral ("⌛ 2 w")
- occ commands for a run (also as a dry run) and for the tags

### How it differs from "Retention" (files_retention)
Nextcloud's own Retention app deletes files by collaborative tags and Flow
rules. Folder Retention attaches the periods to folders instead and checks
that every file arrives in the trash bin. Do not let both delete on the same
instance.

### Requirements
Nextcloud 34 or 35, the "Deleted files" app (files_trashbin) and system cron.
Team folders are supported but not required. External storages are not
evaluated.

### How this app was built
Folder Retention is vibe-coded: its code, tests, documentation and German
translation were written by AI coding agents (Anthropic's Claude Code); the
maintainer set the goals, made the product decisions and tested the app. There
has been no independent human code review and no security audit, so please
evaluate the app yourself before relying on it, and keep simulation mode on
until the log shows what you expect. Details in the
[README](https://github.com/hotochan123/nextcloud-folder-retention#how-this-app-was-built-ai-disclosure).

forms.description:
**Simple surveys and questionnaires, self-hosted!**

- **📝 Simple design:** No mass of options, only the essentials. Works well on mobile of course.
- **📊 View & export results:** Results are visualized and can also be exported as CSV in the same format used by Google Forms.
- **🔒 Data under your control!** Unlike in Google Forms, Typeform, Doodle and others, the survey info and responses are kept private on your instance.
- **🧑‍💻 Connect to your software:** Easily integrate Forms into your service with our full-fledged [REST-API](https://github.com/nextcloud/forms/blob/main/docs/API_v3.md).
- **🙋 Get involved!** We have lots of stuff planned like more question types, collaboration on forms, [and much more](https://github.com/nextcloud/forms/milestones)!

forms_deck.description:
**Turn form submissions into Deck cards.**

When someone submits a Nextcloud Form, this app creates a card in a Deck board/list you choose, with
the answers in the card description. Each user configures their own mappings in
**Settings → Personal → Forms → Deck**, so the card is created as *that* user and the normal Deck
and Forms permissions apply.

- One mapping = one form → one board + list. Compose the card title from the submission date and
  any question answers (e.g. `28/9/26 - Laptop - Printer not working`).
- **Route a single form to different boards**: add one mapping per board and set each mapping to run
  only when a choice question has a chosen answer (e.g. "Issue type" is *Hardware* → the Hardware
  board, *Software* → the Software board). A mapping without a condition always runs.
- Add the form answers as the board's existing Deck tags.
- Optionally attach the files uploaded through a file question to the card.
- Works for logged-in submissions and for public (anonymous) form links.
- Editing or re-submitting a submission does not create a second card.
- If the configured user loses access to the form or the board, the mapping disables itself and
  records the reason, and the submission still succeeds.

**Requirements:** the **Forms** and **Deck** apps must be installed and enabled. If either is
missing, this app stays inert (the pickers show empty lists).

**Privacy note:** the answers are copied onto the Deck board, so everybody with access to that
board can read the form answers.

formulabase.description:
FormulaBase is a lightweight personal calculator for the formulas you use again and again — markups, unit conversions, loan payments, mixing ratios, engineering constants, anything.

Organise your formulas into collections, define each formula's variables once, then open it any time, type in numbers, and read the result live. The math runs entirely in your browser (no eval, no server round-trip).

Features:
- 5,522 built-in formula templates in 13 fields (mathematics, statistics and probability, AI and computing, physics, chemistry and materials, engineering, personal money, investing, business and accounting, health and life sciences, everyday life, and more) — searchable, and ready to drop into your own collections
- Template settings: hide whole fields, subcategories or single templates you do not need
- Collections of reusable formulas
- Named variables with labels, units and default values — numbers, lists, matrices or complex numbers
- Safe expression engine with more than 200 functions: arithmetic, conditions (if, piecewise), sums, products, integrals, derivatives and equation solving, statistics, cash flows, matrices, number theory, special functions, probability distributions and physical constants
- Live result as you type, with unit and decimal-place control
- Version history per formula — the version before each edit is kept beside it, numbered and restorable, separate from the calculation history
- Share a collection with other Nextcloud users at three levels (view / edit / delete)
- An AI assistant, through the AI-Hub app: a chat beside the formulas that knows FormulaBase and how its expressions are written, answers in words and writes a formula out as text you can type in, and reads the open collection only as the administrator allows. Without AI-Hub it is simply not shown
- Same clean, themable design as RegiBase (light / dark)

The 2,400 templates added in 0.7.0 were each checked against an independent calculation. Since 0.8.0 the whole library and every screen are translated into 13 languages — English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Arabic, Hindi and Korean. The older part of the library (3,122 formulas) has not all been hand-verified. If you spot a wrong formula, bad default, mistranslation, or missing unit, please open an issue on GitHub — reports are welcome.

formvox.description:
FormVox is a file-based forms and polls app for Nextcloud. Unlike traditional form apps, FormVox stores everything in .fvform files — no database tables needed.

**Features:**
* 100% file-based storage (.fvform files)
* Question types: text, textarea, single/multiple choice, dropdown, date, time, number, scale, rating, file upload, matrix, table
* Conditional logic and page routing
* Quiz mode with scoring
* Export to CSV, JSON, and ODT (with custom template support)
* Import from Microsoft Forms
* Per-form branding with visual page builder
* Answer piping (use previous answers in later questions)
* Charts and visualizations in Results view
* Webhooks and REST API for integrations
* Collaborative editing with real-time presence indicators
* Notifications on new responses
* Password protection and expiration for public links
* Multi-language: English, Dutch, German, French

**Unique Benefits:**
* One file contains everything (definition + responses)
* Works with Nextcloud's versioning and sharing
* End-to-end encryption compatible
* No database migrations needed

**Perfect for:**
* Surveys and feedback forms
* Quizzes and assessments
* Event registrations
* Expense declarations
* Data collection with privacy requirements

forum.description:
Create discussions, share ideas, and collaborate with your community directly in Nextcloud.

**Key features:**
- **Threaded Discussions** - Create and reply to organized discussion threads with pagination
- **Category Organization** - Structure your forum with customizable categories, headers, colors, and drag-and-drop reordering
- **Rich Text Formatting** - BBCode formatting with built-in and custom tags, toolbar with overflow menu
- **File Attachments** - Attach files from your Nextcloud storage or upload via drag-and-drop
- **Notifications** - Subscribe to threads and get notified on replies and @mentions
- **Post Reactions** - React to posts with emoji reactions
- **Read/Unread Tracking** - Track unread posts at thread and category level
- **Thread Summaries** - Summarize a thread or its unread replies with the AI provider configured in Nextcloud
- **Bookmarks** - Save threads for quick access
- **Search** - Advanced search with boolean operators and category filtering
- **User Profiles** - View post history, statistics, and role badges
- **Roles and Teams** - Fine-grained permissions per role or Nextcloud Team, per category
- **Guest Access** - Optional public access for unauthenticated visitors with configurable permissions
- **Edit History** - View post revision history with configurable visibility and per-account privacy controls
- **Reusable Templates** - Save and insert frequently used content snippets
- **Signatures** - BBCode-formatted signatures on posts
- **Thread Drafts** - Auto-saved drafts per category
- **Dashboard Widgets** - Recent activity, top threads, and top categories on the Nextcloud dashboard
- **Direct Post Links** - Link directly to a specific post within a thread
- **Moderation Tools** - Pin, lock, hide, and move threads; review and restore deleted content
- **Management Tools** - Manage categories, roles, BBCodes, and forum settings with granular permissions
- **Server Administration** - Repair seeds, rebuild statistics, and assign roles from the Nextcloud admin panel

**Perfect for:**
- Team discussions and collaboration
- Community forums
- Support channels
- Knowledge bases
- Project discussions
- Internal communication

The forum integrates seamlessly with your Nextcloud instance, using your existing accounts and teams for authentication and access control.

frontend_insight.description:
🔍 **Capture and analyze JavaScript errors from your users' browsers in real-time!**

FrontendInsight gives you **visibility into frontend issues that would otherwise go unnoticed**.

✨ **Key Features:**
• 🐛 Automatic tracking of client-side errors and unhandled promise rejections
• 📊 Browse events with advanced filtering and sorting
• ⏰ Configurable data retention policies with automatic cleanup
• 👥 Restrict reported events browsing to specific user groups
• 🛡️ Built-in rate limiting to prevent abuse
• 🚀 Modern UI built with Svelte 5

**Identify and fix frontend bugs before they impact your users' experience!**

fulltextsearch.description: Core App of the full-text search framework for your Nextcloud.

fulltextsearch_elasticsearch.description: Extension to the _Full text search_ app to communicate with ElasticSearch.

fulltextsearch_postgresql.description:
Full text search for Nextcloud without a search server: the index lives in the PostgreSQL
database your Nextcloud already uses.

PostgreSQL uses less memory and disk space, without sacrificing response time or search
quality.

- Indexing follows the language and folds accents, so "numerisation" finds "numérisation". The
  app takes the language of your instance, and can combine several.
- The app reads PDF and office files itself (docx, xlsx, pptx, odt, ods, odp), with no
  extraction service.
- Permissions are indexed with the content, so a search only returns documents the person
  running it can open.

Requires the Full text search app (fulltextsearch) and a content provider, usually the one for
files (files_fulltextsearch). The unaccent and pg_trgm extensions install themselves when the
database privileges allow; otherwise search stays accent-sensitive until an administrator
creates them.

fulltextsearch_sql.description:
Makes the _Full text search_ app work without any additional services.

It uses the Nextcloud MySQL or PostgreSQL database backend as search provider.

Currently can not index office document formats, but does work with PDFs (if they contain text/have been OCR'ed).

**Warning:** This app will store all indexed content in your Nextcloud database *twice* (roughly) - once as plain text and once as searchable index. This means that your database can easily grow hundreds of megabytes or even gigabytes in size if you have much indexable content (e.g. documents).

geoblocker.description:
This is a front end to geo localization services, that allows blocking (beta), delaying (beta) and logging of login attempts from specified countries.
Login attempts from local network IP addresses are never blocked, delayed or logged.
In the current implementation the login page is normally shown to everybody independent of the country. Also login attempts with a non existing user are failing as usual independent of the country.
Wrong Nextcloud configuration (especially in container) can lead to all access seems to come from local network IP address.
Determination of the country from IP address is only as good as the chosen service.

Countries can be specified using allowlisting or blocklisting.

Currently available localization services are:
- Geoiplookup (local programm on the host)
- MaxMind GeoLite2 (local database accessed via PHP API)
- Data from Regional Internet Registries (Nextcloud SQL database build up with data downloaded from the RIRs FTP servers)

For help how to set up the localization services please have a look at the GitHub repository (homepage on the right side).

gestion.description:
# Run your business with Gestion
Gestion is a Nextcloud application designed to make invoicing simple, secure, and efficient for freelancers, micro-enterprises, and small businesses.

Key Features:
* Add and manage customer profiles
* Create and customize product entries
* Generate professional quotes and invoices in PDF format
* Generate electronic invoices in the Factur-X format
* Send PDFs directly by email from the application
* Store generated documents securely within your Nextcloud instance
* Track your business activities more efficiently

✨ Electronic invoicing is supported in France. Gestion can generate Factur-X invoices that combine a human-readable PDF with structured electronic invoice data.

Factur-X files can always be generated and downloaded without using an external platform. Each company can also select and configure a compatible approved electronic invoicing platform.

The PDF generation system has also been redesigned to improve document layout, styling, and compatibility.

Gestion integrates seamlessly with the Nextcloud ecosystem and keeps your business data under your control.

If you require adaptations to comply with your country's regulations, please open an issue on the GitHub repository.

gpxpod.description:
# GpxPod Nextcloud application

Display, analyse, compare and share GPS track files.

🌍 Help us to translate this app on [GpxPod Crowdin project](https://crowdin.com/project/gpxpod).

GpxPod:

* 🗺 can display your gpx/kml/tcx/igc/fit files
* 📏 supports metric, english and nautical measure systems
* 🗠 draws interactive chart for elevation, speed, pace or any extension data
* 🗠 use line gradient color for track lines with speed, elevation, pace or any extension data
* 🗠 shows track statistics
* 🖻 displays geotagged pictures
* 🖧 generates public links pointing to a track/folder
* 🗠 can correct tracks elevations using SRTM data
* ⚖ can make global comparison of multiple tracks
* ⚖ can make visual pair comparison of divergent parts of similar tracks
* 🀆 allows users to add personal map tile servers
* 🖍 allows user to manually choose line color for each track
* 🔒 works with encrypted data folder (server side encryption)

Link to Nextcloud application website : https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/gpxpod

grafana_sync.description:
Grafana Sync turns a Nextcloud folder into a live mirror of a Grafana folder.

Map a Grafana **folder** to a Nextcloud folder and everything inside it shows up: subfolders become folders, dashboards become real `.grafana` files with the Grafana icon. Click one and the live dashboard opens in Grafana.

Nothing is matched on filename. Every file carries its dashboard's uid, so renaming, moving, copying, trashing and restoring never break the link — and re-running a sync never duplicates anything.

## ✨ What you can do

- 📊 **Edit a dashboard as a file** — save it in the Files app, over WebDAV or from the desktop client, and Grafana has it
- 🗂️ **Keep the whole tree** — Grafana has real nested folders, and both sides mirror each other at any depth
- 🚚 **Move** a dashboard between folders or between mappings — same dashboard, same uid, same URL
- 🍝 **Copy** one, and get a real new dashboard in Grafana
- 🗑️ **Trash, restore and purge**, with an optional Grafana recycle bin that preserves ids
- 🏷️ **Tag** a dashboard on either side — the file, the JSON and Grafana all carry one set
- ➕ **Create** a dashboard from the Files app's **+ New** menu
- 🖱️ **Open in Grafana**, or open the JSON in a text editor
- ⌨️ **Script all of it** — every admin action has an `occ` command

## 🗂️ Real folders, all the way down

Grafana has real, nested folders, so there is no tagging scheme to maintain and no flat namespace to fake. The mapping is a plain folder-to-folder mirror and the whole tree comes with it, in both directions.

Move a folder and every dashboard under it is re-parented in one gesture, uids intact — not deleted and re-created to get there. Rename it on either side and the other follows, because the link is the folder's uid rather than its name. A folder holding no dashboards stays an ordinary folder, however much else is in it.

## 🗑️ A recycle bin Grafana never had

Grafana has no trash. Delete a dashboard there and it is gone; delete a folder and it takes everything under it, in one request, with nothing to undo it.

So this app adds one. Name any ordinary Grafana folder as the recycle bin, and trashing a dashboard file **parks** its dashboard there instead of deleting it — id, URL and history kept. Restore the file and it comes straight back out. Only emptying the Nextcloud trash makes it permanent.

That turns an irreversible cascade into a move. It works from the Grafana side too: purge the parked dashboards there and the trashed file follows them; drag them back out and the trashed folder returns, uids intact.

## 🧭 Sync or Link — the folder decides

| Mode | The file holds | Pushes back? |
|---|---|---|
| **Sync** | The full dashboard JSON | Yes — fully bidirectional |
| **Link** | A pointer (uid, title, URL) | No — clicking it opens Grafana |

**Link** is for dashboards somebody else owns — provisioned by an operator, managed in Git, generated by a chart. Nextcloud treats them as read-only and a DAV guard stops anything overwriting the pointer.

A **sync** mapping is therefore also a real backup: every dashboard in the folder, complete and versioned by Nextcloud.

## 🎨 Honest icons, honest dates

Dashboards register their own mimetype, so they wear the real Grafana icon instead of a generic braces glyph. And each file carries **the dashboard's** created and modified dates rather than the sync's — so Recent, sorting and search all tell you the truth about your work.

📖 **[Full documentation and the `occ` reference on GitHub](https://github.com/kubed-io/nextcloud-grafana#readme)**

Requires a Grafana service-account token with access to the folders you map. This app is in early development: it works end to end and is covered by tests against a real Grafana, but has not yet been run widely.

---

This is a community integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Grafana Labs. "Grafana" and the Grafana logo are trademarks of Grafana Labs, used here only to identify the service this app integrates with.

grimoire.description:
Grimoire is a virtual tabletop (VTT) built into Nextcloud. Run campaigns and
live sessions with shared 2D battlemaps and a physics-driven 3D mode where you
can load glTF character models and build maps in three dimensions.

## Features

- Campaigns and scenes, stored in your own Nextcloud
- 2D mode: maps, tokens, drawings, fog of war, grid (square/hex)
- 3D mode: glTF/GLB models, 3D map building, orbit camera
- Physics 3D dice (d4–d20) with real settle-and-read results
- 2D dice viewport: roll physics dice without leaving the battlemap
- Tools: pointer, grab, measurement, area-of-effect, draw, fog, build
- Token health system with DM-controlled HP bars
- Player permissions (per-layer create/update/delete, owner-only tokens)
- Real-time multiplayer rooms (signed room tokens + polling fallback)
- Addon/extension system with a sandboxed GRIM SDK
- Asset library backed by Nextcloud Files

group_default_quota.description: Allow setting the default quota for users based on their group membership.

group_manager.description:
Group Manager gives administrators a single screen to browse groups (local and LDAP), manage
local group membership in bulk, and — when Team Folders is installed — create or assign group
folders and their per-group permissions and quota, without leaving Settings.

- Browse local and LDAP/AD groups side by side, searchable, with LDAP groups grouped separately.
- Add people, a whole group at once, or a pasted list to a local group; queue several changes as
  colored chips and apply them in one batch that never aborts over a single failed row.
- Make members group admins (Nextcloud subadmins) right from the member list, in the same
  queued batch.
- Create a new group folder or assign an existing one to a group, edit Write/Share/Delete
  permissions and the folder's quota, and see a badge when a folder has advanced permissions
  (ACL) enabled — works for LDAP groups too.
- When the Group Quota app is installed, view and set a group's shared storage limit, with a
  warning for members who belong to several groups that have a quota.
- LDAP group membership stays read-only, as the directory is the source of truth; everything else,
  group admins included, works the same as for a local group.

groupfolders.description:
Team Folders (formerly "Group Folders") allows administrators to create and manage shared
folders for selected teams within Nextcloud.

Admins can grant one or more teams access to a folder, configure permissions (such as read,
write, and sharing rights), and assign storage quotas from the Team Folders section (under
admin settings). The app also supports advanced permissions and integration with Nextcloud’s
trash and versioning systems.

As of Hub 10 / Nextcloud 31, admins must be members of a team to assign that team to a Team
Folder.

groupquota.description:
Allow setting a disk quota for an entire group.

Note: configuring quota is only possible trough the API, no admin interface is currently available.

guests.description:
👥 Allows for better collaboration with external users by allowing users to create guests account.

Guests accounts can be created from the share menu by entering either the recipients email or name and choosing "create guest account", once the share is created the guest user will receive an email notification about the mail with a link to set their password.

Guests users can only access files shared to them and cannot create any files outside of shares, additionally, the apps accessible to guest accounts are whitelisted.

hc_shared_app_core.description:
# HC Shared App Core

**A shared runtime foundation for Nextcloud applications.**

HC Shared App Core provides reusable user interface components and services for developers building applications on Nextcloud 35. It helps dependent apps share a consistent foundation instead of implementing the same features separately.

## Included services

- **User interface:** layouts, workspaces, dialogs, forms, toolbars, pickers, notifications and settings.
- **Content editing:** reusable Markdown editor components.
- **Maps and lists:** map services, places, hierarchical lists and sharing helpers.
- **App infrastructure:** events, application backgrounds, version compatibility checks and optimistic-concurrency helpers.
- **Developer resources:** public API documentation and a reference application.

## Who should install it?

This is a **dependency for other Nextcloud apps**, not a standalone app with its own workspace. Install or enable it when a compatible application requires HC Shared App Core.

Each consuming application remains responsible for its own business logic, access control, data storage and server-side authorization.

## Applications built on Core

The following Hacesoft applications already exist and use HC Shared App Core. They are **not yet published in the Nextcloud App Store**; public releases will be added gradually after preparation and testing.

- **[GridSight](https://github.com/hacesoft/GridSight)** — source repository on GitHub; not yet in the App Store.
- **[Sticky Notes (Žluté lístečky)](https://github.com/hacesoft/nextcloud-stickynotes)** — source repository on GitHub; not yet in the App Store.
- **Weather (Počasí)** — development version exists; public repository updates are being prepared.
- **Places and Navigation (Navigace)** — development version exists; public repository updates are being prepared.
- **Wiki** — currently developed locally, without a public repository.
- **Family Tree (Rodokmen)** — existing project; no public repository link confirmed yet.

**Developer example:** [HC Shared App Core Playground](https://github.com/hacesoft/Playground) is a separate demonstration/reference project, intended for GitHub, **not for publication in the Nextcloud App Store**. The source package also includes a minimal example under `build/examples/empty-app/`.

## Compatibility

- **Nextcloud:** version 35.
- **PHP:** version 8.2 or later (subject to Nextcloud compatibility).

Support for other Nextcloud major versions must be tested and declared separately.

## Documentation

- [Installation and updates](https://github.com/hacesoft/core/blob/main/docs/en/INSTALLATION.md)
- [Developer guide](https://github.com/hacesoft/core/blob/main/docs/en/DEVELOPMENT.md)
- [Public API and services](https://github.com/hacesoft/core/blob/main/docs/en/SERVICES.md)
- [Czech documentation](https://github.com/hacesoft/core/blob/main/docs/cz/README.md)

**Source code:** https://github.com/hacesoft/core

**Issues:** https://github.com/hacesoft/core/issues

health.description:
Health helps users track personal health and wellbeing in everyday life and at work. The app provides a configurable journal for metrics and habits such as stress, energy, mood, hydration, breaks, movement, sleep, weight, and more.

Users choose what they want to track and whether they want reminders. Quick entries, check-ins, and check-outs keep daily use simple, while daily, weekly, and monthly views and statistics show trends and goal progress without medical diagnoses or automated health assessments.

For even faster mobile entry, Health includes an installable PWA with an offline-first quick-entry interface. It lets users record enabled metrics with large touch-friendly controls and sync changes back to Nextcloud when a connection is available.

hidden_groups.description:
Some groups are only meant for configuration, such as enabling an app for everyone, and are far too large to share with.

Admins can hide such groups in the sharing settings. Nobody can share files or folders with a hidden group, and hidden groups do not show up in sharing suggestions. Existing shares with a hidden group keep working, but cannot get more permissions.

hidesidebars.description:
# Hide sidebars

Hide left sidebar and top header bar for use in iframe for example or some other scenarios.

## Usage
Add `hide-sidebars` after `?` as query parameter to nextcloud url or with `dir` parameter after `&`.

Examples:
```
http://nextcloud.example.com/index.php/apps/files/?hide-sidebars
http://nextcloud.example.com/index.php/apps/files/?dir=/New%20folder&hide-sidebars
```

This app from version 2.0.0 brings new config parameter `addAllowedFrameAncestorDomain` to allow embedding into a website.
Simply add the following line to your `config/config.php`:

```
...
'addAllowedFrameAncestorDomain' => '*.example.com:*'
...
```

For Nextcloud All-in-One (AIO) set it with `occ` on the host:


# HomeCheck — personal app home

Arrange the Nextcloud apps you can open as Dashboard-style panes with folders. Reordering saves to your personal layout and updates the top-bar app order (folders stay in HomeCheck only). Hide apps you do not need and restore them anytime.

**Free AGPL web app.** Optional admin seed template for first-time users; every user can fully customise afterwards.

## Highlights

- Dashboard-style panes with folders
- Drag to rearrange; sync order to the top bar
- Hide / restore apps from your home
- Optional start-page CTA and admin seed layout
- Theme-aware chrome with accessible controls

## Feedback welcome

We improve this app with real-world use. Bug reports, rough edges, and ideas help — open a GitHub Issue (https://github.com/aSoftwareByDesignRepository/nextcloud-homecheck/issues) or write to info@software-by-design.de. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

**🔲 iFrame Widget for Nextcloud Dashboard**

This app adds customizable iFrame widgets to your Nextcloud dashboard, allowing you to embed external websites directly within Nextcloud.

## ✨ Features

- **Embed any website** directly in your Nextcloud dashboard
- **Customize appearance** with custom titles and icons
- **SimpleIcons integration** using the `si:` prefix for thousands of brand icons
- **Colorize icons** with a built-in color picker
- **Adjustable height** for perfect layout integration
- **Responsive design** with extra-wide display option (2 columns)
- **Personal widgets** for individual user customization
- **Group-based widgets** for targeted content delivery
- **Admin controls** for global and group-specific configurations
- **Multiple widget slots** up to 5 public and 5 group widgets
- **Iframe security controls** with sandbox and allow attribute customization

## 🛠️ Configuration

The widget supports three types of configurations:

### 🌍 Global/Public Widgets (5 slots)
Set up widgets that appear on all users' dashboards.

### 👤 Personal Widgets (1 per user)
Allow each user to create their own personalized widgets.

### 👥 Group Widgets (5 slots per group)
Create widgets that are only visible to specific user groups.

## 🔒 CSP Configuration

If you encounter Content Security Policy errors, this app now adjusts CSP via the Nextcloud PHP CSP API based on the configured widget URLs. Avoid adding a second CSP header at the web server level, as browsers apply the strictest policy. See the full documentation on GitHub for details.

## 💻 Compatibility
- Nextcloud 33–35

impersonate.description:
By installing the impersonate app of your Nextcloud you enable administrators to impersonate other users on the Nextcloud server. This is especially useful for debugging issues reported by users.

To impersonate a user an administrator has to simply follow the following four steps:

1. Login as administrator to Nextcloud.
2. Open users administration interface.
3. Select the impersonate button on the affected user.
4. Confirm the impersonation.

The administrator is then logged-in as the user, to switch back to the regular user account they simply have to press the logout button.

**Note:**

- This app is not compatible with instances that have encryption enabled.
- While impersonate actions are logged note that actions performed impersonated will be logged as the impersonated user.
- Impersonating a user is only possible after their first login.
- You can limit which users/groups can use impersonation in Administration settings > Additional settings.
