integration_forgejo_gitea.description:
Bring the parts of Forgejo or Gitea that people actually check ten times a day into the Nextcloud dashboard. Signs in once with OAuth 2.0 authorization-code grant against your Forgejo or Gitea instance and then keeps the two systems talking in the background.

## Dashboard widgets

Eleven widgets, grouped by intent so the dashboard reads like your day rather than a list of API endpoints.

**Overview.** Six KPI tiles in a compact grid — open issues assigned, open issues you opened, open PRs where your review is requested, open PRs you opened, open issues mentioning you, contributions in the last 7 days. Each tile links to the equivalent Forgejo dashboard filter.

**Work queue.** Open Issues, Closed Issues, Open PRs, Closed PRs and Reviews. Each carries a per-widget repository picker (searchable multi-select), a filter (assigned / created / mentioning / all), and a refresh-frequency setting. Rows show number, title, assignee avatar, up to three colour-matched label chips, repo full-name and relative timestamp. A "Show all" link at the bottom of each widget lands on the equivalent Forgejo filter page.

**Activity.** Commits (latest commits across your selected repos, with an optional "only mine" toggle) and a GitHub-style contribution Heatmap (last 3 or 6 months, user-selectable) plus a stats grid showing total, this week, this month, current streak, longest streak, best day.

**Repositories.** Milestones (open milestones with progress bars across selected repos) and Repo stats (compact per-repo card showing stars, forks, open issues, open PRs, latest release tag).

**Notifications.** Unread Forgejo/Gitea notifications inbox with type icons (issue / PR / commit / repository) and a per-row mark-as-read action.

## Auto-refresh

All eleven widgets poll in the background at a user-selected cadence (Never / 30s / 1m / 5m default / 15m / 30m / 1h), pause while the browser tab is hidden, and re-fetch once when the tab regains focus. An idle dashboard tab left open in the background does not hammer your Forgejo.

## Brand-aware UX

Admin picks the instance type (Forgejo or Gitea). Every widget's icon and title switch to match — Forgejo orange horn (CC-BY-SA-4.0, Caesar Schinas), Gitea green tea-cup (CC-BY-4.0) — so a Nextcloud instance connected to Forgejo reads as *Forgejo: Open Issues*, a Gitea one reads *Gitea: Open Issues*.

## Security

OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow (RFC 6749) is the only connect path. 32-byte session-bound `state` parameter, verified with `hash_equals()`. Access and refresh tokens encrypted at rest via Nextcloud's `ICrypto`. Bearer tokens redacted from log messages. Generic error responses to the browser; upstream detail stays in the server log. Instance URL validated on admin write. Full OWASP Top 10 mapping in `SECURITY.md` in the repository.

## Requirements

Any recent Forgejo (v1.x, all v7+) or Gitea (v1.19+) instance with an OAuth application registered. PHP 8.1+, Nextcloud 30-34.

integration_inspect360.description:
Nextcloud integration app for Njordium Inspect360.

## Dashboard widgets

- **Overview** — four KPI tiles: Approved Vendors, Total Vendors, Pending Review, Total Services. Powered by a single call to /api/v1/suppliers/stats plus a lightweight products count.
- **Approved Vendors** — list of suppliers with status "approved", with country, org number, and regulatory flag chips (Critical, ICT, Data Processor, AML) at a glance.
- **Added Vendors** — recently added suppliers, sorted by created-at descending.
- **Assessed** — recent vendor assessments with status, current stage, and colour-coded risk level (low/medium/high/critical).

Each widget carries a per-user refresh cadence (Never / 30s / 1m / 5m default / 15m / 30m / 1h), pauses polling while the browser tab is hidden, and re-fetches on wake so an idle dashboard tab doesn't hammer the API.

## Authentication

Sign in with your Inspect360 account from Personal Settings → Connected accounts. The app stores only the returned refresh token (encrypted via Nextcloud's ICrypto) and mints short-lived access tokens on demand for every API call.

Only Inspect360 accounts without multi-factor authentication are supported in this release — accounts with MFA enforced or MFA-enrolment-required will see a targeted "not supported yet" message. Fuller MFA support arrives in a subsequent release.

integration_itop.description:
### 🚀 Complete iTop ITSM Integration for Nextcloud

Seamlessly connect your Nextcloud collaboration platform with iTop IT Service Management system. This comprehensive integration brings ITSM functionality directly into your daily workflow without leaving Nextcloud.
**⚠️ Requires iTop server with REST API enabled**

### ✨ Key Features

#### 📊 Dual Dashboard Widgets
- **Portal Widget**: Personal ticket queue for all users with status breakdown (Open, Pending, Resolved)
  - View 4 most recent tickets (Incidents + User Requests)
  - Visual status indicators and priority badges
  - Responsive design for mobile/desktop
- **Agent Widget**: Comprehensive operational dashboard for IT agents only
  - **My Work**: Assigned incidents and requests with real-time counts
  - **Team Queue**: Team-wide ticket distribution and workload overview
  - **Change Management**: Upcoming changes with time windows and types
  - Automatic visibility control based on user profile (agents vs portal users)

#### 🔗 Dynamic Reference Provider
- **Rich Link Previews**: Paste iTop ticket links in Talk, Deck, or Collectives for instant rich previews
- **Detailed Information**: View ticket status, priority, assignee, and description at a glance
- **Smart Navigation**: Direct links to full ticket details in iTop
- **Universal Compatibility**: Works across all Nextcloud apps that support rich content

#### 🔍 Unified Search Integration
- **Quick Access**: Search your iTop tickets directly from Nextcloud's search bar
- **Smart Results**: Filter by ticket type (Incidents, User Requests) with status indicators
- **CI Browsing**: Search Configuration Items (computers, phones, printers, software, and more)
- **Custom CI Classes**: Extensible search support for any CI class defined in your iTop CMDB
- **Personal Scope**: Only shows tickets you created or are assigned to
- **Real-time Status**: Live priority and status badges in search results

#### 🎯 Smart Picker & Content Integration
- **Content Creation**: Insert iTop references while writing in Text App or chatting in Talk
- **Quick Browse**: Access recent tickets and CIs with smart suggestions
- **Rich Insertion**: Add links that automatically become interactive previews
- **Context Aware**: Relevant suggestions based on your current work

#### 🔔 Notification System (v1.3.0+)
- **Portal Notifications**: Stay informed about your tickets - status changes, agent responses, resolutions
- **Agent Notifications**: Get alerted about assignments, team queue updates, reassignments, and SLA warnings
- **12 Notification Types**: Granular control with per-type enable/disable for portal and agent notifications
- **Mandatory/Optional Control**: Administrators can force-certain notifications or let users choose
- **Configurable Intervals**: Adjust how frequently the system checks for updates

#### 📰 Newsroom Mirroring (v1.4.0)
- **iTop Newsroom in Nextcloud**: Receive iTop Newsroom announcements as Nextcloud notifications
- **Opt-in Per User**: Each user independently enables Newsroom mirroring
- **ActionNewsroom Triggers**: Requires ActionNewsroom extension configured in iTop

#### ⚙️ Professional Settings Interface
- **Personal Dashboard**: Real-time status with connection indicator and ticket counts
- **Secure Authentication**: Token-based setup with one-time personal token validation
- **User Profile Display**: See your iTop identity (name, email, organization)
- **Notification Control**: Configure alerts for new assignments and updates

#### 🛠️ Enterprise Admin Panel
- **Centralized Configuration**: System-wide settings with encrypted token storage
- **Connection Testing**: Real-time validation of iTop server connectivity
- **Ticket System Detection**: Automatically detects iTop configuration (Helpdesk vs Ticketing mode)
- **Custom CI Classes**: Add any CI class from your iTop CMDB beyond the 11 built-in types
- **Icon Management**: Upload custom SVG icons for CI classes, or auto-fetch from iTop datamodel
- **User Monitoring**: Track connected users and system health

#### 🔐 Security & Architecture
- **Dual-Token Security**: Separate application and personal tokens for maximum security
- **Data Isolation**: All queries filtered by Person ID - users only see their own data
- **Portal User Support**: Works with SAML/external authentication via Portal Personal Tokens
- **No Data Storage**: Personal tokens used once for verification, then discarded

### 🏢 Perfect For
- IT teams managing incidents and service requests
- Help desk agents tracking assigned tickets
- End users checking their request status
- Organizations using both Nextcloud and iTop ITSM

### 🔧 Technical Requirements
- **iTop Server**: Version 3.0 or higher with REST API enabled
- **Nextcloud**: Version 30.0 or higher
- **PHP**: 8.1 or higher
- **Optional**: [iTop Portal Personal Tokens Extension](https://github.com/LexioJ/itop-portal-personal-tokens) for enhanced Portal user support

#### Start streamlining your ITSM workflow - Connect iTop with Nextcloud and experience unified IT service management!

**Data sent to Microsoft:** the calendar, contact and task data you choose to synchronise is read from and written to Microsoft Graph (graph.microsoft.com) on your behalf. Nothing else leaves your server.

Bring SuiteCRM into your Nextcloud dashboard, search bar and notifications area. Signs in once with OAuth2 against a SuiteCRM 8.x instance and then keeps the two systems talking in the background.

## Dashboard widgets

Nine widgets, grouped by intent so the dashboard reads like your day rather than a list of modules.

**Schedule.** SuiteCRM Calendar (upcoming Calls and Meetings, with an optional per-user toggle for open Tasks) and SuiteCRM Tasks (open Tasks assigned to you, sorted by due date).

**Workload.** SuiteCRM Cases (open Cases, filtered by SuiteCRM role ACL) and SuiteCRM Pipeline (open Opportunities grouped by sales stage with weighted amounts).

**Activity.** SuiteCRM Activities (recent Calls, Meetings, Tasks and Notes across modules, sorted by date_modified so "recent" means "recently touched").

**Discovery.** SuiteCRM Contacts, SuiteCRM Accounts and SuiteCRM Leads (recently added records within your ACL, sorted date_entered DESC).

**Quick Actions.** A floating action button on any Nextcloud page for creating a Call, Meeting, Task, Note or Contact without leaving the current view. Toggleable per user.

## Search and notifications

Full-text search across Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Cases, Leads, Calls, Meetings, Tasks and Notes, surfaced through Nextcloud's unified search. Background job polls SuiteCRM alerts and pushes them into your Nextcloud notifications area.

## Requirements

SuiteCRM 8.10.x or later with the v8 REST/JSON:API enabled. SuiteCRM 7.x is no longer supported.

## Upgrading from 2.x

The 3.0.0 release restored the original `integration_suitecrm` app id after the App Store record transfer. A repair step copies admin config and per-user OAuth tokens forward from the 2.x `njordium_suitecrm` install automatically on `occ upgrade`. See `docs/upgrade-2.x-to-3.0.md` in the repository for the manual rollback path if needed.

⚠ This app is still in early development
and has only been tested with IBM watsonx.ai as a Service.

This app implements the following text generation providers
using any freely-available large language model:
Free prompt, Summarize, Headline, Context Write, Chat, and Reformulate.

You can connect to the watsonx.ai service provided by IBM Cloud,
or to a self-hosted cluster running IBM Software Hub and related services
([IBM Cloud Pak for Data](https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/cloud-paks/cp-data/5.0.x) is also required in this case).

## Improve AI task pickup speed

To avoid task processing execution delay, setup at 4 background job workers in the main server (where Nextcloud is installed).
Refer to the [admin documentation](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/admin_manual/ai/overview.html#improve-ai-task-pickup-speed) for the setup process.

## Ethical AI Rating

### Rating for Text generation via IBM watsonx.ai: 🟠

Positive:
* The provided foundation models are freely available, and thus can be ran on-premises

Negative:
* The software for training and inference of models is proprietary, limiting modifications to the API or other functionality
* Some foundation models are trained on data that is not freely available, limiting the ability to fine tune them

Learn more about the Nextcloud Ethical AI Rating [in our blog](https://nextcloud.com/blog/nextcloud-ethical-ai-rating/).

integration_windmill.description:
A seamless integration between Nextcloud and Windmill that allows you to automate workflows, sync data, and orchestrate processes with your standalone [Windmill](https://windmill.dev) instance.

This project bridges Nextcloud’s collaboration and file platform with Windmill’s powerful automation engine — enabling low-code workflows, background jobs, and event-driven automation.

## Features

- Automated workflows triggered by Nextcloud events

- Execution of various workflow actions directly in your Nexcloud  

- Secure authentication via temporary tokens or app passwords

- Configurable triggers and actions

- Low-code workflow creation using Windmill UI

More details on how to set this up in the [admin docs](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/stable/admin_manual/windmill_workflows/index.html)

integration_youtube.description:
YouTube integration providing an inline video player for link previews, a smart picker and search provider for searching YouTube videos, channels, and playlists.

Configuration:

Set an API key in the Administration settings -> Connected Accounts -> YouTube Integration section to allow the search and smart picker

Note: The search and smart picker functionality is disabled by default. Users can opt-in to enable them from their respective settings.

integration_zammad.description:
Zammad integration provides a dashboard widget displaying your important notifications,
	a search provider for tickets and notifications for new open tickets.

integration_zimbra.description:
Zimbra integration into Nextcloud provides a dashboard widget for unread emails,
 one for upcoming events, a search provider for emails and the ability to search for Zimbra contacts in Nextcloud.

Nextcloud will suggest your Zimbra contacts addresses when you search for a contact via the top-right contacts menu
or when you search for someone to share a file to.

integration_zulip.description:
This integration allows you to send Nextcloud files to your Zulip chat instance as uploaded files, public shared links, or internal shared links.

## 🔧 Configuration

### User settings

Account configuration happens in the "Connected accounts" user settings section.
It requires you to specify the URL of your Zulip instance, as well as the email address and API key associated with your Zulip account in that instance.
These values can be found in and copied from your Zulip account's `zuliprc` file located in **Personal settings > Account & privacy > API key**.

If those settings are not configured, a link to the "Connected accounts" user settings page will be displayed when attempting to send a file to a Zulip user/topic.
The context menu to send a file can be accessed by right clicking on the file/folder to be shared or selecting them and clicking on the "Actions" button.

interfonts.description:
# Inter Fonts

Switches every font in the Nextcloud interface to **Inter**, a highly-legible
typeface designed specifically for computer screens by Rasmus Andersson.

## Features

- **Zero external requests**: the Inter variable font is fully self-hosted inside the app, no Google Fonts, no CDN
- **Single variable font** covers every weight from 100 to 900 (roman + italic)
- **Zero FOUT**: both WOFF2 files are preloaded with `<link rel="preload">` so the font is in cache before paint
- **Zero CLS**: a metric-compatible synthetic Arial fallback matches Inter's vertical metrics until the real font swaps in
- **Works on every page** including the login form, public share pages, password recovery, and the Impersonate / Guests apps
- **Works in sub-directory installs** via runtime URL generation through `IURLGenerator`
- **Cache-safe across upgrades**: font filenames embed the upstream Inter version, so a new release automatically becomes a new URL
- **Covers the whole UI**: navigation, file lists, modals, popovers, login boxes, dashboards, and more
- **Tabular numerals** on file sizes and timestamps so digits stay vertically aligned

## Credits

The **Inter** typeface is created by [Rasmus Andersson](https://rsms.me/inter/)
and licensed under the [SIL Open Font License 1.1](https://scripts.sil.org/OFL).

The app itself is licensed under [AGPL-3.0-or-later](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html).

intravox.description:
IntraVox turns Nextcloud into a full intranet: pages built with a visual drag-and-drop editor, no code required.

**Where your content lives**
IntraVox runs wherever you run Nextcloud — your own hardware, an EU host, on-premises. It is open source, so it can be audited. Your content is not a platform format: pages are plain files and JSON in a folder, which keeps leaving cheap if you ever need to.

**Building pages**
* Drag-and-drop widgets in flexible grids (1–5 columns), 7 page templates
* Text with tables and markdown, images, video, links, files
* Calendar, People, News, Photo Story and File Story widgets
* Draft/published workflow, scheduled publication, page locking

**Finding your way**
* A page structure panel that stays open while you navigate, with a table of contents of the page you are reading
* Navigation editor with mega menu and sidebar options
* Nextcloud Unified Search integration (Ctrl+K)

**Working together**
* Reactions, threaded comments and version history with one-click restore
* Multilingual pages: link language versions, and readers are offered the one in their language
* Public sharing, with optional password protection
* Department access control through Team folders ACL

**Requirements:** Nextcloud 32–35, PHP 8.2+ (Nextcloud 35 itself requires PHP 8.3), Team folders.

intros.description:
The Intros app helps new users to understand the main Nextcloud apps.

* **Highlights user interface elements** to explain them
* **Plays tutorials automatically** on the user's first visit to an app
* **Easy to disable/enable** for each app
* **Comes with pre-installed tutorials** for Files, Dashboard, Calendar, Talk, Contacts, and the User settings menu.
* **Admins can define custom tutorials** with JSON files

introvox.description:
IntroVox shows people around Nextcloud. New users get a welcome tour after their first login, and a short tour the first time they open an app such as Files, Talk, Deck or Calendar.

**For users:**
* A welcome tour after the first login, in their own language
* Short tours the first time they open an app or a page, or a tip on any page after a few days
* Steps that go on when they click the element or fill in a field; a step whose element is not there yet waits aside until it appears
* Images, GIFs and videos in steps, with descriptions and captions
* Every tour can be started again from the personal settings, also through Tours in the user menu, and tours that start by themselves can be switched off
* An optional "Getting started" checklist on the Dashboard that ticks itself off

**For administrators:**
* Built-in tours for Files, Talk, Deck and Calendar, and tours of your own for an app, a page, or anywhere
* Translated default steps via Transifex (every translated language is available automatically), with your own steps per language where you want them
* Groups per step and per tour
* Who gets a tour and when: everyone or new accounts only, a number of days after the first login, between two dates
* Share links that start a tour, for a welcome mail or a message to a team
* Statistics per tour: how many people started, completed and skipped it, and how far people get
* Export and import of a whole tour, with its steps in every language and its images and videos
* Translate a tour or write its steps with AI, through the Nextcloud Assistant; you check every step before it is saved
* Optional anonymous telemetry reporting
* Automatically adapts to your Nextcloud theme (light, dark, high contrast)

Built with Vue 3 and Shepherd.js.

inventorycheck.description:
# Stock. Locations. Clear bookings.

InventoryCheck keeps parts and supplies on the Nextcloud you already host: warehouses, vans and site boxes, quantities, and an append-only booking history. See low stock early, print labels, run stocktakes — then optional InventoryCheck Mobile uses the same ledger for shelf and van scanning.

**Free web app** (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Companion apps: https://nextcloud.software-by-design.de/

## Why teams install it

- **Know what is where** — locations (warehouse, shelf, van, site box) and items with SKU, scan code, unit of measure and reorder level
- **Book without rewriting history** — receive, issue, transfer and adjust as append-only movements; corrections use compensating bookings
- **Act on low stock** — dashboard signals, movement history and printable labels
- **Count the shelf** — stocktake campaigns from create → count → close with posted adjustments
- **Stay scoped** — office / field roles and optional access restriction
- **Optional mobile** — license surface for mobile seats and paired scan devices

## Clear limits

- Movements are append-only — corrections use compensating bookings.
- Declared databases: MySQL and PostgreSQL.

## Feedback welcome

We improve this app with real-world use. Bug reports, rough edges, and ideas help — open a GitHub Issue (https://github.com/aSoftwareByDesignRepository/nextcloud-inventorycheck/issues) or write to info@software-by-design.de. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

## Requirements

- Nextcloud 32–35 · PHP 8.2–8.5 · MySQL or PostgreSQL

invite_registration.description:
Invite Registration lets administrators create personal, cryptographically random
invitation links. New Nextcloud user accounts can only be created by opening a valid
invitation link — there is no public self-service registration button.

This app works together with the Circles (Teams) app and requires it: every
invitation link is tied to a team, and the new user is added to that team on
registration.

Features:
- Admin-generated invitation links with configurable expiry and usage limits
- One-time or multi-use links
- Revoke links at any time
- Email verification: accounts are activated only after the user confirms their email
- Per-link team assignment: the new user joins the chosen team (Circle)
- Creates normal Nextcloud accounts (not guests) via the native user manager
- Passwords are never stored by the app; they are passed straight to Nextcloud
- No token enumeration: invalid, expired, revoked and exhausted links show a generic error

Requires the Circles app: https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/circles

journal_caldav.description:
Journal CalDAV connects the Nextcloud Journal / JournalNotes app to CalDAV clients.

It provides two complementary calendars:

- Journal: a read-only calendar containing all-day events for Journal entries. This makes Journal entries visible in Nextcloud Calendar and other regular calendar clients. Each event links back to the original Journal entry.

- Journal Notes: a writable VJOURNAL calendar intended for journal-capable CalDAV clients such as DAVx5 and JTX Board.

Journal entries can be synchronized and edited from JTX Board. New VJOURNAL notes can also be created from JTX Board. If a Journal entry already exists for the selected date, the new note is appended to that daily entry.

JournalNotes remains the canonical storage for all journal data.

Features:
- VJOURNAL synchronization through CalDAV
- DAVx5 and JTX Board support
- Create and update Journal entries from CalDAV clients
- Append new notes to an existing daily Journal entry
- Preserve JTX note titles as Markdown headings when appending
- Read-only all-day VEVENT calendar for Nextcloud Calendar
- Links from calendar events back to JournalNotes
- Stable content-dependent ETags
- calendar-multiget support
- CalDAV deletion intentionally disabled

Requires Journal / JournalNotes 0.2.0 or newer.

journeys.description:
Automatically clusters your photos by time and location into journeys (trips, vacations) and creates a Photos album for each. Only photos inside your Memories timeline path are used.

**Requires the Memories and Photos apps.**

- **Journey albums:** created daily in the background (opt-in), with place-and-date names like `Iceland — Aug 12–19, 2024`. Home-aware: local days and trips are clustered with separate thresholds; adjacent trips in the same country are merged.
- **Journals:** a travel diary with day entries auto-filled from your photos. Share with users for co-editing or publish to a revocable public link with route map and travel stats.
- **Videos:** render a journey into an MP4 highlight reel (requires `ffmpeg`), saved to `Documents/Journeys Movies/`. Optionally weaves in short clips, with their own sound, from the trip's videos.

    php occ journeys:cluster-create-albums <user>

kanso.description:
Kanso is a kanban board app for Nextcloud, built for speed. Boards, stacks and
cards with instant drag & drop, optimistic updates and payloads sized for large
boards (2,000+ cards). Realtime updates via notify_push, with a polling fallback.

Rich cards with markdown, labels, due dates, assignees, priorities, checklists,
parent/child cards and threaded comments with @mentions and watchers. File
attachments (up to 100 MiB each), custom fields per board (text, number, date or
a select list), time tracking with a per-card total, and private reminders on a
card or a single comment. Board sharing with per-user and per-group access
control, plus an optional read-only public link that needs no Nextcloud account.

A review workflow (request review, approve / request changes, customizable
review types, and an optional done-gate). A cross-board My Work hub (my tasks,
reviews, inbox), cross-board Projects, and per-board and per-project analytics
(velocity, cycle time, throughput). Board, List and Timeline (Gantt) views, with
swimlanes, saved filters and display sort.

Recurring cards on RRULE schedules, auto-archive rules, WIP limits and stack
roles, card templates, a command palette with full-text search, and trash with
restore.

Every board you can read also appears as a read-only CalDAV task list of its
due-dated cards, with an optional per-board .ics feed. Email intake turns mail in
an IMAP folder into cards in a column you choose, and GitHub and Forgejo links
and webhooks keep cards in step with pull requests and issues. One-click Import
from Deck, import from a Trello JSON export or a CSV, board export and re-import
as a zip with attachments, board duplication, and scheduled periodic backups of
every board for administrators.

keepassnc.description:
---

Open and edit KeePass databases (KDBX 3.1 / 4.x) straight from Files. Click the .kdbx, type your master password, get on with your day.

**Safe by design**

- Everything is decrypted in your browser. The master password and the plaintext never leave it; the server only ever sees the encrypted file.
- Saves are checked against the file's ETag, and a backup is made first.
- If two devices edit at once, the versions are merged instead of one quietly winning.
- An optional encrypted offline copy keeps the database usable when the server or network is down.

**What's inside**

- No database yet? Make one right in Files with + New
- KeePassXC-style search and tags
- TOTP, Steam Guard included, set up from a screenshot of the QR code
- Attachments with a preview, entry colors, history and icons
- Placeholders and field references like KeePassXC knows them
- Database settings, encryption and key derivation included, with values a browser can handle
- A new master password or key file whenever you like
- Merge a "conflicted copy" back in, and import CSV or JSON (KeePassXC, Bitwarden, Nextcloud Passwords, Passman, browsers …) or export CSV
- Password generator and a health report
- Follows your Nextcloud's accent color and light or dark theme, with a layout that works on phones and big screens alike
- English, German and Chinese

**Still just a KeePass file**

KeePassXC, KeePassDX and Strongbox keep working on it, no lock-in.

keepiq.description:
A zero-knowledge encrypted secrets manager for Nextcloud — a personal vault for users and a write-without-read credential store for applications, using end-to-end RSA-4096/AES-256 encryption backed by a private Certificate Authority. Your master password is never stored: not even the server administrator can read your secrets.

**Key Features**

- **End-to-end encryption** — RSA-4096 + AES-256 private-key protection with a private Certificate Authority (root + intermediate, auto-renewal)
- **Personal vault** — folder organisation, fuzzy search, Nextcloud unified search integration
- **Secret sharing** — share with Nextcloud users and groups, password-protected link sharing, secret requests (write-without-read), temporary ownership delegation
- **Application management** — register applications with CSR-based onboarding, write-without-read application secrets, OAuth-style application tokens (RFC 7523 JWT Bearer)
- **Admin settings** — CA health monitoring, password policies, application approval queue
- **NL Design System ready** — CSS variables, WCAG AA, government theming

Free and open source under the EUPL-1.2 license.

**Support:** For support, contact support@conduction.nl.

kooksession.description:
KOOK SESSION is a logbook for surfers, wingfoilers and other water sports lovers. Log every session with its conditions, keep track of your favourite spots and your quiver, and learn from your own statistics: which board for which swell, which wind works best at each spot, how many hours you spent on the water this year.

Everything stays in **your Nextcloud**: sessions are stored in its database, photos and videos in your own Files. No account with a third-party service, no advertising, no tracking.

## Sessions
- Session log in a large sortable table (date, sport, spot, duration, rating, wind, swell, equipment, comment, media), with filters by year, sport, spot, rating and equipment.
- Sport, spot, date and start time; the end time is pre-filled two hours later and the duration is computed.
- 1 to 5 stars and a free comment; number of waves ridden, distance covered, maximum speed (knots and km/h).
- One photo and one video per session, uploaded with a progress bar (camera on mobile), saved in `KookSession/photos` and `KookSession/videos`; videos get a thumbnail.
- Equipment used, grouped by type, and the buddies you went out with.

## GPS tracks
- Import a GPX file (Garmin Connect, Strava, phone apps) or an IGC file into a session, or create a new session from a track; help explains how to export from Garmin Connect.
- Map of the track, distance, duration and maximum speed (best 10-second average, in knots and km/h).
- Empty fields are filled in from the track: date, times, distance, speed, sport and nearest spot; a spot can be created at the start of the track.
- The track is saved in `KookSession/traces` and analysed on your server.

## Conditions
- Swell height and period, tide reference, offset and coefficient.
- Wind rose: touch the side the wind comes from, the arrow shows where it blows to.
- Wind and gusts in knots or Beaufort force, kept in sync, with km/h conversion; water and air temperature.

## Spots
- World map of your spots (OpenStreetMap); tap a marker to open the spot.
- Place search by name (Nominatim), click or drag the marker to the exact peak.
- Description and up to 4 photos per spot.

## Quiver
- Boards with dimensions in feet and inches (6′0″ × 19 ¼″ × 2 7/16″), metric conversion and volume; wings (area), foils (front wing area), wetsuits (thickness).
- Brand, model, purchase date and price, condition, up to 4 photos.

## Statistics
- Favourite spot, sessions per month by sport, time on the water compared with last year.
- 5-star sessions, equipment by conditions, ideal conditions per spot, personal records (including highest speed).

## Sharing
- Share a session, a spot, a piece of equipment, the map of your spots or your statistics as a message (SMS, e-mail, messaging app).
- Public link: a read-only page for friends without Nextcloud (photo, map, GPS track, conditions), valid 24 hours or 7 days, revocable, with the option to hide the exact spot position.
- Send a copy of a session, a spot or a piece of equipment to another user of your Nextcloud, who is notified and adds it to their own logbook.

## Preferences
Add your own sports, equipment types and wetsuit thicknesses.

## Android app
A native Android app uses the same data (sign-in with Nextcloud's Login Flow), available on F-Droid.

## Good to know
- Each user only sees their own data; photos, videos and GPS tracks are regular files in your Nextcloud Files.
- The only external services are for maps: OpenStreetMap tiles and Nominatim place search.
- Video thumbnails need `ffmpeg` and the `OC\Preview\Movie` preview provider on the server.
- Available in English and French.

This app was developed with the help of Claude, an AI assistant by Anthropic. Screenshots use fictional demo data; photo credits are listed in the README of the repository.

ktec_talkbot.description:
**Talk-Bot** turns any Nextcloud Talk conversation into an AI chat.

Enable the app and switch the bot on in a conversation — that is the whole setup
on the Talk side. No external daemon, no webhook endpoint, no Docker image and no
separate machine are required: the bot runs entirely inside Nextcloud as a Talk
in-app bot, in a few hundred kilobytes of PHP.

### Requires AI-Hub

Talk-Bot no longer talks to a model itself. The AI service, key, model and limits
live in **AI-Hub** — a separate app that is the one place AI is set up for the
whole Base series — and Talk-Bot asks it for every answer. Install AI-Hub from the
App Store, choose the AI service, key and model there, and Talk-Bot uses them. The
same AI-Hub also serves the other apps, so there is only one place to configure and
one bill to watch.

### Light by design

One small app, installed from the App Store like any other. There is nothing else
to run and nothing else to keep alive. It answers off the request path, so posting
a message never waits for the model.

### A plain, sandboxed assistant

Everyone talks to the same assistant: it answers questions and nothing more. It has
no tools of any kind — no files, no shell, no way to touch the server. (An
administrator who wants a chat assistant with shell access uses NetBase's assistant
instead; Talk-Bot does not do that.)

### And the rest

- **Per-conversation memory.** Each user keeps their own history in every room;
  `?reset` starts over.
- **Commands.** `?reset`, `?undo`, `?retry`, `?summary` and `?lang <code>` for the
  conversation; `?help`, `?status`, `?model`, `?whoami` and `?version` for
  information; and `?roll`, `?flip`, `?8ball`, `?ping` and `?joke` for fun. `?help`
  lists them all.
- **Access control.** Optionally restrict the bot to an allow-list of users.
- **Reply language.** Answer always in a fixed language, or mirror the user.

### Privacy

Messages sent to the bot go through AI-Hub to the AI provider configured there, and
nowhere else. Point AI-Hub at a local model server and nothing leaves your machine
at all.

Requires the Nextcloud Talk app and the AI-Hub app.

kursumstufung.description:
Eine Erweiterung zur effizienten Verwaltung von Umstufungsanträgen zwischen verschiedenen Kurs-Niveaus.
		Lehrkräfte können Anträge (Entwürfe) erstellen und an die Schulleitung einreichen.

lager.description:
# Lagerverwaltung

Lagerverwaltung bringt eine übersichtliche Bestandsverwaltung direkt in Nextcloud. Organisiere Lagerorte, Regale oder Schränke und Fächer, erfasse Artikel mit EAN oder Code und behalte Bestände sowie jede Bewegung nachvollziehbar im Blick.

## Funktionen

- Lagerstruktur mit Lagerorten, Regalen oder Schränken und Fächern oder Flächen
- Artikel mit Beschreibung, EAN oder Code und optionalem Foto
- Wareneingänge und Entnahmen mit Menge, Notiz, Datum und Benutzer
- Vollständige Bewegungs-Historie pro Artikel
- Artikel- und EAN-Suche
- Barcode- und QR-Code-Scan mit Kamera oder aus Bilddateien
- QR-Codes und EAN-Barcodes für Artikel erzeugen
- Deutsche und englische Oberfläche

## Datenschutz

Alle Daten, Bestände und Fotos bleiben in der eigenen Nextcloud-Instanz. Es werden keine Daten an externe Server übertragen.

## Berechtigungen

Das Löschen von Lagerorten, Regalen, Fächern und Artikeln ist ausschließlich Nextcloud-Administratoren erlaubt.

large_file_previews.description:
Renders previews of files too large for Nextcloud's own preview providers, by handing the file where it lies to a command-line renderer rather than loading it into PHP or sending it to a service.

What you get:

- **PDF and Illustrator previews** through `pdftoppm` (poppler), of the first page, at the full preview size, or a scanned page at its own resolution where that is smaller, for files of any size.
- **Image previews** through `vipsthumbnail` (libvips): TIFF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC, HEIF and AVIF, each type off until it is switched on, read in strips or from a pyramid's nearest level; a TIFF in one large strip that runs out of memory gets a second chance through `tiffcp`.
- **Limits around every render**: a timeout, address-space and file-size caps and a raised out-of-memory score, each with its value, the two caps switched together.
- **Per type and per extension**: which files the app takes, and from which size up to which size; anything it declines goes to the next provider.

Only files on local, unencrypted storage are rendered. Everything else is left to Nextcloud's other preview providers.

ldap_contacts_backend.description:
Adds a virtual address book and lets import contacts to user's individual one.

![Copy found LDAP contact to address book](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextcloud/ldap_contacts_backend/master/screenshots/contactsmenu-with-action.png)

In order to configure an LDAP backend, run

``php
php occ ldap_contacts:add --interactive $ADDRESSBOOKNAME
``

Where $ADDRESSBOOKNAME is a name you like to identify the virtual addressbook with. The interactive mode leads you through the configuration, but you can also use the `--help` flag to see all the options.

Given that the configuration is correct, you and your users will be able to search through the LDAP contacts via the global contacts menu. An import action allows to copy the contact over to the best fitting existing addressbook. A redirect takes you the contacts app with the newly created card open.

ldap_write_support.description:
The write support for LDAP enriches the LDAP backend with capabilities to manage the directory from Nextcloud.
* create, edit and delete users
* create, modify memberships and delete groups
* prevent fallback to the local database backend (optional)
* auto generate a user ID (optional)
* and more behavioral switches

learning.description:
**Learning** is a self-hosted learning platform for Nextcloud. Your questions, progress, and student data never leave your server.

Built for IT certification bootcamps (CompTIA, Cisco, AWS) but works for any subject. Instructors create courses, track student progress, and identify at-risk learners. Students drill with scientifically-backed spaced repetition and hands-on simulations.

## Why Learning?

- **Your data stays on your server** — no cloud dependency, full GDPR compliance
- **FSRS adaptive scheduling** — cards are prioritized by memory strength, not rigid intervals
- **9 interactive IT simulators** — CLI terminals, firewall builders, DNS resolvers, subnet calculators, network topology placement
- **AI tutor (optional)** — answers questions by citing your uploaded course materials
- **Verifiable certificates** — issue cryptographically signed, publicly verifiable completion credentials

## For Instructors

- Course management with pool assignment and student enrollment
- **At-risk warnings** — automatic detection of struggling students
- **Chapter heatmaps** — see where the class struggles at a glance
- **Curriculum timeline** — plan course schedule with milestones
- **Admin dashboard** — CSV export, course archiving, cohort merging
- Campaign selection — choose which story scenarios are available per course

## Certification & Compliance

- **Signed completion certificates** — every passing learner receives a cryptographically signed (Ed25519) certificate, minted automatically
- **Public verification portal** — anyone can verify a certificate's authenticity via its permanent URL, no login required
- **Compliance reports** — organization-wide completion overview for audits and works agreements
- **Mandatory training & recertification** — assign required courses, track certificate expiry, and automate recertification reminders
- **Tamper-proof audit trail** — every issuance, revocation, and completion is logged

## For Learners

- **Smart Queue** — one-click review of all due cards, sorted by urgency
- **Training & Exam Mode** — practice or simulate timed exams
- **PBQ Simulations** — performance-based questions with interactive CLI, drag-and-drop placement, and wiring tasks
- **Story Campaigns** — learn through real IT incident scenarios (WannaCry, SolarWinds, Log4Shell)
- **Live Duels & Sprint** — real-time multiplayer quiz battles via Server-Sent Events
- **Gamification** — XP, levels, streaks, 10 badges, seasonal league
- **Maintenance Mode** — long-term retention schedule after course ends
- **Trouble-spot cheat sheet** — export your weakest topics for exam prep

## AI Features (optional)

Requires a Google Gemini API key. Without it, the app is fully functional — AI features are simply hidden. Each user must explicitly opt in before any data is sent to the API.

- **VirtuProf** — AI learning assistant with RAG-powered answers and source citations
- **Question Generator** — create flashcards from pasted text
- **Note Generator** — AI-powered topic summaries saved to Nextcloud Files

## Question Types

- Multiple Choice, Free Text with fuzzy matching, PBQ Simulations
- CSV/JSON import & export, pool sharing, multi-language translations

## Technical

- Vue 3, Vite, Pinia — modern frontend stack
- 1220 unit tests, PHPStan Level 5, pre-push quality gates
- Native Nextcloud integration: Dashboard widgets, Notifications, Talk, Files
- AGPL-3.0 — fully open source

## Requirements

- Nextcloud 33–35
- PHP 8.1+
- PostgreSQL 13+ or MySQL 8+

**Looking for pilot partners!** If you run Nextcloud at a school, university, or training provider — we'd love your feedback. Open an issue with a bit of context and we're happy to walk you through it.

learniq.description:
Learniq is a learning system for Nextcloud: a leerlingvolgsysteem (LVS)-style progress-tracking core for primary, secondary, and higher education, and a leeromgeving / LMS for corporate L&D and government employee training — the same underlying data model serves both.

**v0.1 wedge — Compliance training**

- Annual AVG / BIO / NIS2 / Cyberbeveiligingswet refresher courses
- Bulk-enrol all employees in mandatory training
- Capture signed attestations per learner
- Detect upcoming certificate expiries
- Real-time coverage percentage per regulation
- Audit-pack export with immutable evidence log
- External-training bulk recording with officer verification and linked credential issuance
- School-year rollover wizard (propose mapping, side-effect-free preview)
- IMS QTI 2.x / 3.0 and Common Cartridge item-bank import
- Open Badges 3.0 credential issuance and public verification endpoint
- Launch cmi5 lessons and keep every xAPI result in learniq's own learning record store

**Later phases**

- K-12 leerlingvolgsysteem (Phase 2): BRON/ROD, UWLR, OSO, Edukoppeling, SchoolID/ECK iD pseudonymisation, OPP cycle, PTA grading, DigiD parent flow — a generic data-exchange job queue with an OSO parent-approval gate already exists, but no BRON/ROD, OSO, or SURFconext OpenConnector adapter is wired yet, so no wire-level exchange runs today
- Higher education (Phase 2): SURFconext federation, Studielink enrolment, OOAPI 5.0 catalog, eduPersonAffiliation, edubadges
- Assessment authoring (Phase 3): proctored exams (ProctoringProviderInterface for ProctorU, Honorlock, ExamSoft — interface only, no provider wired), EDCI verifiable credentials
- AI-assisted features (Phase 5): adaptive learning paths + AI item generation, gated behind EU AI Act high-risk feature flags

**Technical foundations**

- Built on OpenRegister (data layer), OpenConnector (external system adapters), and @conduction/nextcloud-vue
- Content runtime: cmi5 + xAPI primary, with a SCORM 1.2 / 2004 compatibility shim
- Immutable audit trail backs compliance evidence, AVG record-of-processing, and AI Act decision traces
- Standards-first: 26 standards mapped (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI, QTI, EDCI, Open Badges 3.0, UWLR, OSO, ROD, Edukoppeling, SchoolID, ECK iD, SURFconext, AVG, EU AI Act, BIO2, NIS2) — most as design target, not all yet implemented

Free and open source under the EUPL-1.2 license.

**Support:** support@conduction.nl

libresign.description:
**LibreSign helps organizations manage document signing inside Nextcloud.**

It is built for teams that need clear signing rules, traceable actions, and workflows that follow internal processes and legal requirements.

LibreSign has been a verified [Digital Public Good](https://digitalpublicgoods.net/r/libresign) since 2025.

**What LibreSign enables**

- Support internal and external signers
- Keep a traceable record of requests and validations

If your organization uses LibreSign, support its development:

For enterprise support, contact LibreCode:
https://libresign.coop

linkboard.description:

llmchat.description:
**Privacy-first by architecture. Batteries included. Bring your own LLM.**

A chat interface for large language models where **your browser talks directly to the LLM backend**.
Nextcloud acts only as configuration storage and archive target — it is never a proxy and never sees
prompts or responses. Not "we promise not to look": it structurally cannot.

Because the requests originate in the browser, `localhost` resolves from the *user's* machine. Your
Nextcloud can live in a datacenter and still talk to an Ollama instance running on your laptop —
no tunnel, no VPN, no exposed port. No server-side LLM app can do that.

Features:

* Bring your own backend: Ollama, llama.cpp, LiteLLM, OpenRouter, vLLM — anything OpenAI-compatible
* Multiple connections with encrypted API key storage, multiple profiles per connection
* Profiles carry model, system prompt, temperature, token budget, streaming and reasoning switches
* Streaming responses with a stop button, edit-and-retry, regenerate — including regenerating the
  same question with a different profile or model
* Full-text search across your local chat history
* Optional agent tools: web search via your own SearXNG, page fetching, clock, and read-only
  access to your own Nextcloud (Unified Search, Collectives, files, PDF text) — no MCP server,
  no extra container, no app password needed
* External MCP servers (Streamable HTTP, tools only) with token or OAuth 2.1 sign-in — proxied by
  the server, so their tokens never reach the browser, and every call asks first
* Skills: Markdown files in your own Files where you write down how a kind of question should be
  answered, which source to use and how the reply should look. Ships with a weather example that
  replaces a web search with one API call, fetched by your browser from a host you allowlisted
* Models can ask you a question in a dialog instead of guessing at an ambiguous requirement
* File picker in the composer, so a path goes into the prompt without being typed
* "LLM Chat" in the Files menu opens a new chat with that file's path already in the prompt
* Vision-capable models can be shown an image or a rendered PDF page from your files, behind a
  per-profile switch that is off by default
* Approval dialog before any tool call that leaves the browser, on by default
* Chat history in IndexedDB — local to the browser, by design
* Archive chats as Markdown files into your Nextcloud files
* Profile export/import as JSON (never contains secrets)

**Note:** API keys are stored encrypted on the server but are necessarily delivered to the browser,
since that is where the request is made. Each user only ever sees their own key.

localsend_share.description:
Adds a **Send via LocalSend** action to the file menu in the Files app.

The action asks a small relay service for the LocalSend devices on the LAN,
shows a device picker and sends the selected file to the chosen device. On the
receiving device, open the LocalSend app and accept the transfer.

The relay URL and its shared token are configured by an administrator under
*Administration settings → LocalSend Share*. The relay itself is a small
standard-library Python service and ships in the `server/` directory of this
app's repository; a `compose.yaml` is included so it can be started with
Docker. The relay must run on the same LAN as the receiving devices (UDP
multicast and broadcast discovery) and therefore usually uses host networking.

Requirements:
- Nextcloud 33 or newer
- A LocalSend relay reachable from the Nextcloud server (see `server/`)

Privacy: when a user triggers the action, the selected file is sent to the
relay and from there to the device the user picked. No other data is
transmitted.

logcheck.description:
# Know when something goes wrong — without SSH and fragile cron scripts.

HealthCheck watches the Nextcloud admin log file and notifies entitled admins when new ERROR or FATAL lines appear. Configure email, Slack Incoming Webhooks, a generic HTTPS webhook, and in-app notifications. Digests, mutes, and safe defaults keep alert volume under control.

**Free web app** (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Donations welcome: https://github.com/sponsors/aSoftwareByDesignRepository

## Why admins install it

- **View, search, and manage the log file** — read the newest part, search (literal), copy lines, browse older copies next to the live file, or start a fresh file after you fix errors (system admin)
- **Survive logrotate** — durable byte cursor with rotate/truncate recovery
- **Mute noise** — app id and regex mutes; HealthCheck itself is muted by default
- **Safe by default** — aggregates only (no raw log text in alerts) unless a system admin opts in with confirmation
- **Honest when it cannot watch** — unsupported log backends show a clear “Can’t watch” state

## Clear limits

- File-based logging only (`log_type = file`). Syslog / systemd / errorlog are unsupported in V1.
- One Nextcloud server (or a cluster that shares the **same** log file). Several app servers each with their own local log are not supported.
- Log browsing is capped (chunked read/search) and only the systemconfig logfile — never a user-chosen path.
- Starting fresh / deleting the log requires a Nextcloud **system admin** and typed confirmation.
- No SIEM export, ML anomaly detection, or auto-remediation.

## Feedback welcome

We improve this app with real-world use. Bug reports, rough edges, and ideas help — open a GitHub Issue (https://github.com/aSoftwareByDesignRepository/nextcloud-logcheck/issues) or write to info@software-by-design.de. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

## Requirements

- Nextcloud 32–35 · PHP 8.2–8.5 · MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL
- Working background jobs (cron recommended)

mail.description:
**💌 A mail app for Nextcloud**

- **🚀 Integration with other Nextcloud apps!** Currently Contacts, Calendar & Files – more to come.
- **📥 Multiple mail accounts!** Personal and company account? No problem, and a nice unified inbox. Connect any IMAP account.
- **🔒 Send & receive encrypted mails!** Using the great [Mailvelope](https://mailvelope.com) browser extension.
- **🙈 We’re not reinventing the wheel!** Based on the great [Horde](https://www.horde.org) libraries.
- **📬 Want to host your own mail server?** We do not have to reimplement this as you could set up [Mail-in-a-Box](https://mailinabox.email)!

## Ethical AI Rating

### Priority Inbox

Positive:
* The software for training and inferencing of this model is open source.
* The model is created and trained on-premises based on the user's own data.
* The training data is accessible to the user, making it possible to check or correct for bias or optimise the performance and CO2 usage.

### Thread Summaries (opt-in)

**Rating:** 🟢/🟡/🟠/🔴

The rating depends on the installed text processing backend. See [the rating overview](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/admin_manual/ai/index.html) for details.

Learn more about the Nextcloud Ethical AI Rating [in our blog](https://nextcloud.com/blog/nextcloud-ethical-ai-rating/).

mail_roundcube.description: Integrates an existing Roundcube standalone email-webapp into Nextcloud, with optional SSO.

maildrop.description:
MailDrop fetches emails via IMAP, extracts attachments, and stores them automatically in a configurable Nextcloud folder.

### Features

- Multiple mappings (each IMAP mailbox → one target user and folder)
- Optional subject and sender filters
- Flat storage by default (`YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_uidN_filename`)
- Optional per-mail subfolders and `.eml` sidecar files
- TLS certificate validation, attachment size limit, mark-as-seen or delete after import
- Background job every 5 minutes, plus `occ maildrop:fetch`

### Privacy

MailDrop connects only to the IMAP servers you configure. IMAP passwords are stored encrypted in your Nextcloud database. The app does not send data to the author or any third-party service.

Imported files stay in Nextcloud when you disable the app. To delete stored mappings and IMAP settings, run `occ maildrop:purge-config --yes`.

### Requirements

- Nextcloud 28–35
- PHP 8.1 or newer (follow the PHP range of your Nextcloud version)
- Outbound IMAP access and a working system cron for the background job

maintenancecheck.description:
# Know what is due. Close it in the field.

MaintenanceCheck runs recurring and corrective maintenance on the Nextcloud you already host. Put customers, sites and equipment in one register. Schedule by calendar or meter. Turn due visits into work orders with checklists, photos and optional signatures — then hand the office a Servicebericht PDF.

**Free web app** (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Companion apps: https://nextcloud.software-by-design.de/

## Why teams install it

- **See overdue work first** — due board for overdue, today, next 7 days and the weeks ahead, plus open jobs
- **Finish jobs with evidence** — conditional checklists, photos, optional signature; job kits and skills gates when you need them
- **Plan the day** — dispatch, day tours, capacity hints, exception board and an ops KPI snapshot (CSV)
- **Keep the register tidy** — customers, sites, equipment, printable QR stickers
- **Handle break/fix work** — corrective intake, failure codes, job minutes, comments, docs and warranty end
- **Support recurring inspections** — obligation packs (incl. DE/EN starters), pass/fail/conditional close, Prüfnachweis PDF
- **Stay in control** — office vs technician roles, optional allow-list, overdue Nextcloud Notifications

## Clear limits

- Prüfnachweis PDFs are operational evidence packs — not legal certificates. Seeded checklists are templates, not legal advice.
- Customers here are a field register. Same name in another business app ≠ same record; nothing merges on its own.
- Optional stock deduction after close stays off by default and never blocks finishing a job.

## Feedback welcome

We improve this app with real-world use. Bug reports, rough edges, and ideas help — open a GitHub Issue (https://github.com/aSoftwareByDesignRepository/nextcloud-maintenancecheck/issues) or write to info@software-by-design.de. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

## Requirements

- Nextcloud 32–35 · PHP 8.2–8.5 · MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL

majordomo.description:
Using this app you can automatically synchronize your user's to a
[Majordomo mailing list manager](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Majordomo_(software)).
It is possible to configure multiple mailing lists at any list server to include or exclude selected groups, users and other email addresses.

Import of existing mailing list memberships is supported, as well as reviewing changes before you apply them.
At your option, this app will keep your mailing list memberships up-to-date on a daily basis.

This app requires a dedicated IMAP mailbox to function!

- **🗺 Beautiful map:** Using [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) and [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com), you can choose between standard map, satellite, topographical, dark mode or even watercolor! 🎨

mcp.description:
New in 1.2.1: tasks gain subtasks: read, list and set a parent in the same calendar, with loops and nesting beyond 64 levels refused. In Data protection, configure one personal-root backup folder name (default MCP backups); previous names and content remain preserved and protected. Files pre-write copies are on by default and can be suspended only with native Versions available for the acting user; existing Versions prerequisites still apply and native versions are not guaranteed for every file/backend. Contact deletion always requires a verified backup. Optional Mail lists only the caller's accounts and cached folders/counters: no message reading, IMAP synchronization or changes; open Mail once for an empty cache.

**MCP for Cloud** is a native app that turns your Nextcloud into a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. AI assistants work with your files, notes, calendars, contacts, tasks, Deck boards and Talk conversations through one URL on your own server: no extra service, no Docker, no copy of your data elsewhere.

## What the assistant can do

- **Files**: list, search by name or content, read text, PDF, DOCX and ODT, view images, list and restore versions; edit text with a diff and a verified backup, create files and folders, upload, copy, move and reorganize folders with undo; share with people, groups or a public link.
- **Notes**: list, read, search, create, edit the whole text, append or replace one unique passage, move and delete (only when the trash bin can recover it).
- **Calendar**: list calendars and events, create, edit, move, delete and transfer events through the real CalDAV pipeline, with participants; invitations are sent only when asked.
- **Contacts**: search and read contacts, create and edit them while keeping every unknown vCard field.
- **Tasks**: list, read, create, edit, complete and delete tasks, with their categories.
- **Deck**: boards, lists and cards; follow up the cards you manage with due date and time; list, add and remove card labels on Nextcloud 32–35 and assign cards. Read and change native dependencies only on Nextcloud 34 and 35. List and unlink visible file associations on Nextcloud 32–35, and link one existing file as read-only for current and future board, group and team members when sharing rules allow. The check applies only when the link is created; a policy or membership change afterwards, and the gap before the native share, are not corrected automatically. Hidden files and unreadable relations are omitted, with no count. The original file is never deleted.
- **Talk**: read conversations, reply, message a user, share or quote a file and create group conversations.
- **Server log**: read and analyze `nextcloud.log`, for administrators or the IT groups they choose. Off by default, read only, IPs masked, the output is treated as untrusted data and every query is audited. With hidden tags configured, an option on by default also hides the text of log messages.

## You stay in control

- **Per-user permissions.** The administrator turns the service on, chooses who may connect and grants each operation per user in a users × permissions matrix. Reading starts allowed; every write, move, delete, transfer, restore or share starts denied.
- **Permissions by group.** The same permissions can be granted to native Nextcloud groups, with a preview of what changes before saving. Groups only grant: they never deny, and a choice made for a single user always wins over the groups. If the server's answer to a save cannot be read, the permission screens say the result could not be confirmed and show what is saved, instead of "Saved".
- **A clear admin screen.** In *Access and permissions* each person has one level per module (None, Read, Edit or Full) and only real exceptions are marked; the actions for one person sit in a row menu, several people are changed from a selection bar, and the list of groups scrolls and filters on its own, so the page stays usable with many users and groups. It works on a phone.
- **Back to group inheritance.** A permission set for one user can be handed back to the groups and the defaults, with a preview that shows the result before and after, cell by cell, and an "Undo" that brings the removed values back for 10 seconds. Nothing is written when the permissions changed in the meantime.
- **Access inspector.** Administrators only, and it changes nothing: enter a user and see every operation as Allowed, Blocked or Unknown, which check blocks it, where the permission comes from (the user, named groups or the default) and whether the user is limited to some resources. It also explains one file path and one calendar or task list, including why an excluded path is excluded. When a check cannot be confirmed the answer is "Unknown", never "Allowed".
- **Restricted to chosen resources.** In *Access and permissions*, the administrator narrows a user's MCP access to an explicit list of folders, event calendars and task lists, up to 200 per user and module, instead of everything the account has in Nextcloud. A folder, calendar or task list outside the list answers exactly like one that does not exist, is left out of listings and previews, and file references pointing to it (Talk and task attachments) are withheld as well. The restriction only ever narrows access, and changing it does not sign the user out; the restriction of a deleted account is removed only when both deletion events are processed outside another transaction and the policy revision was captured before the deletion; only restrictions saved at or before that revision are removed. Otherwise, or if the cleanup fails, the restriction stays, which only narrows access.
- **Optional file type policy.** Off by default, enabled by the administrator in *Data protection*. It checks final names/extensions for MCP writes, including Notes, uploads, restores, copy/move, batches and undo; mandatory internal backups are exempt. It does not inspect content or eliminate prompt injection. With the policy active, folder copies use a validated list and report partial results; later additions are not copied.
- **Plan and confirmation.** A tool that changes something first returns a plan of exactly what it will do; nothing is written until the user approves it.
- **Excluded from MCP access.** Files and folders carrying the system tags the administrator picks, and everything inside those folders, are invisible to the tools of this connector (the server log tools only while "Hide the text of log messages" is on). While at least one tag is configured, sharing, public links, copying or moving a folder to another directory are refused in MCP so that nothing hidden inside can be exposed indirectly — do those in the Nextcloud web interface; individual files and renaming a folder where it already is keep working. File references inside Talk attachments and task attachments are also left out when they point to an excluded file.
- **The app never deletes a file.** There is no tool for it, and edits keep a backup by default, subject to the administrator’s Files copy setting; Nextcloud versioning applies as usual.
- **Nextcloud permissions always apply.** The app never widens what a user can already do. A restriction by resource and an exclusion by system tag only narrow what a user reaches: they never add access. A guest of the Guests app keeps the restrictions of Guests on every request, with an app password, OAuth or a checkout link: only the apps allowed to guests, no hidden external storage, and sharing only within the guest's groups when other accounts are hidden.

## Clients

Claude (claude.ai and Claude Desktop), ChatGPT and Gemini CLI sign in with OAuth: the user logs into their own Nextcloud and clicks **Allow**. Other MCP clients can use an app password. In *Clients and connections*, the administrator can also register the self-hosted programs the organization runs itself, each with its own client ID and the exact address it comes back to, port included; turning one of them off or deleting it ends its sessions at once.

## Requirements

Nextcloud 32–35 and PHP 8.2 or later. Deck and Talk are optional: their tools appear only when the app is enabled in a supported version.

media_embedding_connector.description:
Search images in Nextcloud by meaning or visual similarity.

Media Embedding Connector sends supported images and text queries to an administrator-configured Media Embedding Service. The resulting vectors are stored in a connector-managed Elasticsearch index. The current adapter supports the MediaLab External API.

* Search with natural-language descriptions
* Find visually similar images, including from a temporary uploaded query image
* Browse permission-filtered results in a responsive image layout
* Open previews, download files, or navigate to their source folder
* Keep filenames, paths, users, groups, shares, and access-control data in Nextcloud

The app requires a compatible embedding API and Elasticsearch 8.12 or newer. Administrators retain control over network endpoints, indexing activation, supported formats, and backfill operations.

mediafetch.description:
MediaFetch is a download manager for Nextcloud that combines aria2 and yt-dlp in one web interface. Version 2.0 adds graphical yt-dlp settings, per-download video and music presets, enhanced torrent search and German/English localization.

Features include regular HTTP/HTTPS downloads, BitTorrent and magnet downloads through aria2, and media downloads through yt-dlp. Administrators keep control over global downloader settings while every user can configure their own download folders, aria2 options and yt-dlp options.

MediaFetch is based on the original NCDownloader / Net loader project and continues its AGPL-licensed codebase.

meetree.description: MeeTree provides a TreeView/Jreepad-inspired tree note editor with Markdown content preview, native JSON storage, TreePad Lite HJT import/export, and first-pass CherryTree CTD import/export compatibility.

memegen.description: A tool for picking a meme template and filling in custom text captions using the Smart Picker functionality.

memories.description:
# Memories: Photo Management for Nextcloud

Memories is a *batteries-included* photo management solution for Nextcloud with advanced features including:

- **📸 Timeline**: Sort photos and videos by date taken, parsed from Exif data.
- **⏪ Rewind**: Jump to any time in the past instantly and relive your memories.
- **🤖 AI Tagging**: Group photos by people and objects, powered by [recognize](https://github.com/nextcloud/recognize) and [facerecognition](https://github.com/matiasdelellis/facerecognition).
- **🖼️ Albums**: Create albums to group photos and videos together. Then share these albums with others.
- **🫱🏻‍🫲🏻 External Sharing**: Share photos and videos with people outside of your Nextcloud instance.
- **📱 Mobile Support**: Work from any device, of any shape and size through the web app.
- **✏️ Edit Metadata**: Edit dates and other metadata on photos quickly and in bulk.
- **📦 Archive**: Store photos you don't want to see in your timeline in a separate folder.
- **📹 Video Transcoding**: Transcode videos and use HLS for maximal performance.
- **🗺️ Map**: View your photos on a map, tagged with accurate reverse geocoding.
- **📦 Migration**: Migrate easily from Nextcloud Photos and Google Takeout.
- **⚡️ Performance**: Do all this very fast.

## 🚀 Installation

1. Install the app from the Nextcloud app store (try a demo [here](https://demo.memories.gallery/apps/memories/)).
1. Perform the recommended [configuration steps](https://memories.gallery/config/).
1. Run `php occ memories:index` to generate metadata indices for existing photos.
1. Open the 📷 Memories app in Nextcloud and set the directory containing your photos.

metavox.description:
MetaVox brings structured metadata to Nextcloud team folders. Define the fields your team needs, fill them in right in the file list, and filter, sort, highlight and search on them, even in folders with hundreds of thousands of files. Your files stay untouched: the metadata is stored separately.

**Work in the file list**
- **Metadata columns.** Your fields appear as columns in Files. Double-click a cell to edit it, or edit many files at once.
- **Ten field types.** Text, long text, number, date and time, checkbox, dropdown, multi-select, web address, person and file link.
- **Values you can trust.** Required fields stay filled, and every value is checked, however it arrives.

**See what matters**
- **Views.** Save columns, filters and sorting per team folder, and switch between them in one click.
- **Highlights.** Color cells by their value: overdue in red, due soon in orange, approved in green.
- **Instant filter and sort.** Search a filter's values and narrow down thousands of files at once.

**Find it again**
- **Search by field.** Filter Nextcloud's search bar on a field value, in one team folder or all of them.
- **Saved searches as folders.** Keep a search as a folder in Files, always up to date. *(Nextcloud 33 and newer)*

**Work together**
- **Live updates.** Changes appear for everyone at once, and a cell someone is editing is locked.
- **Nextcloud's permissions.** You see and change the metadata of exactly the files you can, ACL included.

**Automate and connect**
- **Default values.** New files get their team folder's defaults.
- **AI suggestions.** Let AI read a file and suggest its metadata.
- **Flow.** Act on metadata: notifications, access control, retention.
- **WebDAV and REST API.** Ask for `<nc:metavox/>` in a PROPFIND to get every file's metadata with the folder listing, or use the OCS API.
- **Backup and restore.** Daily backups, restored with one click.

**Built for** document classification, case and project files, contracts, policy management, curriculum tagging and research data. Used by universities, government organizations and enterprises.

Supports **Nextcloud 31 to 35** on **MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL**, in English, Dutch, French, German and Swedish. SQLite is for trying MetaVox out.

moodle_talk_bridge.description:
Connect your Moodle courses to Nextcloud Talk. A teacher adds a **Nextcloud
Talk Session** to a course, and everything else happens on its own: the
conversation is created, the class is added to it, and everyone joins with a
single click. No extra logins, no manual room admin.

**What your users get**

- **One click into the meeting.** Teachers and students open the activity in
  Moodle and land in the Talk conversation already signed in. There is no
  second password to remember.
- **Accounts created for them.** Course participants who do not yet have a
  Nextcloud account get one automatically the first time they join.
- **The right people, with the right rights.** Teachers become moderators,
  students join as participants, and membership follows course enrolment — so
  the room stays correct as the class changes.
- **Rooms that follow the course.** A conversation is created when the
  activity is added, renamed when the activity is renamed, and archived when
  it is removed.
- **Private by design.** Every exchange between Moodle and Nextcloud is signed
  and verified, and only the Moodle sites you approve are accepted.

**Setting it up**

Everything is configured in your browser. No command line and no server access
are required.

1. Make sure **Nextcloud Talk** is installed and enabled.
2. Install this app from **Apps → Integration**.
3. Open **Administration settings → Moodle Talk Bridge** and complete the six
   fields: your Nextcloud address, a shared secret, the account this app uses
   and its app password, your Moodle address, and the Moodle sites allowed to
   connect.
4. Enter the same shared secret in the Moodle plugin, then use **Test
   connection** there to confirm both halves are talking to each other.

Secrets are write-only. Once saved they are never displayed again, and leaving
a secret field blank keeps the value already stored.

**Requirements**

- **Nextcloud Talk (spreed)** installed and enabled. This app drives Talk and
  does nothing on its own.
- A Nextcloud account dedicated to this app, with an app password.
- The companion Moodle plugin,
  [Nextcloud Talk for Moodle](https://elearning23.com/nextcloud-talk-for-moodle/),
  installed on your Moodle site.

**You also need the Moodle plugin**

This app is the Nextcloud half of the integration. The matching Moodle
activity plugin, **Nextcloud Talk for Moodle**, is published by Brain
Station 23. Download it, and read its installation guide, here:

**[https://elearning23.com/nextcloud-talk-for-moodle/](https://elearning23.com/nextcloud-talk-for-moodle/)**

Both halves are required — neither works on its own.

**Support**

For installation help, a demo or any question, contact
[elearning@brainstation-23.com](mailto:elearning@brainstation-23.com).

moviedb.description:
# MovieDB - Personal Movie & TV Database

Track all the movies and TV shows you've watched with rich metadata from TMDB.

## Features

- **Movie Tracking**: Log movies with where you watched them (Netflix, Disney+, cinema, etc.)
- **TV Show Tracking**: Track series at the episode level — see progress per season, an "up next" card, and bulk-mark whole seasons or series as watched
- **Continue Watching**: The dashboard lists the shows you are in the middle of with the next episode; stop watching a show you gave up on, and filter the TV list by in progress, finished and stopped
- **Always Up to Date**: A background job keeps the episodes of your TV shows in sync with TMDB, so new seasons and episodes show up by themselves, and the dashboard lists what airs soon under "Coming up"
- **Rewatch Support**: Log multiple viewings of the same movie with separate ratings and dates
- **TMDB Integration**: Automatically fetch posters, cast, plot, and episode data
- **Personal Ratings**: Rate movies and shows 1–10 and write your own reviews
- **Watch History**: Full watch history per title, including per-viewing platform, language, and date
- **Watchlist**: Maintain a mixed movie + TV watchlist with priorities and a random picker that chooses from the whole list (filter by type, genre, high priority)
- **Quiz**: Play a quiz about your own library — when you watched a title, when it was released, who directed it — with a question count of your choice, a score history chart and a personal best
- **Filtering & Sorting**: Filter by genre, platform, and favorites, and sort in either direction
- **Statistics**: Dashboard with viewing stats by genre, platform, episodes watched, and total runtime, plus year- and platform-breakdown charts (including TV shows) with a movies/TV filter
- **Shared Libraries**: Create named libraries and share your collection with other Nextcloud users — assign viewer or editor roles, manage members, and switch between libraries from one account
- **Import / Export**: Back up a library or move it to another Nextcloud instance as a single JSON file — ratings, reviews, rewatches, episode progress and watchlist included

## Getting Started

1. Get a free API key from [TMDB](https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api)
2. Enter your API key in the app settings, or as an administrator set one key for all users under Administration settings → MovieDB
3. Start adding movies and TV shows to your collection!

## Data source

Movie and TV show data is provided by [The Movie Database (TMDB)](https://www.themoviedb.org/). This product uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.
