musicstats.description:
Music Stats shows what you listen to in the Nextcloud **Music** app: top tracks, artists, albums and genres over any period, listening time, the music you never play, and a yearly recap compared with the year before.

The Music app only keeps a total play count per track. Music Stats reads these counters every day and keeps their history, so you get statistics for any period.

## Dashboard
- Period selector: 7 days, 30 days, this month, this year, all time, custom range.
- Plays and estimated listening time compared with the previous period; listening time per day, week or month.
- Top albums with their covers, top artists, top tracks, discoveries.
- Genres, decades and the apps you listen with; CSV export.

## Library
- Contents: tracks, albums, artists, genres, total length, additions month by month, most present artists.
- Tags to complete: tracks without genre, year or artist, albums without cover, with links to the files.
- Ratings: the stars you give to tracks (for example in PowerAmpache2), average, distribution, plays by rating, 5-star tracks, loved but rarely played tracks, best rated artists and albums.
- Share of the library you play, most played artists of all time, forgotten albums, never played tracks.

## Yearly recap
Key figures, album and artist of the year, month by month, top tracks and discovery of the year, compared with the previous year. Each recap is saved for good once the year is over.

## Sharing
A read-only web page for friends without Nextcloud, valid 24 hours or 7 days, revocable, with a ready-made message.

## Good to know
- Requires the **Music** app. Music Stats only reads its data and never changes it.
- Tracking is opt-in, per user. Plays from before you turn it on count in "all time" only.
- Each user only sees their own statistics; nothing leaves your Nextcloud unless you share it.
- Available in English, French and Finnish.

This app was developed with the help of Claude, an AI assistant by Anthropic. Screenshots use fictional listening data; album covers in them are generated pictures, not the real covers.

n8n_sync.description:
n8n Sync turns a Nextcloud folder into a live, two-way mirror of your n8n workflows.

Bind an n8n **tag** to a folder, and every workflow wearing that tag shows up as a real `.n8n` file — with the n8n icon, its own tags, and its own dates. Edit it in Nextcloud and n8n has it seconds later. Change it in n8n and the file updates itself.

Nothing is matched on filename. Every file carries its workflow's id, so renaming, moving, copying, trashing and restoring never break the link — and re-running a sync never duplicates anything.

## ✨ What you can do

- ✨ **Create, read, update and delete** a workflow from either side
- 🚚 **Move** a workflow — it stays the same workflow — or **copy** it, which is always a new one
- 🗑️ **Trash, restore and purge**, mirrored into n8n's archive
- 🏷️ **Re-tag** it from the Files app, from inside the file, or from n8n
- 🖱️ **Open in n8n** with a click, or open the raw JSON in the text editor
- ⌨️ **Script all of it** — every admin action has an `occ` command

## 🗑️ The Nextcloud trash *is* n8n's archive

Trash a workflow file and its workflow is **archived** in n8n — hidden, not gone. Restore it and the workflow comes back. Only when you empty the trash is it permanently deleted.

It works from the other side too: archive a workflow in n8n and its file lands in your Nextcloud trash; unarchive it and the file comes back out. Personal trash and Team Folder trash, both.

## 🏷️ One set of tags, three places to change them

A workflow's tags live in n8n, in the file's own `tags` array, and as Nextcloud's searchable system tags — and all three are kept identical. Change them wherever you happen to be looking and the other two follow, with no "sync now" click.

That means your mirror is as searchable as n8n itself: filter for every `prod` workflow the Nextcloud-native way. 🔍

## 🎨 Honest icons, honest dates

Workflows register their own mimetype, so they wear the real n8n icon instead of a generic document glyph. And each file carries **the workflow's** created and modified dates rather than the sync's — so Recent, Popular files, and sorting a folder by date all tell you the truth about your automation.

## 🧭 Sync or Link — the folder decides

| Mode | The file holds | Pushes back to n8n? |
|---|---|---|
| **Sync** | The full workflow JSON | Yes — fully bidirectional |
| **Link** | A pointer (id, name, URL) | No — clicking it opens n8n |

Move a sync file out of its folder and it becomes **unmapped**: Nextcloud keeps the full JSON and the workflow's identity, while n8n archives the workflow. Move it back into any mapping and the same workflow is restored — not a fresh copy.

## 💾 And it doubles as a backup

A sync folder holds every one of its workflows in full, so it is also a complete, restorable backup — versioned by Nextcloud, synced to your desktop, and searchable by tag.

📖 **[Full documentation, screenshots and the `occ` reference on GitHub](https://github.com/kubed-io/nextcloud-n8n#readme)**

---

This is a community integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by n8n GmbH. "n8n" and the n8n logo are trademarks of n8n GmbH, used here only to identify the service this app integrates with.

nc_gantt.description:
**Professional project management — inside your own Nextcloud.**

nc_Gantt brings structured project planning and day-to-day task execution together in Nextcloud. Plan projects, subprojects, tasks and milestones with a professional Gantt chart — including dependencies, critical path, baselines, resources, capacity, budgets and Earned Value Management.

The key difference is the integration with **Nextcloud Deck**: connect the project plan with the team's actual work. Link tasks to Deck cards, create cards from project tasks, and optionally synchronize progress, dates and assignees. This connects professional project planning with agile, team-oriented execution without introducing another platform or data silo.

All project data stays on your own Nextcloud instance: no external service, no tracking, no data leaving your server.

## ✨ Features

* 📊 **Professional Gantt planning**: Projects, subprojects, tasks and milestones in a synchronized Gantt and table view, with day, week, month and sprint scales, inline editing and keyboard navigation.
* 🔗 **Dependencies & scheduling**: n:m dependencies of all four types (FS, SS, FF, SF), with lag and lead time in working days. Schedule changes propagate through dependency chains and cycles are rejected. Select several tasks in the table and chain them in one step.
* 🎯 **Critical path**: Forward and backward scheduling with float calculation; the chain that determines the project end date is highlighted.
* 📈 **Earned Value Management**: PV, EV, AC, SPI and CPI alongside rollup KPIs for progress, effort, budget and risk.
* 📐 **Baselines & variance reporting**: Freeze a plan, keep the baseline visible and compare the current schedule against it element by element.
* 🔮 **What-if simulation**: Test schedule changes without modifying the saved plan.
* 👥 **Resources & capacity**: Resource groups, roles as a resource type, optional links to Nextcloud user accounts, multiple assignees per task, capacity planning, workload charts and over-allocation warnings.
* 📅 **Working calendars**: Week models, regional calendars and holidays are taken into account by date calculations.
* 🃏 **Nextcloud Deck integration**: Connect projects, subprojects and tasks with Deck boards, lists and cards. Choose between four opt-in synchronization levels, from feedback-only to writing changes with or without confirmation.
* 🤝 **Sharing & permissions**: Share individual projects with users, groups and teams as viewer, editor or project admin.
* 📎 **Attachments**: Attach any number of files and Notes to projects, subprojects, tasks and milestones; they are shared automatically with everyone who has access to the project.
* 🗓 **Calendar & Tasks integration**: Subscribe to project dates and milestones via ICS and optionally write your own tasks to the Nextcloud Tasks app.
* 🔄 **Import & export**: JSON with resources (including the people behind roles), availabilities and working calendars, CSV for spreadsheets and the rendered chart as PNG, SVG or PDF. Anything that cannot be taken over is listed in a summary after the import. Plans from **Microsoft Project** (MSPDI XML, also written by ProjectLibre and GanttProject) can be imported as a new project, including hierarchy, dependencies, resources, working calendar and planned costs. Minutes, Markdown lists and notes become a task structure via a preview; canvases, Deck boards and Netherrack notes, canvases and tables can serve as sources too.
* 🧬 **Duplicate & templates**: Copy a proven project as the starting point for a new one, with a new start date and a choice of keeping all, only role or no resource assignments. Subprojects can be copied many times, for example room by room, one after the other or in parallel.
* 🔗 **Search, Smart Picker & link previews**: Find projects, tasks and milestones in the global Nextcloud search, insert them via the Smart Picker (`/`) and see a rich preview in Text, Talk, Notes and other apps.
* 🏠 **Dashboard widgets**: See active projects and your next due or overdue tasks directly on the Nextcloud dashboard.
* 🧠 **Netherrack knowledge**: Link notes, sections and blocks from Netherrack to tasks and see decisions, risks and open knowledge tasks per project – only references are stored.
* 💬 **Talk**: Create or link a Talk conversation per project; participants follow the project sharing, and a bot posts schedule changes and due dates. Subprojects, tasks and milestones can have their own conversation with the people of their resources.
* 🔔 **Notifications**: Configurable reminders for tasks and milestones, plus notifications for assignments and schedule changes. Shares, status changes and schedule changes also appear in the Nextcloud activity stream.
* ↩ **Undo & audit log**: Undo accidental schedule changes including their propagation chain; field changes are recorded.
* 🔍 **Search & filters**: Filter by risk, overdue items, budget overruns, resources, assigned tasks and missing Deck links without losing the time context.
* 📖 **Project management glossary**: Around 30 project-management terms and formulas built into the app.
* 🌐 **Localisation**: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Brazilian Portuguese.

## 🔐 Sovereign by design

nc_Gantt runs entirely on your Nextcloud instance. Project plans, resources, schedules and reports remain under your control — without a separate SaaS service or external tracking.

Requires Nextcloud 31–35 and PHP 8.1 or newer. Works with MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite.

## 📚 Documentation

* 🚀 [HOWTO](https://codeberg.org/fds2610/NC-Gantt/src/branch/main/nc_gantt/docs/en/HOWTO.md) — plan a sample project step by step, from the working calendar to the finished report
* 📋 [Feature reference](https://codeberg.org/fds2610/NC-Gantt/src/branch/main/nc_gantt/docs/en/FEATURES.md) — every function with its purpose, input and output
* 📝 [Changelog](https://codeberg.org/fds2610/NC-Gantt/src/branch/main/nc_gantt/CHANGELOG.md) — what changed in each release
* 💾 [Installation](https://codeberg.org/fds2610/NC-Gantt/src/branch/main/nc_gantt/docs/en/INSTALL.md) — setup and update notes

## 🐛 Feedback

Bug reports and feature requests are welcome in the [issue tracker](https://codeberg.org/fds2610/NC-Gantt/issues).

nc_netherrack.description:
**Your second brain — inside your own Nextcloud.**

Netherrack keeps your notes as plain Markdown files with YAML front matter in the `Netherrack/` folder of your Nextcloud. Sharing, versioning, sync clients and WebDAV work out of the box because notes are ordinary files — no proprietary format, no lock-in. On top of the files the app maintains an index for search, backlinks, properties, tasks and graph views, and turns your notes into a linked knowledge base: wiki links, embeds, bookmarks, canvases and database-like views.

All notes stay on your own Nextcloud instance: no external service, no tracking, no data leaving your server.

## ✨ Features

* ✍️ **Markdown editor**: CodeMirror 6 with formatting toolbar, live preview and autosave. Conflict detection warns you if a note was changed elsewhere instead of silently overwriting it.
* 🔗 **Wiki links**: `[[Note]]` with autocomplete, automatic creation of missing targets and link rewriting on rename. Link to headings (`[[Note#Heading]]`) and blocks (`[[Note#^id]]`).
* ↩️ **Backlinks & outgoing links**: Panels with a jump to the linking passage, including the linked sections and blocks.
* 🕸 **Graph view**: See all notes and their connections; hover for the file path, click to open.
* 🏷 **Tags**: `#tag` and front matter tags with overview, AND/OR filter and autocomplete.
* 🗂 **Properties**: All front matter fields are indexed with types (text, number, checkbox, date, date-time, list, tags). Edit them in a dialog above the editor; renaming a key works across notes.
* 🧩 **Embeds**: `![[Note]]`, `![[Note#Heading]]`, `![[Note#^id]]` and files (`![[image.png|300]]`, PDF, audio, video) right in the preview. Paste or drag & drop uploads to the attachment folder.
* 🔍 **Search**: Weighted full-text search (title > heading > tag/property > path > content) with jump to the match, also in the global Nextcloud search.
* ✅ **Tasks**: `[ ]` / `[x]` from all notes in one view, split into “My tasks” and “Unassigned tasks”, with filters for status, due date, priority, tag and folder; check them off right from the overview. They also appear in the Nextcloud “Tasks” app and, with a due date, in the Calendar.
* 🙋 **Mentions**: `@user` with autocompletion shares the note with that user and notifies them; chips in the preview show who has access, “For me” lists all notes that mention you.
* 🗃 **Bases**: Database-like views over your notes as `.base` files — table, list, cards, kanban (drag & drop changes the property) and calendar, with filters, sorting, grouping and editable cells.
* 🎨 **Canvas**: Infinite boards in the open JSON Canvas 1.0 format with text, note, file, link and group cards, labelled connections and colors.
* 📊 **Tables**: Spreadsheets as `.ods` files (LibreOffice-compatible) with several sheets, formulas (function menu, pick cells and ranges with the mouse), number formats, merged cells, comments, colors and Markdown/Excel clipboard — edited together in real time with live cursors of everyone working in the table.
* 📑 **Templates**: Every note in the templates folder is a template, with variables such as `{{title}}` and `{{date:FORMAT}}`; optional template for new daily notes.
* 📅 **Daily notes**: Journal with day navigation.
* 🔖 **Bookmarks**: Notes, folders, headings, blocks, saved searches, tags, bases and links in nested groups — they follow renames.
* 🪟 **Tabs, split view & layouts**: Open notes in tabs, work in two panes side by side, choose the sidebar panels (backlinks, outgoing links, tags, outline) and save named layouts.
* 🌐 **Publish**: Share notes and folders as a public web page via a link share, with rendered Markdown, wiki links and embeds restricted to the shared content; password and expiry date of the share apply.
* 🎙 **Voice notes**: Record in the app and transcribe locally with whisper.cpp as a background job (optional, off by default, set up by the admin).
* 👥 **Shared notes & Group Folders**: Changes by any user update the index of everyone who has the note.
* 🔌 **API for other apps**: OCS REST API (`openapi.json`), a query API with typed filters, AND/OR/NOT groups, sorting and pagination, and a PHP service (`NetherrackService`) for other apps.
* 📱 **Mobile view** and 🌐 **localisation** (English, German).

## 🔐 Sovereign by design

Netherrack runs entirely on your Nextcloud instance. Your notes are plain files you can open with any editor or sync client at any time.

Requires Nextcloud 31–35 and PHP 8.1 or newer. Works with MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite.

## 📚 Documentation

* 🚀 [HOWTO](https://codeberg.org/fds2610/Netherrack/src/branch/main/nc_netherrack/docs/en/HOWTO.md) — first steps with notes, links, tags and search
* 📋 [Feature reference](https://codeberg.org/fds2610/Netherrack/src/branch/main/nc_netherrack/docs/en/FEATURES.md) — every function with its purpose
* 📝 [Changelog](https://codeberg.org/fds2610/Netherrack/src/branch/main/nc_netherrack/CHANGELOG.md) — what changed in each release
* 💾 [Installation](https://codeberg.org/fds2610/Netherrack/src/branch/main/nc_netherrack/docs/en/INSTALL.md) — setup and update notes

## 🐛 Feedback

Bug reports and feature requests are welcome in the [issue tracker](https://codeberg.org/fds2610/Netherrack/issues).

ncc_backend_4mc.description:
# NC Connector Backend

Shared settings, consistent signatures and clear responsibilities: manage NC Connector for Thunderbird and Outlook Classic centrally in your Nextcloud.

## Shared defaults, tailored exceptions

Decide which settings are mandatory and which users may change in the add-on. Set central defaults for sharing permissions, password protection and expiry dates, for example.

Use **group and user overrides** to accommodate different needs: sales can have different sharing text and expiry periods from internal administration. Individual users can receive different settings or personalized signature details when needed.

## Delegate tasks, keep control

Not every change to a signature or sharing text needs to go through the Nextcloud administrator.

With **admin delegation**, give selected people access to exactly the areas they need. For example, someone in marketing or communications can maintain email-signature branding and revise the wording of sharing templates without permission to change sharing or Talk policies.

Assign permissions separately for sharing, Talk and email signatures, covering policies, templates, group overrides and user overrides in each area. Delegated users work in their personal Nextcloud settings and do not need full Nextcloud administrator rights.

## A consistent brand with personal signatures

Design central HTML templates for email signatures, sharing blocks, separate password emails and Talk invitations. Your own text, logos and design create consistent company branding.

Email signatures combine these templates with Nextcloud profile data and individual details, such as phone numbers or additional contact information. The mail add-ons automatically select the matching signature based on the sender address.

## Simple rollout and central defaults

Preconfigure the server address and sign-in method through the [Windows registry for Outlook](https://github.com/nc-connector/NC_Connector_for_Outlook/blob/main/docs/ADMIN.md#enterprise-rollout) or [enterprise policies for Thunderbird](https://github.com/nc-connector/NC_Connector_for_Thunderbird/blob/main/docs/ADMIN.md#enterprise-rollout). Users do not have to configure these details themselves.

In the backend, choose whether the add-ons use local or centrally supplied defaults. You can also let users choose the source themselves. Mandatory policies continue to apply regardless of that choice.

## Additional functions

- **Attachment automation:** Set size-based rules and decide when attachments are shared through Nextcloud.
- **Talk meetings:** Set defaults for room type, password, lobby and adding invited users and guests.
- **Separate password delivery:** Send sharing passwords in a separate email or through a time-limited Nextcloud Secrets link.
- **File sources in Thunderbird:** Centrally control NC Connector's Nextcloud VFS provider and access to compatible external VFS providers.

## Start for free and expand for teams

Community mode includes one free Seat for one Nextcloud user account with all backend functions. [Pro licenses](https://nc-connector.de/preise-lizenzierung/) are available for teams starting at five Seats. The functions remain the same.

Seats are assigned to Nextcloud users. Each user needs a valid assigned Seat to use central backend functions.

## Requirements and data storage

You need NC Connector for Thunderbird or Outlook Classic. Nextcloud Talk is required for Talk meetings; the Nextcloud Secrets app is only required for password delivery through Secrets links.

The backend does not store email messages or attachments. Centrally configured templates, settings and individual signature details are stored in your Nextcloud.

## Mail add-ons

- [NC Connector for Thunderbird](https://addons.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/addon/nc4tb/)
- [NC Connector for Outlook Classic](https://github.com/nc-connector/NC_Connector_for_Outlook/releases/latest)

## More information

- [Homepage](https://nc-connector.de)
- [Contact](https://nc-connector.de/kontakt/)
- [Support form](https://nc-connector.de/support/)

netbase.description:
NetBase turns your Nextcloud into a network console: it finds every device on the LAN, opens each one's own settings page from inside Nextcloud, and keeps the everyday lookup tools on the same screen.

Device windows are the heart of it. The server fetches a device's own web interface and rewrites every address inside it, so a router, a switch, a printer or a NAS can be signed into and configured from anywhere the Nextcloud is reachable — no VPN, no jump host, no site visit. Firmware can be sent, a configuration restored, a backup taken. Several windows can be open at once.

Discovery needs no root, no agent and no extra packages: NetBase primes the kernel neighbour table, reads it back, and asks each device for its own name over NetBIOS, mDNS, WS-Discovery and SSDP. It also listens for the announcements devices make, continuously and in the background, so a device sitting on another subnet of the same wire — one nothing here can reach, and which can never answer a question — still appears in the list. MAC addresses are resolved against a bundled IEEE registry of more than 53,000 vendor prefixes, offline.

What each part is for:
- Device windows — a device's own settings page, through Nextcloud, from anywhere
- LAN sweep and inventory — name, IPv4, MAC, vendor, type and open ports, exportable as CSV
- DNS — any record type from any resolver, resolver comparison, delegation trace, zone-transfer test
- Whois and free-domain search — look up any domain or address (IANA referrals, no whois binary), or check a name across a whole range of endings at once to find one that is still free
- Wake-on-LAN — wake a device by its MAC address
- TLS and HTTP — certificate, chain and expiry, accepted TLS versions, redirect chain, security headers
- Mail — SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, DANE and blocklists, SMTP/IMAP/POP3 server tests and an open-relay test, plus a basic mail program: read, search, reply, forward and send with attachments from your Nextcloud files
- FTP, SFTP and SCP — browse a remote server and move files to and from your Nextcloud folders; copy, move, compress and extract (ZIP, tar.gz, 7z and more), convert text encodings and line endings, resume transfers, and act as another account through sudo
- SSH and Telnet — a credential-free probe, and commands or a full terminal on a saved connection
- Benchmarks — internet speed, LAN throughput over iperf3, resolver comparison, HTTP timing
- Every result can be copied, downloaded or saved straight into your own Nextcloud files
- An AI assistant, through the AI-Hub app, that explains what is on the screen (a scan, a ping, a list of devices); administrators who switch it on can let it suggest commands, run only after the person approves each one. Without AI-Hub it is simply not shown

Access is per tool. NetBase is an administrator's app, and everything that touches the local network defaults to administrators — but each tool can be opened to named groups or to everyone from Administration settings, so an instance can lend out whois, DNS and the other harmless lookups without lending out the network. Where an account is allowed nothing, NetBase leaves itself out of that account's app menu.

Available in twenty-one languages, and NetBase can be set to a different language from the rest of Nextcloud, per account.

**A SnappyMail fork focused on integration with Nextcloud.**

NextSnapMail is an independent community fork of SnappyMail for the Nextcloud
use case. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Nextcloud GmbH.

NextSnapMail is under active development and provided as-is. Please test it
carefully before using it in production. Installation and use are at your own
risk.

**Lightweight & fast email client.**

- **Dark mode**
- **Responsive design**
- **Full Sieve filtering support**
- **Date-limited out-of-office messages per account and identity**, with names
  and addresses loaded automatically from the selected account and flexible
  per-sender reply intervals for the full absence, daily, weekly or custom use
- **Safe multi-instance Sieve handling** that detects and preserves vacation
  settings created by another NextSnapMail instance and allows explicit removal
- **Explicit migration of existing managed Sieve filters** from
  `rainloop.user` to `nextsnapmail.user`; both scripts remain independently
  editable until the user deliberately starts the migration
- **Almost all IMAP features** including advanced searching
- **Integration with Nextcloud Unified Search**
- **Integration with other Nextcloud apps** (Contacts, Files and Calendar)
- **Multiple mail accounts and identities**
- **Integrated Gmail / Google OAuth2 login**, including main account setup from
  the personal settings and additional Gmail accounts from the webmail account
  menu
- **Administration integrated into Nextcloud**, including mail domains, Google
  OAuth, webmail settings, extensions and data migration without a separate
  webmail administrator login
- **Domain connection tests** with visible IMAP, SMTP and optional Sieve results
- **Protected shared CardDAV settings** that cannot be overwritten while an
  additional mail account is active
- **Admin-assisted import from existing SnappyMail installations**, including
  stored mailbox credentials, additional accounts and app data
- **Admin reset option** to remove NextSnapMail account settings and recreate a
  clean NextSnapMail data folder when troubleshooting is needed
- **Admin-controlled message list size**, including default value, maximum
  value and an optional enforced setting for all users
- **Send & receive OpenPGP encrypted/signed emails** (With full HTML support, ECC keys, or plain text with Mailvelope)
- **Send & receive S/MIME encrypted/signed emails**
- **Many security features** (Sodium encrypted passwords, Sec-Fetch, TOTP 2FA, DKIM, prevent tracking, etc.)
- **Kolab integrations**

After enabling the app, administrators can manage the complete webmail
configuration in the dedicated "NextSnapMail" section of the Nextcloud
administration settings without a separate webmail administrator login.
Users can add their initial mailbox credentials in the dedicated
"NextSnapMail" section of their personal settings.

Administrators can also use the NextSnapMail administration settings to import
data from an existing SnappyMail installation or reset NextSnapMail data for
troubleshooting.

ng_backup.description:
Back up your whole Nextcloud — data directory, database and configuration — encrypted and
incremental, to storage you choose. Restore single files, folders, a user, or the whole server from
the web interface or `occ`. No shell access or external tools needed, so it also runs on Nextcloud
All-in-One and hosted Nextcloud.

**Where to**
- S3 and S3-compatible storage, SFTP, WebDAV, SMB, FTP, Swift or a local path (NFS mount), through
  the connection code of the External storage app. A location is never mounted and never shows up
  in Files.

**How**
- Deduplicated, compressed and encrypted (XChaCha20-Poly1305) on the server before upload, streamed
  straight to the location: no local copy, no double disk space. Unchanged files are not read again.
- Database dump through Nextcloud's own connection, in one consistent transaction (PostgreSQL,
  MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite).
- Runs in short steps from the background jobs, so a server or container restart does not lose a
  running backup.
- Daily schedule, retention policy, and `occ backup:verify` (optionally `--deep`) to check that a
  backup can be read.

**Safe**
- Up to three passphrases plus a recovery kit; the passphrase is the actual key.
- Deletion delay and append-only locations against ransomware or a compromised server; S3 object
  lock supported.
- Admin notifications on failures, stale backups and changes to keys and locations.

**Restore**
- Files and folders into a new folder, merged, or replacing the original — through Nextcloud, so
  overwritten files keep a version and removed ones go to the trash.
- One user (account, files, calendars, contacts) via user_migration.
- The whole server onto a fresh installation (disaster recovery).

NG Backup needs Nextcloud's background jobs on system cron (a real cron line, not only the setting).
Read "Known limitations" in the README before you rely on it, and test a restore. Feedback is very
welcome: use the "Share your experience" link on the admin page.

Developed and sponsored by [Ensembia](https://www.ensembia.com). We can offer (paid) assistance if
you need help with restoring a backup after a crash.

nopstation_analytics.description:
# nopCommerce Analytics & Reporting Studio by nopStation

A powerful, enterprise-grade Nextcloud application designed to seamlessly bridge your **nopCommerce** e-commerce store with your self-hosted **Nextcloud** workspace. Monitor sales, track revenue performance, inspect customer lifetime value, manage fulfillment logistics, and prevent stockouts—all within your private cloud.

---

### 🌟 Key Highlights

- **🔒 100% On-Premise & Data Sovereignty**: All raw e-commerce data (orders, line items, customers, products, and shipments) is synchronized directly into your local Nextcloud database. All KPI calculations and reports run on your server—zero third-party tracking, zero external SaaS dependencies.
- **⚡ Real-Time Synchronized E-Commerce**: Supports both on-demand manual sync (Full & Incremental) and automated real-time event updates via HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks (`OrderCreated`, `OrderPaid`, `CustomerRegistered`, `ProductStockChanged`).
- **💼 Enterprise UX & State Persistence**: High-performance Vue 3 interface with deep URL hash routing (`#/dashboard`, `#/reports/summary`, `#/reports/customers`, `#/reports/lowstock`, `#/exports`, `#/settings`) and persistent state across page reloads.

---

### 📊 Core Features

#### 1. Executive Sales KPI Dashboard
- **Live Performance Metrics**: Instant cards for Gross Revenue, Net Profit, Total Orders, Average Order Value (AOV), Shipping Fees, and Tax Collected.
- **Interactive Multi-Granularity Trends**: Interactive side-by-side charts for Revenue vs. Profit and Order Volumes with Day, Week, and Month grouping.
- **Fulfillment & Logistics Intelligence**: Real-time order fulfillment tracker (Delivered, Shipped, Not Yet Shipped, Shipping Not Required) with efficiency rate progress indicator and live dispatch feed.

#### 2. Deep Operational Sales Reports
- **Dynamic Period Breakdown**: Group sales performance by Day, Week, or Month.
- **3-Level Hierarchical Drilldown**:
  - **Level 1**: Periodic revenue, tax, and order count summaries.
  - **Level 2**: Expandable orders table with Order ID, Customer Name/Email, Timestamp, Payment Method, Shipping Method, Discounts, and Status badges.
  - **Level 3**: Expandable order line items breakdown showing Product Name, SKU, Quantity, Unit Price, and Subtotal.
- **Compact Child Pagination**: Clean navigation controls for large order volumes.

#### 3. Customer Segmentation & Analytics
- **3-Level Expandable Customer Directory**: Customer profile → Customer orders history → Order line items.
- **Flexible Date Range Filtering**: Nullable start and end dates with quick presets (*All Time*, *Last 30 Days*, *Last 90 Days*, *This Year*).
- **Segment & Behavior Filters**: Search by Name, Email, or Customer ID; filter by segment (*First-Time Buyers* vs *Returning Customers*); sort by *Highest Spend*, *Most Orders*, *Most Recent Order*, or *Customer Name*.
- **Dual Independent Pagination**: Dedicated pagination controls for both the parent customer list and nested order histories.

#### 4. Low Stock Inventory Alerts
- **Proactive Stock Monitoring**: Automatically identifies and lists catalog products with inventory levels at or below 10 units to help your team prevent stockouts and backorders.

#### 5. Automated CSV Report Exports
- **One-Click Export to Nextcloud Files**: Generate clean CSV reports and store them directly inside your Nextcloud Files storage (`/Files/Analytics/`) for immediate sharing and team collaboration.

---

### ⚙️ Quick Installation & Setup

1. **Install App**: Place `nopstation_analytics` into your Nextcloud server's `apps/` or `custom_apps/` folder, or install directly from the Nextcloud App Store.
2. **Enable App**: Run `php occ app:enable nopstation_analytics` via terminal or enable it through the Nextcloud Apps management screen.
3. **Configure Store Credentials**:
   - Open **nopCommerce Analytics** from the Nextcloud app header menu.
   - Go to **Settings & Data Sync**.
   - Enter your nopCommerce Store Base URL (e.g. `https://your-store.com`).
   - Enter your REST API credentials (Admin Email & Password or JWT credentials) and click **Save Settings**.
   - Click **Test Connection** to verify connectivity, then run **Run Full Sync**.
4. **Real-time Webhook Configuration (Optional)**:
   - In your nopCommerce Webhook plugin, configure endpoints to post to `https://<your-nextcloud>/index.php/apps/nopstation_analytics/api/v1/webhook` with header `X-Nop-Signature` for instant updates.

---

### 🏢 Developed by nopStation (Brain Station 23)

**nopStation** is the premier brand of **Brain Station 23 PLC**, dedicated to the global nopCommerce ecosystem:
- **nopCommerce Gold Solution Partner**: Recognized as the #1 provider of nopCommerce enterprise plugins, multi-platform mobile apps, themes, and custom engineering.
- **ERP 23 Integration**: Seamless enterprise resource planning and digital transformation solutions.
- **Official Website**: [https://www.nop-station.com](https://www.nop-station.com)
- **nopCommerce Marketplace**: [nopStation on nopCommerce](https://www.nopcommerce.com/en/nopstation)
- **LinkedIn**: [nopStation Showcase](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/nopstation/) | [ERP 23](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/erp-23bs)
- **Customer Support**: support@nop-station.com

noteberg.description:
NoteBerg is a note-taking app combining handwriting, rich text, and Nextcloud sync.

## Features

### Handwriting & Drawing
- Handwriting input with active stylus and pressure sensitivity
- Pen tool with customizable colors, marker/highlighter tool
- Lasso selection — move, resize, rotate, copy selected strokes
- Eraser tool, unlimited undo/redo
- Mark handwritten notes as tasks

### Text Editing
- Rich text editor (WYSIWYG) with formatting, tables, colors, and font sizes
- Automatic mode switching between drawing and text editing
- Task checkboxes inline with notes

### Media & Import/Export
- PDF import — annotate PDFs with pen and text
- Image insertion with cropping and perspective correction, with automatic page corner detection
- Document mode in the camera — outlines the page live, straightens it after the shot, and can flatten shadows for a scanned look
- PDF export with automatic A4 pagination

### Organization
- Notebooks for hierarchical organization
- Note overview with thumbnail previews
- Full-text search across handwriting and typed text
- Markers tab — browse task markers across all notes
- Recycle bin with soft delete and permanent deletion

### Sync & Storage
- Offline-first — all data stored locally in IndexedDB
- Nextcloud sync via WebDAV with conflict resolution

### UI
- Dark mode / light mode with system preference detection
- Background patterns — ruled lines and grid
- Internationalization — English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Chinese

### Handwriting Recognition
- Optional AI recognition with a vision model you configure yourself — off by default, always started manually.
- Nothing is sent anywhere unless you turn it on and supply your own provider details.
- When you start a recognition, your handwriting is rendered as an image and sent from your Nextcloud server to the endpoint you configured, and the transcribed text is returned.
- The request is made by the server rather than the browser, so your API key stays on the server and is never exposed to the web page. It is stored encrypted.

### AI Integration (optional)
- A shared, off-by-default AI provider connection (endpoint, model, API key) configured once per account in the app's settings. There is no built-in or shared service, and no key ships with the app.
- AI handwriting recognition (above) is the first feature built on this connection, with more planned.

### Data & Privacy
- All note data is stored exclusively on your own Nextcloud server — no third-party services or telemetry, except for the optional AI recognition described above, which is off unless you configure it
- Note: uninstalling this app does not delete your note data from the server. Your notes remain in the /NoteBerg/ WebDAV folder and can be re-accessed by reinstalling the app. This is intentional — your data may also have been synced there by the NoteBerg desktop or mobile app.

### Also available on other platforms
- Android: native app via Google Play open testing: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=eu.noteberg.app
- Windows: desktop installer from GitHub Releases: https://github.com/thomasleuthold/NoteBerg/releases (unsigned build; Windows may warn about an unknown publisher)

ocr_search.description:
Makes the text inside your images searchable from the unified search:
screenshots first of all, and also photos of notes, signs and documents.

Images are recognised by a small OCR service that runs next to Nextcloud
(PP-OCRv5 through ONNX Runtime, CPU only, under 1 GiB of memory). New and
changed images are indexed automatically by the background job; existing
images are indexed with `occ ocr_search:index` and `occ ocr_search:process`,
which can be scheduled at night and limited in runtime. The recognised text is
shown in a tab of the file sidebar and can be copied.

Search results only contain files the searching user can access. Uploading and
viewing keep working when the OCR service is down; images simply wait in the
queue.

The OCR service ships in the `server/` directory of this app's repository,
with a `compose.yaml`. Its URL and shared token are configured by an
administrator under *Administration settings → OCR Search*.

Requirements:
- Nextcloud 33 or newer, background jobs run by cron
- The OCR service reachable from the Nextcloud server (see `server/`)

Privacy: every image that is indexed is sent to the OCR service URL configured
by the administrator. No other data is transmitted.

# OpenID Connect Login

Provides user creation and login via one single OpenID Connect provider. Even though this is a fork of [nextcloud-social-login](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login), it fundamentally differs in two ways - aims for simplistic, single provider login (and hence is very minimalistic), and it supports having LDAP as the primary user backend. This way, you can use OpenID Connect to login to Nextcloud while maintaining an LDAP backend with attributes with the LDAP plugin.

### Features

- Automatic [Identity provider endpoints discovery](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-discovery-1_0.html)
- User creation at first login
- User profile update at login (name, email, avatar, groups etc.)
- Group creation
- Automatic redirection from the nextcloud login page to the Identity Provider login page
- WebDAV endpoints `Bearer` and `Basic` authentication
- Optional removal of special characters in UID
- Mapping of multiple names to a single display name
- Mapping for birthdate

onlyoffice.description:
The ONLYOFFICE app for Nextcloud brings powerful document editing and collaboration tools directly to your Nextcloud environment. With this integration, you can seamlessly create, edit, and co-author text documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and PDFs, as well as build and fill out PDF forms.

Collaborate with your team in real time, make use of Track Changes, version history, comments, integrated chat, and more. Work together on files with federated cloud sharing. Flexible access permissions allow you to control who can view, edit, or comment, ensuring secure role-based collaboration tailored to your needs. Documents can also be protected with watermarks, password settings, and encryption for added security.

The app offers support for over 50 file formats, including DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, RTF, TXT, CSV, ODT, ODS, ODP, EPUB, FB2, HTML, HWP, HWPX, Pages, Numbers, Keynote, etc. Seamless desktop and mobile app integration means you'll have access to your Nextcloud files wherever you go.

Furthermore, you can seamlessly connect any AI assistant, including local ones, directly to the editors to work faster and more efficient. This allows you to leverage various AI models for tasks like chatbot interactions, translations, OCR, and more.

Whether you’re working with internal teams or external collaborators, the ONLYOFFICE app for Nextcloud enhances productivity, simplifies workflows, and ensures your files remain secure.

openrouter_connector.description:
This app connects your Nextcloud instance to [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai), a unified API that gives you access to
hundreds of large language, image, speech-to-text and text-to-speech models from many providers with a single API key.

Once an API key is configured, the administrator selects the OpenRouter models that should be available. Every selected model
is registered as its own set of task processing providers, named after the model, so different models can be picked for
different tasks in the **Artificial Intelligence** admin settings.

The following Assistant features are provided, depending on the modality of the selected models:

* **Text models**: free prompt, chat, chat with tools (agent support), summarize, headline, topics, context write,
  reformulate, proofread, change tone, formalization, simplification, reformat paragraphs (since Nextcloud 34),
  improve text (since Nextcloud 35), translate and emoji generation.
  Models that accept image input additionally provide image analysis and optical character recognition (OCR).
* **Image models**: image generation via the dedicated OpenRouter image API.
* **Speech-to-text models**: audio transcription.
* **Text-to-speech models**: speech generation.

The [Assistant app](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/assistant) is required to use these features from the user interface.

## Privacy

All requests are sent to the OpenRouter API (`openrouter.ai`), which routes them to the upstream model providers.
Administrators can switch to OpenRouter's EU endpoint (`eu.openrouter.ai`) instead, which processes prompts and
completions inside the European Union only. The admin settings offer OpenRouter's routing options to restrict requests
to providers that do not store or train on your data (`data_collection: deny`) and to zero-data-retention providers.
Please review the
[OpenRouter privacy documentation](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/privacy/provider-logging) and the terms of the
model providers you select.

## Improve AI task pickup speed

To avoid delays when processing tasks, set up background job workers as described in the
[Nextcloud AI documentation](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/admin_manual/ai/overview.html#improve-ai-task-pickup-speed).

## Ethical AI Rating

The rating depends on the model you select through OpenRouter:

### Proprietary models (for example OpenAI, Anthropic, Google): 🔴

Negative:
* The software for training and inference of these models is proprietary, limiting running them locally or training by yourself
* The trained models are not freely available, so they can not be run on-premises
* The training data is not freely available, limiting the ability of external parties to check and correct for bias or optimise the models' performance and CO2 usage

### Open-weight models (for example Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek): 🟡

Positive:
* The trained models are freely available and can be run on-premises

Negative:
* The training data is usually not freely available, limiting the ability of external parties to check and correct for bias or optimise the models' performance and CO2 usage

Learn more about the Nextcloud Ethical AI Rating [in the Nextcloud blog](https://nextcloud.com/blog/nextcloud-ethical-ai-rating/).

opsdash.description:
Opsdash is an independent third-party app for Nextcloud Calendar that turns calendar activity into an operational cockpit for weekly and monthly planning.

Opsdash is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially maintained by Nextcloud GmbH or the Nextcloud project.

Use it to answer three questions fast:
- What happened this period?
- Are we on pace against targets?
- Where is workload drifting?

### Highlights
- KPI dashboards for totals, active days, day-of-week patterns, and category mix
- Calendar and category targets with pacing context
- Strategy-aware widgets that stay aligned with Single Goal, Calendar Goals, and Calendar + Category Goals
- Balance/trend widgets for period-over-period comparisons
- Presets and profile export/import for repeatable reporting
- Guided onboarding for quick team setup

### Compatibility
Supports Nextcloud 31 through 35. Nextcloud 35 requires PHP 8.3 or later.

### Runs inside Nextcloud
- Runs fully inside Nextcloud (no external analytics backend)
- Per-user configuration persisted server-side
- CSRF-protected write endpoints and standard Nextcloud permission model

Opsdash is built for teams that already plan in calendars and want clear execution visibility without leaving Nextcloud.

orchestration_gateway.description:

You can use this app to register, update and delete webhook listeners in the Nextcloud admin settings. Triggers can be set on Nextcloud events from Files, Forms, Tables, Calendar and many more. You can also configure event filters, user ID filters and choose which authorization tokens to include for every webhook. otpmanager.description:
OTP Manager is useful for those who use two-factor authentication (2FA) and want to manage their OTP codes securely and easily.
This application allows you to synchronise your OTP codes with your personal Nextcloud server so that you can access them from any device.

######

With OTP Manager, you no longer have to worry about losing your OTP codes or not having access to them when you need them.
All you have to do is synchronise your app with your Nextcloud server and you will always have your OTP codes at hand, wherever you are.

######

OTP Manager offers the convenient feature of importing OTP codes from Google Authenticator by scanning the QR code.
This means you don't have to worry about having to manually enter every single OTP code, but can simply scan the QR code that the Google app generates when exporting
accounts, and OTP Manager will automatically import your associated accounts.

######

pantry.description:
Pantry helps households stay organized in Nextcloud.

- **Houses** group members and their shared data. A person can belong to multiple houses and switch between them freely.
- **Checklists** support recurring items (e.g. milk every week) that automatically reappear when due. Share lists with the whole household so everyone knows what to pick up.
- **Shopping mode** turns your lists into a store-by-store trip — pick the lists and the route, check items off as you walk, see which housemates are out shopping, and finish with a priced review that lands in your shopping history.
- **Barcode scanning** prefills an item from a product's EAN or UPC. Scan with the camera or type the code in, and Pantry looks up the name, category and photo for you to review.
- **Custom fields** attach your own information to checklist items — an expiry date, an aisle number, a size, a yes/no flag. Define a field once for the house or a single list; date fields can send a reminder before they come due.
- **Photo boards** let you keep shared reference photos organized in folders — the right brand of dog food, a favorite recipe card, a product label, and so on.
- **Notes wall** gives the household a lightweight shared space for reminders, pinned messages, and quick notes with customizable colors.
- **Notifications** keep everyone in the loop when photos are uploaded or notes are added or edited.

All data is scoped to a house; members only see the houses they belong to.

Pantry also has companion apps for mobile, watch and desktop that let you manage your lists, photos and notes on the go and keep everything in sync with your Nextcloud instance.

**Companion apps:** Android ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.casraf.pantry), [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/en/packages/dev.casraf.pantry/)) | iOS/macOS ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pantry-for-nextcloud/id6762161619)) | Wear OS ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.casraf.pantry)) | [Windows](https://pantry.casraf.dev/docs/getting-started/apps#desktop) | [Linux](https://pantry.casraf.dev/docs/getting-started/apps#desktop)

paperless_sync.description:
### A native bridge between Paperless-ngx and Nextcloud

Paperless Sync mirrors finalized Paperless-ngx documents into a readable Nextcloud folder structure. Paperless remains the authoritative document archive while Nextcloud provides familiar access through Files, desktop sync, mobile apps, sharing, and its built-in viewer.

### Structured, automatic, and reversible

- Exports archive PDFs or original files through the Paperless API
- Builds a configurable hierarchy from correspondent, document type, date, title, and document ID
- Gives each Nextcloud user the documents they own in Paperless, through the one connection of the administrator (optional per-user ownership)
- Moves or renames files when Paperless metadata changes
- Skips Paperless inbox documents until they are finalized and removes previously mirrored copies when an exclusion tag is added
- Imports files from a configurable Nextcloud inbox into Paperless
- Sends a file or a folder to Paperless from its menu in Files, for a group of your choice, and opens the document of a mirrored copy in Paperless
- Sends files to Paperless by rules of Flow, such as every PDF that a member of a group uploads, with tags of their own
- Mirrors the Paperless trash into a dedicated Nextcloud folder
- Optionally removes files after they are permanently deleted from Paperless
- Removes empty archive folders after moves and deletions
- Runs through native Nextcloud background jobs with resumable state
- Mirrors a new or changed document within seconds when a workflow of Paperless calls its webhook, protected by a secret
- Notifies the administrators when the mirror keeps failing, with setup checks under Administration and a status API for monitors such as Uptime Kuma or Home Assistant

### Safe by default

Synchronization is disabled until an administrator completes and validates the configuration. Permanent deletion is an explicit opt-in and can be protected by multiple missing-document confirmations. A dry-run previews changes without modifying files.

The Paperless API token is stored server-side in Nextcloud's credentials manager and is never returned to the browser. The app operates directly through Nextcloud's filesystem API, so no Nextcloud password or WebDAV credential is required.

### Requirements

- Nextcloud 33 to 35 with reliable cron background jobs
- A reachable Paperless-ngx instance, version 2.16 or newer, 3.x included, with API access
- A dedicated Paperless service account with only the permissions needed for the enabled features

Paperless Sync is independent from [Paperless Unified Search](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/paperless_unified_search). Both apps understand stable document markers such as `[P123]` and can be installed separately.

paperless_unified_search.description:
Full-text search of your Paperless-ngx archive in Nextcloud's search bar, without Elasticsearch, a second index or another container: Paperless answers, Nextcloud decides who sees the file.

Find invoices, contracts, letters, statements, and any text recognized inside your documents, and open the synchronized file in Nextcloud's viewer — without leaving Nextcloud.

### Search in Paperless. Work in Nextcloud.

- Uses Paperless-ngx's native OCR and full-text search, with no index of its own to build or keep current
- Shows results directly in Nextcloud's global search, each with a preview of the document, its date in your language, its correspondent and its type
- Finds documents from the smart picker in Talk, Text, Deck, and Mail, and inserts a link to their file
- Lists the newest Paperless documents you can open on Nextcloud's dashboard, with the widget New in Paperless
- Opens the synchronized file in Nextcloud's built-in viewer on web, iOS, and Android
- Matches documents through stable markers such as `[P123]`
- Shows a document only to the users who may open its synchronized file
- Automatically excludes documents that have not yet been synchronized
- Diagnostics: the settings test the connection and keep a history of failed searches with their errors, also where the hoster keeps Nextcloud's log from administrators
- For administrators: set the app up and test it with occ, without a browser, ask occ why a user doesn't see a document, and see the state of the search in the overview of the administration settings

### Privacy and access control

Paperless is queried server-to-server. The API token is stored in Nextcloud's encrypted credentials manager and is never exposed to the browser.

By default, Nextcloud's search sends terms to Paperless only when users enable connected-services search, and the smart picker only when users pick Paperless documents in it; a client that asks the search API for this provider sends them as well. Administrators can optionally mark their Paperless server as trusted and include it automatically in every global search.

A dedicated, read-only Paperless account is recommended.

### Requirements

- Nextcloud 33 to 35
- A reachable Paperless-ngx instance with API access
- Synchronized files whose names contain their Paperless document marker, for example `[P123]`, owned by one Nextcloud account, the archive account, and shared read-only with the users who may see them

This app provides search integration only. It does not synchronize documents between Paperless and Nextcloud, and without such files the search shows no Paperless documents.

### Native synchronization companion

The independent [Paperless Sync](https://github.com/Dennis-Otto/paperless-sync) Nextcloud app writes these files into the archive account. Both apps use the same stable `[P123]` document marker and can be maintained and updated separately.

Documentation: <https://dennis-otto.github.io/paperless-unified-search/>

penpot_sync.description:
Penpot Sync turns a Nextcloud folder into a live mirror of a Penpot team.

Map a Penpot **team** to a folder and everything in it shows up: projects become folders, designs become real `.penpot` files with the Penpot icon. Click one and the live design opens in Penpot.

Nothing is matched on filename. Every file carries its design's id, so renaming, moving, copying, trashing and restoring never break the link — and re-running a sync never duplicates anything.

## ✨ What you can do

- 📁 **File your designs however you like** — the folder a design lands in becomes its Penpot project, at any depth
- 🚚 **Move** a design between projects, or into another team — same design, same history
- 🍝 **Copy** one, and get a real new design in Penpot
- 🗑️ **Trash, restore and purge**, mirrored into Penpot's own trash
- ➕ **Create** a design from the Files app, or drop a `.penpot` archive in to import it
- 🖱️ **Open in Penpot** with a click
- ⌨️ **Script all of it** — every admin action has an `occ` command

## 🗂️ The folder *is* the project

Penpot's hierarchy is rigid: team, then project, then design, with no sub-projects. Nextcloud is a file manager. So rather than force Penpot's flatness onto your folders, this teaches Penpot yours — a folder becomes a project the moment a design lands in it, and the path spells the name. A project called `Brand/2026` arrives here as two nested folders.

**Drafts is a state, not a folder.** A design that belongs to a team but no project simply sits at the root of the mapped folder. Filing it is a drag; un-filing it is a drag back.

## 🖌 It never edits a design Penpot already has

A `.penpot` export is an opaque archive of nested design data, so there is no "Edit as text" action and no content writeback. Design happens in Penpot; Nextcloud holds the archive and the click-through.

The one thing that travels upward is an archive Penpot has **never seen**: drop a `.penpot` into a mapped folder, or press **Sync to Penpot**, and it becomes a new design. Nothing existing is touched.

## 🗑️ Two trashes, and only one irreversible gesture

Penpot has a trash of its own, so trashing a design in Nextcloud is reversible on both sides — restore the file and the design comes back with its id, revision and history intact. Delete a design in Penpot and its mirror lands in your Nextcloud trash, never a hard delete.

Only emptying your Nextcloud trash destroys anything, and even then only a design still sitting in Penpot's trash.

## 🧭 Sync or Link — the folder decides

| Mode | The file holds | Keeps a copy? |
|---|---|---|
| **Link** *(default)* | A pointer — zero bytes | No — clicking it opens Penpot |
| **Sync** | The real `.penpot` archive | Yes — yours to open offline |

The mode decides whether the bytes live on your Nextcloud, never whether the design can be opened. A `sync` mapping is therefore also a real backup: every design in the team, exported and versioned by Nextcloud.

## 🎨 Honest icons, honest dates

Designs register their own mimetype, so they wear the real Penpot icon instead of a generic archive glyph. And each file carries **the design's** created and modified dates rather than the sync's — so Recent, Popular files and sorting a folder by date all tell you the truth about your work.

📖 **[Full documentation, screenshots and the `occ` reference on GitHub](https://github.com/kubed-io/nextcloud-penpot#readme)**

Requires the `enable-access-tokens` flag on your Penpot instance — it is off by default upstream. This app is in early development: it works end to end and is covered by tests against a real Penpot, but has not yet been run widely.

---

This is a community integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Penpot (Kaleidos Ventures SL). "Penpot" and the Penpot logo are trademarks of their respective owner, used here only to identify the service this app integrates with.

phonetrack.description:
# PhoneTrack Nextcloud application

📱 PhoneTrack is a Nextcloud application to track and store mobile device's locations.

🗺 It receives information from mobile phone's logging apps and displays it dynamically on a map.

🌍 Help us to translate this app on [PhoneTrack Crowdin project](https://crowdin.com/project/phonetrack).

⚒ Check out other ways to help in the [contribution guidelines](https://gitlab.com/eneiluj/phonetrack-oc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

How to use PhoneTrack :

- Create a tracking session.
- Give the logging link\* to the mobile devices. Choose the [logging method](https://github.com/julien-nc/phonetrack/blob/main/doc/user.md#logging-methods) you prefer.
- Watch the session's devices location in real time (or not) in PhoneTrack or share it with public pages.

(\*) Don't forget to set the device name in the link (rather than in the logging app settings). Replace "yourname" with the desired device name.
Setting the device name in logging app settings only works with Owntracks, Traccar and OpenGTS.

On PhoneTrack main page, while watching a session, you can :

- 📍 Display location history
- ⛛ Filter points
- ✎ Manually edit/add/delete points
- ✎ Edit devices (rename, change colour/shape, move to another session)
- ⛶ Define geofencing zones for devices
- ⚇ Define proximity alerts for device pairs
- 🖧 Share a session to other Nextcloud users or with a public link (read-only)
- 🔗 Generate public share links with optional restrictions (filters, device name, last positions only, geofencing simplification)
- 🖫 Import/export a session in GPX format (one file with one track per device or one file per device)
- 🗠 Display sessions statistics
- 🔒 [Reserve a device name](https://github.com/julien-nc/phonetrack/blob/main/doc/user.md#device-name-reservation) to make sure only authorized user can log with this name
- 🗓 Toggle session auto export and auto purge (daily/weekly/monthly)
- ◔ Choose what to do when point number quota is reached (block logging or delete oldest point)

Public page and public filtered page work like main page except there is only one session displayed, everything is read-only and there is no need to be logged in.

This app is under development.

## Install

See the [AdminDoc](https://gitlab.com/eneiluj/phonetrack-oc/wikis/admindoc) for installation details.

Check [CHANGELOG](https://gitlab.com/eneiluj/phonetrack-oc/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#change-log) file to see what's new and what's coming in next release.

Check [AUTHORS](https://gitlab.com/eneiluj/phonetrack-oc/blob/master/AUTHORS.md#authors) file to see complete list of authors.

## Known issues

- PhoneTrack **now works** with Nextcloud group restriction activated. See [admindoc](https://github.com/julien-nc/phonetrack/blob/main/doc/admin.md#issue-with-phonetrack-restricted-to-some-groups-in-nextcloud).

Any feedback will be appreciated.



## Donation

I develop this app during my free time.

* [Donate with Paypal](https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=66PALMY8SF5JE) (you don't need a paypal account)
* [Donate with Liberapay : ![Donate using Liberapay](https://liberapay.com/assets/widgets/donate.svg)](https://liberapay.com/eneiluj/donate)

pipelinq.description:
Pipelinq is a lightweight CRM for Nextcloud. Manage clients, track leads through visual pipelines, handle incoming requests, and keep a complete history of every interaction — all without leaving your Nextcloud workspace.

**Key Features**

- **Client management** — Track persons and organizations with contact details, notes, and full history
- **Contact persons** — Link individuals to organizations with roles like sales manager or project lead
- **Lead pipeline** — Drag-and-drop kanban board with configurable stages, values, and close probabilities
- **Request intake** — Capture incoming requests before they become formal cases
- **Contact moments** — Log calls, emails, visits, and other interactions with clients
- **My Work queue** — Personal overview of your assigned leads, requests, and follow-ups
- **Nextcloud Contacts sync** — Two-way sync with the native Contacts app via CardDAV
- **Duplicate detection** — Provided via OpenRegister master-data management, flagging clients with matching names or emails
- **Import and export** — vCard contact import and export via Nextcloud Contacts, plus scheduled CSV data exports
- **Activity and notifications** — Stay updated on assignments, stage changes, and new notes

Pairs naturally with [Procest](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/procest) for case management. A direct request-to-case handoff bridge is in development (openspec change `semantic-handoff-emit`).

**Requires:** [OpenRegister](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/openregister) (install from the [Nextcloud App Store](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/openregister)).

Free and open source under the EUPL-1.2 license.

**Support:** For support, contact support@conduction.nl. For a Service Level Agreement (SLA), contact sales@conduction.nl.

previewgenerator.description:
The Preview Generator app allows admins to pre-generate previews. The app listens to edit events and stores this information. Once a cron job is triggered it will generate start preview generation. This means that you can better utilize your system by pre-generating previews when your system is normally idle and thus putting less load on your machine when the requests are actually served.

The app does not replace on demand preview generation so if a preview is requested before it is pre-generated it will still be shown.
The first time you install this app, before using a cron job, you properly want to generate all previews via:
**occ preview:generate-all -vvv**

The preview queue will be processed automatically by a background job if the system cron background job mode is configured in Nextcloud. Additionally, you may run **occ preview:pre-generate -vvv** to a process the queue of pending previews immediately.

prinotes.description:
PriNotes is a feature-rich, privacy-first note-taking application for Nextcloud that keeps your data on your own server.

## Features

**Web Editor**
- Rich block editor: headings, paragraphs, lists, checklists, code blocks, quotes, dividers
- Full-canvas freehand drawing support
- Image attachments with resize and rotate
- Per-note color coding
- Pin important notes to the top

**Organisation**
- Notebooks — group notes into colour-coded collections
- Tags — cross-notebook labels with colour support

**Security & Privacy**

- App-wide PIN + biometric lock (Android)

**Android App**
- Native offline-first Android client with automatic background sync
- Grid and list view with live preview

## Android App Installation

profile_fields.description:
Profile fields lets organizations extend Nextcloud user profiles with customizable fields, per-field access control, and integration-friendly APIs.

Create custom fields for support regions, product specialties, escalation aliases, customer segments, internal access levels, and any other organization-specific context that does not belong in the default profile.

Each field is governed by edit and visibility rules so teams can combine self-service updates with admin-managed data, keeping sensitive operational context accurate without losing usability for employees, partners, and support teams.

## Donation

Developed with ❤️ by [LibreCode](https://librecode.coop). Ongoing maintenance, bug fixes, and long-term sustainability depend on community support.

projectcheck.description:
# Projects, time and budgets — in one place.

ProjectCheck keeps customers, projects, people, time entries and optional budgets on the Nextcloud you already host. Book time against projects. Resolve hourly rates on the server from dated history. See remaining budget before the month runs away.

**Free web app** (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Companion apps: https://nextcloud.software-by-design.de/

## Why teams install it

- **Run the portfolio** — customers and projects with status, dates, search and sort
- **Invite the right people** — Nextcloud users with roles and permissions per project
- **Book and export time** — browse, filter and export entries against projects
- **Price with a history** — server-side rates from project, employee master data or per-person on the project; append-only rate history
- **Watch the numbers** — optional budgets and remaining visibility; dashboard overview; files on projects

## Clear limits

- Mobile may preview rates; the server stays authoritative.
- Prefer `ProjectCheck*` in new integrations — `ProjectControl*` / `OCA.ProjectControl` are deprecated aliases.

## Feedback welcome

We improve this app with real-world use. Bug reports, rough edges, and ideas help — open a GitHub Issue (https://github.com/aSoftwareByDesignRepository/nextcloud-projectcheck/issues) or write to info@software-by-design.de. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

## Requirements

projectmanager.description:
Multi-project hour and progress tracker. Break work into estimated
Points grouped into Sections, log day-to-day work as Leaves, and let the app compute
done/remaining hours automatically from a largest-remainder percentage split per point
and day. Track Milestones with the client (how and when something was presented, and
its perceived acceptance), plus a Tests (validation log) view and .xlsx export.

public_share_control.description:
Public Share Control gives share owners and administrators more control over what visitors can do on public folder links.

**Restrict the "New" menu per link.** In a link's sharing settings, the owner chooses which entries of the "New" menu visitors see — for example, allow uploads but hide "New folder", text documents, spreadsheets, whiteboards or "Add folder description". Uploading itself always stays available.

**One-click uploads for visitors.** Links that allow uploads get an "Upload files" button right next to "Public share", on every screen size. Name conflicts are handled with Nextcloud's own dialog (Cancel, Keep both, Replace). File requests keep Nextcloud's own upload page.

**Defaults and restrictions for administrators** (Administration settings → Sharing):

- *Hidden by default:* entries hidden on every link whose owner hasn't changed the selection.
- *Forbidden:* entries hidden on all links, including existing ones. Owners can't turn them back on.
- A switch to turn the "Upload files" button off for the whole server.

Hiding menu entries changes what visitors see, not what the link permits: a link that allows uploads still lets visitors create files by other means, e.g. WebDAV.

pulse.description:
**Live polls, word clouds and quizzes for presentations — in your own Nextcloud.**
Pulse is a self-hosted alternative to services such as Kahoot!, Mentimeter or
Slido. The presenter opens a room and shows its six-character code on the
projector; the audience joins through a public link, without a Nextcloud
account, and votes from their own phone. Results appear live.

### Polls
Anonymous, with multiple choice, word cloud, scale (single slider, spectrum
radar or compass), ranking and matching.

### Quizzes
With nicknames, points and a leaderboard: multiple choice, true/false,
multiple answers, number guess, free text graded afterwards, ranking and
matching.
- **Moderated:** the presenter shows one question after another and everybody
  answers at the same time — with a countdown and points for speed.
- **Self-paced:** everybody works through the quiz alone on their own phone —
  as a race in the room or as homework with a deadline.

### For presenting
- Decks of several questions, an image per question
- Projector view, QR code and join link
- Practice runs; reveal after each question or at the end
- Summary with CSV export
- Add-in to embed Pulse in PowerPoint slides

### Good to know
- An anonymous token in a cookie discourages voting twice without identifying
  anyone; whoever clears their cookies can vote again.
- Rooms that nobody has used for 30 days are deleted automatically.
- Pulse is vibe-coded: its code, tests, documentation and German translation
  were written by AI coding agents (Anthropic's Claude Code); the maintainer
  set the goals, made the product decisions and tried the app out in the

pwa_suite.description:
PWA Suite lets you fully customize the Progressive Web App (PWA) experience of your Nextcloud instance:

    - Custom manifest.json configuration (name, icons, theme and background colors).
    - Every Nextcloud app gets its own manifest id, so each app can be installed as a separate PWA.

qownnotes.description:
QOwnNotes for Nextcloud lets you view and edit the notes of your [QOwnNotes](https://www.qownnotes.org) note folder in the Nextcloud web interface, including note subfolders and the tags stored in the note folder's `notes.sqlite`.

It also provides the server APIs for the [QOwnNotes desktop app](https://www.qownnotes.org) (note versions and trash) and the [QOwnNotes Android app](https://github.com/qownnotes/qownnotes-android) (a Nextcloud Notes API compatible note API), and replaces the QOwnNotesAPI app.

- **Plain files:** notes stay Markdown files in your Nextcloud, organized in note subfolders like in QOwnNotes Desktop
- **Tags:** hierarchical tags with colors, shared with QOwnNotes Desktop and Android through the note folder's `notes.sqlite`
- **Web interface:** note list, subfolder and tag trees, Markdown editor with preview, conflict handling, versions and deleted notes
- **Integrations:** dashboard widget, unified search (also by tags), link previews and "Open in QOwnNotes" in Files
- **API-only mode:** administrators can disable the web interface and only provide the APIs

Tags need the PHP extension `pdo_sqlite`. If you switch from the QOwnNotesAPI or Notes app, see the [migration guide](https://github.com/qownnotes/qownnotes-nextcloud/blob/main/docs/migration.md).

qownnotesapi.description:
**QOwnNotesAPI is deprecated.** Nextcloud users are encouraged to switch to **[QOwnNotes for Nextcloud](https://github.com/qownnotes/qownnotes-nextcloud)**, its recommended successor.

The new app provides the APIs for QOwnNotes Desktop and Android, plus a web interface for editing notes with subfolders and tags. Read the **[migration guide](https://github.com/qownnotes/qownnotes-nextcloud/blob/main/docs/migration.md)** for installation and client compatibility requirements before removing QOwnNotesAPI.

QOwnNotes for Nextcloud does not support ownCloud; ownCloud users cannot migrate to it.

QOwnNotesAPI is the Nextcloud/ownCloud API for QOwnNotes, the open source notepad for Linux, macOS, Windows and Android, that works together with the notes application of Nextcloud/ownCloud.

The only purpose of this App is to provide API access to your Nextcloud/ownCloud server for the [QOwnNotes desktop app](https://www.qownnotes.org) and the [QOwnNotes Android app](https://github.com/qownnotes/qownnotes-android). You cannot use this App for anything else if you don't use one of these QOwnNotes apps!

quantumchess.description:
**Quantum Chess** is chess in which a piece can stand on two squares at once, until something asks where it really is. It lives inside your Nextcloud: challenge colleagues and family with the notifications, avatars and dashboard you already use. Twenty-one chess variants, from Bee Flow Chess and 5D chess with multiverse time travel to shogi and xiangqi, bring the same quantum rules to other boards.

### How it plays
- Pieces move as in chess. There is no check: capture the enemy king to win, or leave it no escape.
- **Split** a knight, bishop, rook or queen onto two empty squares and it becomes a ghost with exact odds. **Merge** the parts back together; merging onto an enemy piece captures it, for certain when every part surely arrives.
- **Land = roll, pass = link.** Landing on a square that might hold a piece, every pawn move and every king step is settled by a fair roll: Captured, Moved or Missed. Sliding past a maybe-occupied square rolls nothing, but links the pieces.
- **Measure** one of your own ghosts to find out where it really is.
- Kings and pawns are always solid. Every roll shows its odds before you move and explains itself afterwards.

### Play
- 👥 **Online** correspondence games with anyone on your Nextcloud: invitations and open challenges, 1, 3 or 7 days per move, draw offers, rematches, chat with quick phrases, Elo ratings and an opt-in leaderboard
- 🤖 **Computer**: the built-in engine with five levels, from Wobbles to The Observer, running in your browser
- ✨ **AI opponents** with a personality, powered by Nextcloud Assistant, your organisation's provider or your own API key (OpenAI-compatible services such as OpenAI, Mistral, OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini, Ollama or LocalAI, and Anthropic)
- 🪑 **Pass & play** on one device

### Chess variants
- **Multiverse chess (5D)**, the quantum version of 5D Chess With Multiverse Time Travel: timelines side by side, pieces that travel back in time and to other timelines, turns with a move on every board that must move, and ghosts across the whole multiverse, past boards included; every official piece and 44 official start positions, starting on the quick 5 × 5 board
- **Bee Flow Chess**, named after Bee-Flow, the private AI workspace: protect your Queen Bee, with shuffled back ranks, enemy pieces hidden until they move, and a privacy shield around the queen
- Nineteen more variants: 3D chess, Tri-Dimensional chess and 4D chess; Kriegspiel and Fog of war; Chess960, Atomic, Crazyhouse, Bughouse, Antichess, King of the Hill, Three-check and Horde; Hexagonal, Four-player and Capablanca chess; Shogi, Xiangqi and Makruk
- Every variant keeps the quantum rules (split, merge, measure, land = roll, pass = link) and, where they fit, the classic end rules: capture the king, or leave it no escape
- Play the built-in computer (Easy, Normal or Hard) or pass & play for two or four players, with a hand-over screen for the hidden-information variants
- Made for phones too: large boards zoom with a pinch and pan with a finger
- Played on your own device: online play and ratings stay with classic Quantum Chess

### Learn
- Eleven short interactive lessons: the essentials in about ten minutes
- Eleven machine-verified puzzles
- A coach with an evaluation bar, hints, threat warnings and move-quality badges, plus an AI coach you can ask about the position
- Post-game review with an evaluation graph and the key moments of the game

### Native and fair
- Built with Nextcloud's own components: light, dark and high-contrast themes, keyboard and screen-reader support, phone, tablet and desktop layouts
- Notifications with actions in the web, mobile and desktop clients, and a dashboard widget
- Online rolls are drawn by the server at the moment a move is applied and chained together, so later changes to moves you have seen show up; the coach stays off in your running online games
- API keys are stored encrypted on your server and never reach the browser. Nothing is sent anywhere except to the AI provider you choose.
- In English, Dutch, German and French

quota_warning.description:

rechnungswerk.description:
# RechnungsWerk

Schlanke Nextcloud-App zum Erstellen von Rechnungen und **E-Rechnungen** (ZUGFeRD/EN16931)
für deutsche Unternehmen — mit frei wählbarem Empfänger pro Rechnung und automatischer
Übergabe an DATEV, ohne den starren Zwang von DATEV Auftragswesen Next.

## Features

- **Rechnungs-Editor** — Positionen mit Menge, Maßeinheit, Einzelpreis und USt-Satz pro Zeile, Live-Summen
- **ZUGFeRD-Erzeugung** — eine lesbare PDF, die zugleich eine gültige E-Rechnung ist (PDF/A-3 + EN16931-CII-XML)
- **Festschreibung** — GoBD-konform: Entwurf → festgeschrieben (unveränderbar) → Storno/Gutschrift
