recognize.description:
Smart media tagging and face recognition with on-premises machine learning models.
This app goes through your media collection and adds fitting tags, automatically categorizing your photos and music.

* 📷 👪 Recognizes faces from contact photos
* 📷 🏔 Recognizes animals, landscapes, food, vehicles, buildings and other objects
* 📷 🗼 Recognizes landmarks and monuments
* 👂 🎵 Recognizes music genres
* 🎥 🤸 Recognizes human actions on video

⚡ Tagging works via Nextcloud's Collaborative Tags
  * 👂 listen to your tagged music with the audioplayer app
  * 📷 view your tagged photos and videos with the photos app

Model sizes:

 * Object recognition: 1GB
 * Landmark recognition: 300MB
 * Video action recognition: 50MB
 * Music genre recognition: 50MB

## Ethical AI Rating
### Rating for Photo object detection: 🟢

Positive:
* the software for training and inference of this model is open source
* the trained model is freely available, and thus can be run on-premises
* the training data is freely available, making it possible to check or correct for bias or optimise the performance and CO2 usage.

### Rating for Photo face recognition: 🟢

Positive:
* the software for training and inference of this model is open source
* the trained model is freely available, and thus can be run on-premises
* the training data is freely available, making it possible to check or correct for bias or optimise the performance and CO2 usage.

### Rating for Video action recognition: 🟢

Positive:
* the software for training and inferencing of this model is open source
* the trained model is freely available, and thus can be ran on-premises
* the training data is freely available, making it possible to check or correct for bias or optimise the performance and CO2 usage.

## Ethical AI Rating
### Rating Music genre recognition: 🟡

Positive:
* the software for training and inference of this model is open source
* the trained model is freely available, and thus can be run on-premises

Negative:
* the training data is not freely available, limiting the ability of external parties to check and correct for bias or optimise the model’s performance and CO2 usage.

Learn more about the Nextcloud Ethical AI Rating [in our blog](https://nextcloud.com/blog/nextcloud-ethical-ai-rating/).

After installation, you can enable tagging in the admin settings.

Requirements:
- php 7.4 and above
- App "collaborative tags" enabled
- For native speed:
  - Processor: x86 64-bit (with support for AVX instructions)
  - System with glibc (usually the norm on Linux; FreeBSD, Alpine linux and thus also the official Nextcloud Docker container and Nextcloud AIO are *not* such systems)
- For sub-native speed (using WASM mode)
  - Processor: x86 64-bit, arm64, armv7l (no AVX needed)
  - System with glibc or musl (incl. Alpine linux and thus also the official Nextcloud Docker container and also Nextcloud AIO)
- ~4GB of free RAM (if you're cutting it close, make sure you have some swap available)

The app does not send any sensitive data to cloud providers or similar services. All processing is done on your Nextcloud machine, using Tensorflow.js running in Node.js.

regibase.description:
RegiBase is a lightweight personal database for the information you want to keep — credit cards, bank accounts, online accounts, memberships, licenses, contacts and anything else.

Design your own fields (or start from a template), then browse records as a list, a spreadsheet-style table (with a frozen first column), or cards, and choose per field which of those views it appears in.

RegiBase works together with your other Nextcloud apps — Contacts, Tables, Files, Notes and Calendar — using each one when it is installed.

Features:
- Custom form fields with per-field input rules, built from reusable templates
- Save your own templates, and edit the built-in ones (per-user override, resettable to default)
- Duplicate a collection — optionally including all of its records
- Share a collection with Nextcloud users or groups at three levels (view / edit / delete), with an optional access password and optional secret-field sharing
- Optional client-side encryption (AES-GCM) for secret fields — the server never sees the key or the plaintext
- Nextcloud Tables integration: import a table into a new collection, or export a collection to a new Tables table
- Import from CSV / JSON (e.g. Google Password Manager), or from your Nextcloud Contacts (including photos)
- Attach images and files from Nextcloud Files or Notes
- Add reminders to Nextcloud Calendar from date fields, and open addresses in a map (Google Maps / Yahoo! Maps / OpenStreetMap / Apple Maps / Bing Maps), configurable per collection
- Move / copy / merge records between collections
- Password-protected full backup & restore (AES-256 ZIP)
- Command-line access via occ — list / get / export / find (with regex), plus master-key management (set / change / remove) — with opt-in secret decryption
- An AI assistant, through the AI-Hub app: a chat beside the open collection that answers in words and writes out what to type. It never sees the value of a secret field. Without AI-Hub it is simply not shown
- Available in 21 languages (Portuguese in both Brazilian and European forms)

registration.description:
User registration

This app allows users to register a new account.

# Features

- Add users to a given group
- Allow-list with email domains (including wildcard) to register with
- Administrator will be notified via email for new user creation or require approval
- Supports Nextcloud's Client Login Flow v1 and v2 - allowing registration in the mobile Apps and Desktop clients

# Web form registration flow

1. User enters their email address
2. Verification link is sent to the email address
3. User clicks on the verification link
4. User is lead to a form where they can choose their username and password
5. New account is created and is logged in automatically

reinhardterp.description:
Betrio is an ERP and project management solution designed specifically for trades and craft businesses and integrated directly into Nextcloud.

The app combines commercial and operational workflows in one central application – from customers and projects to quotations, orders and invoices, as well as work reports, time tracking, materials, documents and mobile on-site processes.

Features:

- Customer management and CRM with structured private, business and public-sector customers
- Extended customer search plus deletion and anonymization of customer master data
- CSV customer import with automatic detection, manual field mapping, preview and duplicate checks (Betrio Pro)
- Project management and digital project files
- Quotations and orders
- Invoices
- Progress and final invoices
- Credit notes and cancellations
- Payment status and incoming payments
- Outstanding and overdue receivables
- PDF invoices
- XRechnung
- ZUGFeRD / Factur-X using the EN16931 profile (Betrio Pro)
- Invoice audit trail and invoice finalization
- Quotation → order → invoice workflow
- Work reports with signature and PDF
- Time tracking and evaluation
- Material and inventory management
- DATANORM import with preview and supplier assignment
- Inventory assistant and inventory list as PDF
- Supplier filtering and sorting in the material master data
- PDF evaluations for working time, billing, finance, taxes and project post-calculation
- Documents, photos and project files
- Smart Document Inbox for incoming documents
- Digital attendance clock with breaks and manual corrections
- Individual work schedules and working-time account
- Vacation, sickness, training and other absences
- Workforce planning and team calendar
- Appointments and project timeline
- Financial overviews and open items
- Cash book and tax overviews
- DATEV EXTF export
- Mobile smartphone interface
- Camera and barcode functions
- Integration with Nextcloud Files
- German and English user interface

Attendance time, project time and planned time are deliberately kept separate. The working-time account supports individual target hours per weekday, approved absences, a configurable start date and an opening balance.

After an update, Betrio shows each user a one-time overview of important changes. Release information remains available under Help → What's new?.

A separate Android app, “Betrio Mobile”, is also available.

Betrio runs directly within your own Nextcloud installation. Customer, project and business data therefore do not need to be moved to a separate ERP cloud to operate Betrio.

Betrio is offered in Community and Pro editions. The Community edition remains free to use. A valid Betrio Pro licence unlocks additional professional features. The Pro licence can be activated and managed directly in Betrio. Changing editions or ending a Pro licence does not delete existing customers, projects or documents.

The commercial functions support the workflow from quotation and order through invoicing to payment receipt. Finalized invoices and relevant actions are documented through the invoice audit trail.

A DATEV EXTF export is available for exchanging accounting data.

XRechnung is integrated and continues to be developed and validated.

Betrio does not replace tax or legal advice. Accounting and export functions should be checked against the requirements of your business and, where appropriate, coordinated with your tax adviser before productive use.

remotestorage.description:

requrvhive.description:
**ReQurv Hive** brings AI into your [Nextcloud](https://nextcloud.com) — private, self-hosted, and under your control. All model calls are served by [ReQurv AI Hive](https://hive.requrv.ai), ReQurv's private and secure OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint.

### Nextcloud App

- **Chat** — Converse with an AI assistant about your files and documents
- **Projects** — Scope a conversation to selected folders, so the assistant only sees what you choose
- **Coworkers** — Save repeatable AI jobs and run them on demand or on a schedule
- **Summarise & rewrite** — Condense, draft, rephrase and proofread text
- **Model picker** — Switch model per conversation
- **Usage metrics** — Token and conversation counters exported via OpenMetrics

### AI provider

**ReQurv AI Hive** — OpenAI-compatible API hosted by ReQurv at hive.requrv.ai. The API key
is configured once by the admin and stored encrypted; the base URL is an admin-only setting.
Provider choice applies to chat and to the Nextcloud Assistant integrations alike.
Assistant actions that send images need a vision-capable model.

### MCP Server

ReQurv Hive includes a [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server with 316 tools that gives any MCP client — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Claude.ai and the Claude mobile app, Cursor, VS Code and others — direct access to your Nextcloud:

- **Files & sharing** — Browse, read, write, search, share, tag, and restore from trash or older versions
- **Calendar, Tasks & Contacts** — Events, to-dos and address books over CalDAV and CardDAV, plus Deck boards and Projects
- **Talk, Mail & Notifications** — Conversations, polls and reactions, mail accounts and messages, notification triage
- **Photos & Maps** — Albums and metadata, GPS tracks and devices, favourites, and photo geotagging
- **Notes, News, Recipes & Bookmarks** — Markdown notes, RSS feeds, recipes, and bookmark folders and tags
- **Coworkers & administration** — Run saved AI jobs, manage users, groups and apps, run `occ`, and check integrity

### Resources

- [ReQurv AI Hive](https://hive.requrv.ai)

---

ReQurv Hive is based on [AIquila](https://github.com/elgorro/aiquila) by

app) and MIT (MCP server and repository). Modified by ReQurv since 2026-09-25.

richdocumentscode.description:
**This app has to be installed and used together with the [Nextcloud Office](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/richdocuments) integration app.**

Collabora Online is a powerful LibreOffice-based online office suite with collaborative editing, which supports all major documents, spreadsheet and presentation file formats and works together with all modern browsers.

* This app provides a built-in server with all of the document editing features of Collabora Online.
* Easy to install, for personal use or for small teams.
* A bit slower than a standalone server and without the advanced scalability features.

**System Requirements:**
- Linux running on ```x86-64``` or ```arm64/aarch64```
- A ```glibc``` based distribution/container (```musl libc``` is **not** supported)
- Fontconfig (```libfontconfig.so.1```)
- Additional requirements can be found in [here](https://github.com/CollaboraOnline/richdocumentscode#richdocumentscode)

*The download is rather big so it is possible you will experience a time-out when installing via the web interface.* You can use the OCC command install the built-in server from the command-line instead:

```
sudo -u wwwrun php -d memory_limit=512M ./occ app:install richdocumentscode
```
Where `wwwrun` is the user of your web server. This is ```www-data``` on Debian, Ubuntu and derivatives, `wwwrun` on SUSE based distributions, `apache` on Red Hat/Fedora and `http` on Arch linux and derivatives.

Updates can be done like this:
```
sudo -u wwwrun php -d memory_limit=512M ./occ app:update --all
```

Of course, alternatively you could increase memory usage and PHP time-outs by default, see the [Nextcloud documentation.](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/admin_manual/configuration_files/big_file_upload_configuration.html?highlight=php%20timeout#configuring-your-web-server)

Additional troubleshooting tips can be found [here](https://github.com/CollaboraOnline/richdocumentscode?tab=readme-ov-file#troubleshooting).

runbook.description:
# Runbook

**Runbook** is a Nextcloud application for creating, executing and tracking repeatable procedures.

It transforms static checklists and procedural documents into structured, collaborative workflows that teams can execute consistently and trace from start to finish.

Teams can create reusable runbook templates for operational procedures such as server deployments, employee onboarding, maintenance routines, security reviews, production releases, audits, month-end processes and any other repeatable activity.

Each runbook execution creates an independent historical snapshot of the procedure. Steps can be assigned to users, completed individually, supplied with structured responses, comments and supporting evidence, while Runbook maintains a complete activity history of the execution.

Runbook integrates naturally with Nextcloud users and groups for access control, assignments and collaboration while keeping its own data model and business logic isolated from the rest of the platform.

Its purpose is simple:

**Turn procedures into repeatable, accountable and traceable execution.**

### Core capabilities

Runbook allows teams to:

- Create reusable procedure templates with sections and ordered steps.
- Start independent runs from published templates.
- Assign runs and individual steps to Nextcloud users.
- Share templates and runs with Nextcloud users and groups.
- Collect confirmations, text, numbers, dates, selections and files during execution.
- Add comments and operational evidence.
- Track progress, deadlines and overdue work.
- Maintain a complete execution history.
- Search templates and runs through Nextcloud.
- Surface assigned work from the Nextcloud Dashboard.
- Configure application policies from Nextcloud Administration Settings.
- Use the application in multiple languages through the standard Nextcloud translation system.

Runbook does not modify Nextcloud users, groups or global permissions. Nextcloud identities are only referenced for authentication, assignment and access control.

Runbook is designed to be useful for IT, operations, HR, finance, quality, security, customer service, facilities and any other team that relies on repeatable procedures.

s3_api.description:
**Point any S3 client at a Nextcloud folder.**

Mark a folder as a bucket in your personal settings, create an API key, and use it with the AWS
CLI, boto3, rclone or any other S3-compatible client. The files stay ordinary Nextcloud files —
visible in the web UI, synced by the desktop client, shareable, versioned. Nothing is duplicated
into a separate object store.

Rather than the handful of calls a file sync needs, this implements the parts that make an S3
endpoint usable as a real backend:

* Conditional writes (`If-Match` / `If-None-Match`) that serialise concurrent writers, so the
  store works as a compare-and-swap primitive
* Multipart uploads, including `UploadPartCopy` for server-side compose
* Ranged and conditional reads, delimited listings, presigned URLs
* Streaming uploads — bodies are never buffered in memory, and `aws-chunked` payloads have their
  per-chunk signature chain verified
* Correct S3 ETags (content MD5, compound form for multipart) rather than Nextcloud's internal
  etag, which is too coarse to build a compare-and-swap on

Authentication is AWS Signature V4, via header or presigned URL. Each API key is scoped to exactly
one bucket and is either readonly or readwrite.

Verified against [gits3](https://github.com/markuman/gits3srv), a git server that keeps bare
repositories in a bucket: its own S3 client and a real push / clone / gc cycle run against this
app in the test suite, exercising compare-and-swap, content ETags, ranged reads and delimited
listings.

**Note:** every request passes through PHP and Nextcloud's storage layer. This is a convenient way
to talk S3 to data you already keep in Nextcloud — not a replacement for a high-throughput object
store.

samewindow.description:
**🔗 Same Window for Nextcloud**

This app ensures that all links on frontend widgets open in the same window/tab instead of opening new windows or tabs in the browser. This provides a more seamless user experience by keeping users within the current Nextcloud interface.

## ✨ Features

- **🔗 Automatic link modification** - Converts all widget links to open in the same window
- **⌨️ Modifier key support** - Ctrl/Cmd/Shift+click and middle-click still open new tabs/windows
- **🎯 Widget-only targeting** - Only affects links within widgets, not navigation elements
- **⚡ Dynamic content support** - Works with content loaded via AJAX through mutation observers
- **🚫 No configuration required** - Works out of the box with no admin settings needed

## 🛠️ How it Works

The app automatically detects links with `target="_blank"` or `target="_new"` attributes within widget areas and modifies their behavior to open in the same window. Users can still override this behavior using:
- **Middle-click** - Opens in new tab

## 💻 Compatibility
- Nextcloud 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34 & 35

santacloud.description:
**SantaCloud is an advent calendar for Nextcloud**
- ✅ Create your own content for the doors - e.g. competitions, reciepts, poems...
- ✅ Offer your customers entertainment during the Advent season.
- ✅ With built-in test mode.
- ✅ Easy setup via Backend.

savapage.description:
## Print from Nextcloud to SavaPage

Send documents directly from Nextcloud to a [SavaPage](https://www.savapage.org) print server.

- Send a **single file** from the Files app context menu.
- **Batch print** multiple files or whole folders; folders are expanded recursively on the server.
- Allowed file types are enforced server-side, so only printable documents are sent.
- Credentials are managed per user and can be synced automatically from SavaPage, or overridden by users when the administrator allows it.
- Dedicated **SavaPage** sections in both Administration and Personal settings.

### Requirements

- Nextcloud 28 – 35
- PHP 8.3+
- A reachable SavaPage server

### Installation

Install SavaPage Print from the [Nextcloud App Store](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/savapage), or download a release archive and enable it in your `apps` directory.

### How it works

When you choose *Print to SavaPage*, the app uploads the document to your SavaPage server (`{Server URI}/restful/v1/documents/print`) using your personal SavaPage ID and UUID. SavaPage then holds the document in its print queue for you to release at the printer.

[Read the full documentation](https://www.savapage.org) for administrator and user guides.

scim_client.description:
Use Nextcloud as an identity provider for external services using the [SCIM](https://scim.cloud/) standard.

Simply add your SCIM servers in the admin settings, and the app will automatically sync all Nextcloud users and groups to your servers.

scoreview.description:
ScoreView displays MuseScore scores (.mscz) directly from Files - as faithful
MuseScore notation (SVG) with a playback cursor that follows client-side
synthesized MIDI playback in sync, instead of a static PDF export.

Made for choir and ensemble work: the notation looks like the sheet music you
already know, every voice can be heard on its own, and every measure is one
click away.

An uploaded .mscz file is converted once, server-side, to notation pages (SVG),
MIDI and timing data, then cached: opening the same file again does not
re-render, it is served from the cache. Only a change to the file triggers a
new conversion.

There are two equivalent conversion paths that produce the same result. The
default one needs no configuration at all and no container: MuseScore as
WebAssembly, executed by the server's Node.js runtime - everything it needs
ships with the app, and the server fetches the SoundFont for playback on its
own. Alternatively a MuseScore container next to Nextcloud does the
converting. If the server can run neither, the browser converts instead -
without a cache, as a fallback.

Feature set: zoom presets, fullscreen and auto-scrolling in time with playback;
a freely configurable playback highlight (sounding notes or a bar, in a colour
of your choice);
measure navigation, looping over a measure range, click-to-note jump and
keyboard shortcuts; a mixer with per-voice volume/mute/solo, a "my voice"
preset, tempo in BPM and a metronome; annotations anchored to musical
position (private or shared, surviving a re-upload); touch controls with
pinch-zoom for a tablet on the music stand.

For practice, choir rehearsal and concert: the starting note of your own voice
or the key note, your own voice in the stereo image, a speed trainer in the
loop, light notes on a dark background, a performance mode with page turning by
key or pedal; a leader role per score with voice notes, rehearsal stamps and
rehearsal marks in the navigation; "Follow me" - the leader sends position,
loop and starting note to every device (below one second with notify_push)
and lets them follow silently while it plays;
setlists as a Markdown file with piece changes inside the viewer; own
recordings only the person recording can hear, and intonation feedback while
singing. The Nextcloud mobile apps open the viewer too - the Android app
without the microphone; so far only Android has been tested.

On the go and on a phone: practice tracks as MP3 files in Files - the current
mix, optionally one per voice for everyone -, a coach mode (your own voice on
the piano), transposing the sound, a system band with the staves side by
side, a lyrics view of your own voice, note names on the notes, and scores
with sound without a network via an offline page in the browser. "Follow me"
takes everyone along to the next piece of the setlist.

secrets.description:
Secrets allows users to generate share links for text based data (e.g. passwords, CSV lists, bank accounts...) that can be sent to anyone (including receivers without a Nextcloud account) for retrieval. The data itself will be end-to-end encrypted (so not even Nextcloud can access it) and the encryption key will be part of the share link (the anchor part) - but never be actually sent to the server. Once retrieved, the secret will be deleted from the server, ensuring, that if it arrived at the correct receiver it has been seen by nobody else.

Secrets now comes with a cli that can be used to automate the provisioning of secret shares: https://github.com/theCalcaholic/nextcloud-secrets/releases

sendent.description: Sendent now securely exchanges files and emails, integrating with both Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams. This enhanced capability allows users to seamlessly conduct their work, not only within their preferred email environment but also within the collaborative framework of Microsoft Teams. Whether sharing privacy-sensitive documents, content, or handling attachments that exceed standard email size constraints, Sendent ensures a streamlined and secure communication experience. All files are directed to your Nextcloud instance, empowering you to control and manage access permissions effectively.

sendentsynchroniser.description: Say goodbye to manual updates! The Sendent Sync app, designed for the Nextcloud Exchange Connector, enables bi-directional syncing of agendas and contacts between your Microsoft Exchange and Nextcloud Hub. Focus on what truly matters – your work – while your data flows effortlessly.

sentry.description: A Sentry integration that sends unhandled exceptions to a Sentry instance to aggregate application crashes. You either have to set up your own Sentry instance or use your sentry.io account. See the admin documentation for how to configure this app.

sfbridge.description:
This automation in Nextcloud bridges the gap between financial transactions and Salesforce.
Paypal or bank transactions like donations or payments can be synchronized with the Salesforce Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP).

##### Features
- Paypal: Read transaction history
- Bank (via API): Read transaction history
- Salesforce: Create Household/Organization accounts and contact on demand
- Salesforce: Create/update Opportunities/Payments/Allocations
- Salesforce: Link Opportunities to Campaigns
- Nextcloud: Automation via background job
- Nextcloud: Notifications for new transactions
- Nextcloud: Using Talk room for update history

##### Please check GitHub for details first!

share_audit_dashboard.description:
See and audit every share on your Nextcloud, in the browser and not the command line.

Share Audit Dashboard gives administrators a single, visual overview of every share on the
instance (user, group, public link, email, federated, Talk), flags the risky ones, and lets you
fix them in bulk. Regular users get a personal view to audit and clean up the files they share.

**For administrators (Settings → Administration → Share Audit):**
- Dashboard: totals per share type, a 12‑month creation trend, an internal‑vs‑external exposure
  donut, top sharers, and attention banners for insecure links and orphaned shares.
- All shares: a filterable, sortable, server‑side paginated table with per‑column header filters
  and human‑readable permissions. Export the filtered view to CSV.
- Security alerts: public links with no password, no expiration, or a sensitive file type, fixable
  individually or in bulk (add a generated password, set an expiration, revoke). Rules configurable.
- Orphan shares: shares still owned by disabled or deleted accounts, with bulk revoke or transfer to another account.
- Exposure map: internal / external / public reach, a 0‑100 exposure score and the top public sharers.
- Access lookup: search a user, group or email and see every file they can reach, with revoke‑all.

**For every user (Settings → Personal → My shares audit):**
- Review the files you share and fix your own risky public links (add password / set expiration /
  revoke), plus a dashboard widget highlighting the links that need your attention.

Unlike the CLI‑only sharelisting app, everything is available in the browser.

share_via_device.description:
Select any number of files and folders, create a fresh read-only public link for each item, and pass the links to the browser's system share sheet.

The available destinations depend on the operating system and installed apps. If the browser does not provide a system share sheet, the links can be copied instead.

Links follow the server's public-sharing, password, and expiration policies. When public links require a password, use Nextcloud's standard sharing panel.

sharereview.description:
This app can be used for auditing shares within a Nextcloud instance e.g. for data loss prevention.
Share status can be exported for documentation.

- Review any file share
  - files, talk, deck, teams, federation
  - app specific shares (if implemented by other apps)
- Remove shares
- Confirm current review
  - show only new shares next time
- Audit compliance
- Assign review to user groups (e.g. audit or risk mgmt)
- Export as CSV or PDF (manual or regular background job)

Note:
The app must be restricted to at least one specific user group in the app store.
This prevents accidental exposure of the shared content to all users.

shiftsnext.description: Manage your shifts and sync them to your calendar

shopping_list.description:
Manage shared shopping lists between household members. Create multiple lists, categorize items by shop area, tag items, and collaborate in real-time.

Official website: [shoppinglist.otherworld.dev](https://shoppinglist.otherworld.dev/)

Official companion Android app: [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.otherworld.shoppinglist)

shortcuts.description:
Create shortcuts to files and folders from the Files app.

A shortcut is a small `.nextcloudshortcut` file that stores the target file id. Opening it in Files resolves and opens the original file or folder.

These files only work in the web version.

side_menu.description:
Custom menu allows you to modify the position of the main menu by creating a panel on the left of the interface or with a big menu on the top.
You can also define apps that must be displayed in the top menu. Fully customisable.

This application is rather suitable for instances that activate a lot of applications.

Use the shortcut `Ctrl`+`o` to open and to hide the side menu. Use `tab` to navigate.

You can customize colors depending of the theme.

To report a bug or request a feature, please open an issue.

Requirements:

* PHP >= 8.1

If you like this application and if you want to support the development:

* [Buy me a coffee](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/deblan)
* [Donate with liberapay](https://liberapay.com/deblan)

Notice
------

Because I believe in a free and decentralized Internet, [Gitnet](https://gitnet.fr) is **self-hosted at home**.
In case of downtime, you can download **Custom Menu** from [here](https://kim.deblan.fr/~side_menu/).

sidebar.description:
Replaces the apps menu with a sidebar on the left.

* **Compact or wide.** A narrow column of icons with tooltips, or a wide one with names. Everyone switches with one button and the choice is remembered.
* **Small screens.** The sidebar becomes a drawer behind a menu button in the header.
* **Colors.** The theming color, a neutral surface, or any custom color. Text and icons pick the readable contrast on their own.
* **Administration.** Set the defaults, hide apps for everyone, and decide what people may change for themselves.
* **Personal settings.** Labels, colors and hidden apps, as far as the administrator allows.

Hiding an app removes it from the sidebar only. It does not restrict access to the app.

The app stores no user accounts and sends no data to the author. Removing the app deletes its settings and everyone's preferences.

sketch_picker.description: This app adds a smart picker provider to quickly draw sketches and insert them in your current context.

smartcook.description:
SmartCook is a self-hosted, multilingual recipe manager for Nextcloud. Organize recipes with structured ingredients, substitutions, steps, timings, nutrition, tags, categories and tools; plan meals, generate shopping lists, share recipes and export your collection.

Import recipes from ordinary webpages, YouTube videos, public Facebook posts and Reels, and public Instagram posts and Reels, as well as pasted text, Markdown, JSON and supported files. SmartCook extracts the publicly exposed title, description or caption and cover image when available, then always presents an editable preview before saving. Private, restricted or login-required social content cannot be imported.

SmartCook checks Schema.org recipe data first and then uses deterministic local parsing. AI refinement and OCR are optional: choose and configure only the providers you trust. Your source is never saved until you review and confirm the extracted recipe.

smb_test.description: Nextcloud app to debug smb connections

sms_relentless.description:
This application allows sending and receiving SMS and MMS messages in Nextcloud. An SMS/MMS enabled phone number acquired from 
Telnyx, Plivo, Twilio or Flowroute is needed. Detailed instructions on how to configure and use this application can be found on the 'Admin documentation' page.

### Features:

* 🚀 Use one or multiple local phone numbers in countries of your choice, to send and receive SMS/MMS messages with your browser, on any device connected to the Internet.

* 📑 Sent and received SMS/MMS messages are stored in the database per sending/receiving user and can be viewed in paginated tables with filters for every column.

* 🖼️  Up to 10 files of various formats, including jpeg, png and gif, can be sent as MMS messages from MMS enabled phone numbers. Files included in incoming MMS messages are not downloaded automatically. They are stored as URL links to the actual files, so that the receivers can download them only if they trust the senders.

* 📔 SMS/MMS messages older than a specified number of days can be deleted in bulk with one click and they are automatically archived in csv files stored in Nextcloud, before being removed from the database. This makes them available for future analysis.

* 💻 Sending SMS/MMS messages to thousands of recipients can be achieved by uploading a txt/csv file containing the recipients' phone numbers and the same SMS/MMS is sent automatically to all. The time interval between two consecutive messages is configurable.

* 👤 The Display Name of Nextcloud users can be prepended to their messages, to make the origin of messages clearer.

* ⚠️  Admins can restrict the use of specific phone numbers to specific groups or users.

* ✉️  Auto-replies in 'daily mode' and 'vacation mode' can be configured for any controlled phone number.

* 🔏 SMS/MMS messages coming from Telnyx, Plivo and Twilio are checked for authenticity by verifying the SMS provider's signature.

* 📧 Users receive notifications in Nextcloud and (optionally) emails when new SMS/MMS messages arrive.

* 📄 Each sent message receives a delivery receipt displayed in the Sent SMS Messages table.

* 🎎 Messages exchanged between pairs of numbers are organized into conversations on a separate page where each conversation can be viewed, tagged and archived.

* 📞 It can be used with regular 'long code' (10-digit) phone numbers, but also with 'toll-free' numbers and 'short codes'. Users see a list with their current phone numbers and can set them as Sender IDs. Setting alphanumeric Sender IDs is also possible.

* 📱 If Nextcloud is accessed in Firefox for mobile (version 123.0 or newer), it can be used directly on mobile devices.

* 💵 It allows checking the current Telnyx/Plivo/Twilio balance by selecting the provider on the left panel.

* 💰 The only ongoing cost is about $1 per month (depending on the country) for an SMS/MMS enabled phone number located in a country chosen by the user. No contracts.

* 💸 Low prices per SMS: starting from $0.0040 per sent message and $0.0040 per received message (Telnyx), or $0.0085 per sent message and $0.0085 per received message (Plivo), or $0.0109 per sent message and 0.0079 per received message (Twilio), or $0.0055 per sent message and 0.0040 per received message (Flowroute) in the USA.

We have no affiliation with Telnyx, Plivo, Twilio or Flowroute.

### Documentation

* [Admin documentation](https://www.doublebastion.com/install-nextcloud/#install-sms-relentless)

### Donations

* 🎁 [Donate](https://www.doublebastion.com/donations/)

snackcheck.description:
# SnackCheck — kitchen trust ledger

Employees one-tap log snacks and drinks against their Nextcloud account. Managers run catalog, kitchen overview, restock hints, period close, and cent-reconciled payroll CSV/XLSX for HR deduction outside the app.

**Free AGPL web app.** Kitchen Tablet companion is licensed separately (`SNK2` device licences). Web is never gated by the device licence.

## Clear limits

- Not a POS / TSE / gastro Kassensystem
- Not DATEV Lohn live posting
- Not InventoryCheck — optional on-hand/par scalars only; never stock movements; logs never auto-decrement stock

## Feedback welcome

We improve this app with real-world use. Bug reports, rough edges, and ideas help — open a GitHub Issue (https://github.com/aSoftwareByDesignRepository/nextcloud-snackcheck/issues) or write to info@software-by-design.de. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

## Requirements

- Nextcloud 32–35 · PHP 8.2–8.5 · MySQL or PostgreSQL

social.description:
Nextcloud Social connects your Nextcloud account to the Fediverse through the ActivityPub standard.

What it does:
- 🧭 Timelines: home, local, global (federated), direct messages, liked posts, notifications, hashtags
- ✍️ Posts: write posts and replies with a visibility setting, mentions, hashtags, content warnings and media attachments
- ✏️ Edit and delete your own posts; edits are federated as ActivityPub Update activities
- 👍 🔁 💬 Like, boost and reply
- 👥 Follow and unfollow local and remote accounts; incoming follows are accepted automatically unless the account is locked
- 🔎 Find accounts and hashtags via WebFinger and search
- 🌐 Federation: signed delivery of ActivityPub activities, with a delivery queue processed by cron
- 📊 Dashboard tiles for mentions, direct messages, your timeline, bookmarks, follow requests and trending hashtags, plus open reports and federation health for administrators
- 🔒 Photos have their Exif metadata — including the coordinates a phone writes into them — removed before they are stored or federated
- 🎬 A Videos timeline, including the videos from PeerTube channels anyone here follows: streamed from the instance that holds them rather than copied here, and proxied so no viewer's address reaches a server they never chose
- 📡 Videos posted here federate as ActivityPub Video objects filed under a channel, which is what PeerTube needs before it will take one at all, with a poster frame, byte-range seeking and a 2 GB ceiling of their own
- ▶️ A video opens on a watch page: its title, the channel with a Subscribe button, its chapters as links that seek, and where you stopped offered back as continue watching. Every channel and account has an RSS feed with an enclosure per video
- 🪜 An administrator can have each stored video written at a ladder of smaller sizes as HLS, so a player picks what the connection carries; and can set a per-account video quota, see who is holding the disk, choose what happens to media marked sensitive, and hold every post with a video for a moderator
- 📥 A channel can be brought over from PeerTube's own export, or a single video by its address
- 🎨 Filters in the composer and a profile that draws as a grid
- 🗂️ Collections, stories and places
- 📱 Pixelfed's own routes — the config its app reads on launch, discover, the story carousel, collections, mutuals, reports, direct-message threads, push (honestly off) and its admin screens — so its app finds what it looks for once the API is at the domain root
- 🖼️ Stories, collections and places in the web app: a row of faces above your feed with a player and a way to post one; albums as the fourth tab of a profile, each a page of its posts; a pin in the composer that says where a picture was taken, and a page for every place — with nothing ever sent to a map service
- 🧭 A Discover page: who to follow, with starter packs you can follow in one go
- 📤 Share to Social from the Files app: pick pictures or videos there and the composer opens with them attached
- 👥 Lists, and every Nextcloud group you are in as a list of its own — kept in step with the group automatically; you make, rename, delete and fill your own in Settings
- ⚙️ Account settings: the name you publish under, whether people ask before they follow you, whether other servers may suggest you and index your public posts, and the audience every new post starts with
- 🔗 The profile editor says which of your fields are verified links, and gives you the line to paste on your own site to earn the tick
- 👋 A short introduction on the first visit: your address, who to follow, and a way to bring the follows you already have
- 📱 A layout for phones: the post takes the width of the screen, the face inside the card, the composer's toolbar wrapping
- 🔗 Links that land where they should: a post or profile link opens inside the app when you are signed in, a search can be reloaded or sent to somebody, and an address that names nobody says so instead of erroring
- 🩺 For administrators: four setup checks in Administration → Overview — WebFinger, the address ids are built from, the delivery job and the outbound queue — and a Server card for the instance settings that used to need occ
- 🔗 A link to a post or a profile here unfurls into a card in Talk, Text and Deck
- 🕘 Follows, mentions, boosts and favourites show in the Activity app too, and in its digest mail for those who turn that on
- 🗓️ A composer that says what a post is: the language it is written in, a clock to publish it later (with the waiting posts listed in Settings), and a crosshair that says where the subject of a picture is
- 😀 Emoji reactions on a post, federated as EmojiReact, with the faces behind each one
- 💬 Quote posts, carrying the original author's permission on the wire
- 😀 Custom emoji of this instance's own, added with occ social:emoji and rendered on servers that have never seen them
- 🎞️ A GIF picker in the composer, backed by the instance's own library rather than a third party
- 📈 Your own statistics: the last 30 days beside the 30 before them — reach, interactions, likes and boosts, each with the percentage it moved by — then every post of the window one by one, what works, when to post and where your followers are. A statistics page for the instance too, and profile highlights showing what somebody posts about
- 🕰️ On this day, and a weekly recap of what you missed
- 📣 Announcements: what the administrators of this instance are telling everybody, at the top of the timeline until it is read, dismissed once for every device, with an emoji to say something back
- 📡 Relays: subscribe to one and a new server's federated timeline stops being empty — a relay rebroadcasts the public posts of every server on it and carries this server's public posts out to all of them. Public posts only, and a relayed post arrives as the post it is rather than as a boost by the relay
- 💬 Quote controls: who may quote each of your posts (anybody, your followers, nobody), who already has, and a button that detaches one and tells their server
- 🔑 Authorized apps: every app holding a key to your account, with what it may do and when it was last used, and a button that signs one out — the page to open after losing a phone
- 🚪 Delete your Social account from Settings and keep your Nextcloud one: the posts, the follows, and a Delete to every server that knew you
- 🔕 Filtered notifications: the senders your notification policy is holding, one row each, with Show these and Dismiss — and a way to hide a whole server rather than its accounts one at a time
- 📜 Edit history: the "Edited" line under a post opens every version of it
- 🧳 Migration in both directions: the blocks, mutes and lists another network exported, read here; and your follows, followers, blocks, mutes and lists written back out one CSV at a time, the way Mastodon writes them
- 📅 Your year, as a report — Mastodon's #Wrapstodon: twelve months of what you posted and who arrived, the hashtags you used, the three posts that travelled furthest
- 🛡️ For moderators: what may trend (a hashtag, a link or a post kept out of Explore), the instance's custom emoji and its rules, all from the administration page rather than from occ

You can pin your own posts to the top of your profile, bookmark any post, and see which hashtags the instance is using most. This is a partial implementation of ActivityPub and of the Mastodon client API. Blocking, muting and reporting (with a moderation panel in the administration settings) are supported, as are locked accounts with approvable follow requests. Polls are fully supported: create your own, and view and vote on federated ones. Profiles carry an avatar, a banner image and up to four profile metadata fields, edited in the profile editor; a field naming a web page is marked as verified once that page links back with rel="me". Posts that link somewhere get a link preview card. Image (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, and HEIC from an iPhone where the server can read it), video (MP4, WebM, QuickTime) and audio attachments are supported, up to ten per post, each with alt text and a focal point. Quote posts carry the original author's permission on the wire, and the author decides who may quote each post and can take one back afterwards. Third-party Mastodon clients cannot reach the API yet, because it is served under the app's own path rather than at the domain root; there is no streaming API and no push subscriptions. A post can be translated where this Nextcloud has a translation provider.

sociallogin.description:
# Social Login

Make it possible to create users and log in via Telegram, OAuth, or OpenID.

For OAuth, you must create an app with certain providers. Login buttons will appear on the login page if an app ID is specified. Settings are located in the "Social login" section of the settings page.

## Installation

Log in to your Nextcloud installation as an administrator. Under "Apps", click "Download and enable" next to the "Social Login" app.

See below for setup and configuration instructions.

## Custom OAuth2/OIDC Groups

You can use groups from your custom provider. For this, specify the "Groups claim" in the custom OAuth2/OIDC provider settings. This claim should be returned from the provider in the `id_token` or at the user info endpoint. Multiple claims (comma separated) also supported - groups will be merged.
The format should be an `array` or a comma-separated string. E.g., (with a claim named `roles`):

```json
{"roles": ["admin", "user"]}
```
or
```json
{"roles": "admin,user"}
```

Nested claims are also supported. For example, `resource_access.client-id.roles` for:

```json
"resource_access": {
   "client-id": {
     "roles": [
       "client-role-1",
       "client-role-2"
     ]
   }
}
```

**DisplayName** support is also available:
```json
{"roles": [{"gid": 1, "displayName": "admin"}, {"gid": 2, "displayName": "user"}]}
```

You can use provider groups in two ways:

1. Map provider groups to existing Nextcloud groups.
2. Create provider groups in Nextcloud and associate them with users (if the appropriate option is enabled).

To sync groups on every login, ensure the "Update user profile every login" setting is checked.

## Examples for Groups

* Configure WSO2IS to return a roles claim with OIDC [here](https://medium.com/@dewni.matheesha/claim-mapping-and-retrieving-end-user-information-in-wso2is-cffd5f3937ff).
* [GitLab OIDC configuration to allow specific GitLab groups](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/gitlab.md).

## Built-in OAuth Providers

Copy the link from a specific login button to get the correct "redirect URL" for OAuth app settings.

* [Amazon](https://developer.amazon.com/loginwithamazon/console/site/lwa/overview.html)
* [Apple](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/apple.md)
* [Codeberg](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/codeberg.md)
* [Discord](#configure-discord)
* [Facebook](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/facebook.md)
* [GitHub](https://github.com/settings/developers)
* [GitLab](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/gitlab.md)
* [Google](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/google.md)
* [Keycloak](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/keycloak.md)
* [Mail.ru](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/mailru.md)
* **PlexTv**: Use any title as the app ID.
* [Telegram](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/telegram.md)
* [Twitter](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/twitter.md)

For details about Google's "Allow login only from specified domain" setting, see [#44](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/issues/44). Use a comma-separated list for multiple domains.

## Configuration

Add `'social_login_auto_redirect' => true` to `config.php` to automatically redirect unauthorized users to social login if only one provider is configured. To temporarily disable this (e.g., for local admin login), add `noredir=1` to the login URL: `https://cloud.domain.com/login?noredir=1`.

Configure HTTP client options using:
```php
  'social_login_http_client' => [
    'timeout' => 45,
    'proxy' => 'socks4://127.0.0.1:9050', // See <https://curl.se/libcurl/c/CURLOPT_PROXY.html> for allowed formats
  ],
```
in `config.php`.

### Configure a Provider via CLI

Use the `occ` utility to configure providers via the command line. Replace variables and URLs with your deployment values:
```bash
php occ config:app:set sociallogin custom_providers --value='{"custom_oidc": [{"name": "gitlab_oidc", "title": "Gitlab", "authorizeUrl": "https://gitlab.my-domain.org/oauth/authorize", "tokenUrl": "https://gitlab.my-domain.org/oauth/token", "userInfoUrl": "https://gitlab.my-domain.org/oauth/userinfo", "logoutUrl": "", "clientId": "$my_application_id", "clientSecret": "$my_super_secret_secret", "scope": "openid", "groupsClaim": "groups", "style": "gitlab", "defaultGroup": ""}]}'
```
For Docker, prepend `docker exec -t -uwww-data CONTAINER_NAME` to the command or run interactively via `docker exec -it -uwww-data CONTAINER_NAME sh`.

To inspect configurations:
```sql
mysql -u nextcloud -p nextcloud
Password: <yourpassword>

> SELECT * FROM oc_appconfig WHERE appid='sociallogin';
```
Or run:
```bash
docker exec -t -uwww-data CONTAINER_NAME php occ config:app:get sociallogin custom_providers
```

### Configure Discord

1. Create a Discord application at [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications).
2. Navigate to `Settings > OAuth2 > General`. Add a redirect URL: `https://nextcloud.mydomain.com/apps/sociallogin/oauth/discord`.
3. Copy the `CLIENT ID` and generate a `CLIENT SECRET`.
4. In Nextcloud, go to `Settings > Social Login`. Paste the `CLIENT ID` into "App id" and `CLIENT SECRET` into "Secret".
5. Select a default group for new users.
6. For group mapping, see [#395](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/pull/395).

## Hint

### Callback (Reply) URL
Copy the link from a login button on the Nextcloud login page and use it as the callback URL on your provider's site. To make the button visible temporarily, fill provider settings with placeholder data and update later.

If you encounter callback URL errors despite correct settings, ensure your Nextcloud server generates HTTPS URLs by adding `'overwriteprotocol' => 'https'` to `config.php`.

starrate.description:
StarRate is a professional photo rating and culling tool for photographers, seamlessly integrated into Nextcloud.

Rate photos with 1–5 stars and color labels, flag picks and rejects with keyboard shortcuts, and share a guest gallery link with your client or model. They pick their favorites in the browser — no Nextcloud account required. Leave comments on individual images for feedback rounds, and export the final rating list as CSV when you're done.

**Ratings are written as XMP metadata directly into the JPEG file.** Open it in Lightroom Classic, digiKam, F-Stop or Darktable — the stars are already there. No re-export, no sidecar files. **Coming from Lightroom?** Import your existing XMP ratings with one `occ` command — your years of curation travel with you.

**Browse a whole folder tree at once.** Recursive folder view flattens nested directories into a single sortable, filterable grid — perfect for working through an entire shoot week or a multi-event archive without clicking into every subfolder.

**Built for client presentations.** Slideshow mode in the loupe auto-advances through filtered images at a configurable interval — pre-filter to your three-star picks, hand over the keyboard, and let it run.

**Read the workflow guide:** [Nextcloud as a photo home — what works today (and what is still missing)](https://whitespace.de/en/artikel/nextcloud-foto-workflow/)

**Features:**
- Star ratings (0–5) + color labels (Red/Yellow/Green/Blue/Purple) + Pick/Reject flags
- **Recursive folder view** — browse an entire folder tree as a flat stream or grouped by folder depth. Opt-in — enable it once under Personal → StarRate. [How it works](https://github.com/merlin1de/starrate/blob/master/docs/recursive-folders.en.md)
- **Loupe slideshow mode** — auto-advance with configurable interval, ideal for client presentations
- XMP metadata written into JPEG — Lightroom / Bridge / digiKam compatible
- Configurable XMP label language: Lightroom (German localization) or Bridge / digiKam / English tools
- Self-healing XMP read on loupe open — externally-edited files (Lightroom, digiKam) sync their new ratings the next time you click into them, no manual `occ` run needed
- Import existing XMP ratings from Lightroom/digiKam via `occ starrate:import-xmp` (with `--recursive` for whole folder trees)
- Comments on individual images — for client feedback rounds or personal notes, optional in guest galleries
- Export the rating list as CSV (filename, stars, color, pick/reject) — download or copy to clipboard
- Download original images — a single image from the loupe, or the whole selection as a ZIP; available to logged-in users and, per share, to guests
- Guest share links for clients and models (no Nextcloud login required), with optional password, expiry, and per-share permissions (rate / pick / download / export / comments / recursive)
- Keyboard shortcuts like Lightroom: 0–5 stars, 6–9 colors, P/X pick/reject, S slideshow
- Batch rating and batch pick/reject with Shift+click / Ctrl+click / Ctrl+A
- Combinable filters: stars, color, Pick/Reject, unrated
- Full-screen loupe view with zoom up to 400%, pan, pinch-to-zoom
- Dark professional UI theme optimized for photo work
- English and German

sumoffice.description:
Connects Nextcloud Office to a **SumOffice** server — SumSheet for .xlsx / .xlsm / .xlsb and SumDoc for .docx — with one field: the address of your SumOffice stack.

What you get:

* **Your Excel files keep working.** A workbook with macros and Power Query opens from Files, is edited in the browser, and comes back with its VBA project byte for byte; Excel opens it clean.
* **Word documents the same way**, pictures and charts intact.
* **Two people can edit one workbook together through Nextcloud Office.** Measured on the
  28 September editor images: both users' changes stay in the file. Documents (DOCX) are
  single-editor for now — we do not claim simultaneous Word editing.
* **Nothing leaves your servers**: the editors run in your own Docker (`hissih/sumsheet-webhost`, `hissih/sumdoc-webhost`), Nextcloud stays the WOPI host.

This app is the installer: it points the standard Nextcloud Office (richdocuments) app at your SumOffice server, checks the discovery and capabilities endpoints, and shows what the server offers. It requires Nextcloud Office to be installed. One rule to save you an evening: the address you give Nextcloud Office must be the address the browser itself can reach, over https (or the same origin as Nextcloud) — otherwise the editor frame is blocked by the content-security policy and the session cookie never arrives.

Three steps, measured on a real macro workbook: https://sumoffice.com/nextcloud.html

synaplan_integration.description:
Bring Synaplan's AI into Nextcloud Files:

- **Summarize** a document with one click
- **Translate** a file into another language
- **Chat about this file**: ask questions about one document
- **Make searchable by AI**: the AI finds the file when you ask a question, in the chat or in Synaplan
- **AI chat** with a knowledge folder and model of your choice, optional personal memories, and live status (model, language, images and videos)
- **Answer language**: a default language, or each person's Nextcloud language
- **Connect your Synaplan account**: people sign in once, and the AI actions run as them
- **Five languages**: English, German (informal and formal), Spanish, French and Turkish

Requires a running Synaplan instance. Three ways to connect: one shared account, accounts created by the administrator, or each person connects their own Synaplan account.

task_proc_util.description:
**Disclaimer: this project has been vibe coded.**

This application changes the number of Nextcloud Task Processing workers
automatically. It calculates the number of workers from the number of tasks in
the queue. The number of workers stays under a maximum value. The administrator
sets this value.

The application gives workers to all the task types. Thus a large number of
tasks of one type does not prevent the operation of the other types.

The Nextcloud administrator manual gives this method in "Improve AI task pickup
speed". This application uses the same method. But it calculates the number of
workers from the queue. It does not use a constant number of workers.

A supervisor service does the work. The supervisor is one static binary,
written in Go. It reads the task queue and its configuration directly from the
Nextcloud database. Then it starts workers with the command
`occ taskprocessing-util:run`. Each worker operates on one task type only. Each
worker stops after a time limit, and the supervisor starts a new one. Thus the
workers get the new configuration.

## Setup

The application has two parts: this application, and a supervisor service that
you must start yourself. **The application does nothing until the service
operates.**

1. Enable the application: `occ app:enable task_proc_util`
2. Write a systemd unit that starts
   `apps/task_proc_util/bin/task_proc_util-supervisor` and gives it the path to
   your `config.php`. The service must operate on the same computer as
   Nextcloud. It must also operate as the user that owns `config.php`, usually
   `www-data`, because `occ` does not operate as a different user. An
   application password is not necessary. HTTP credentials are not necessary.
   Set `TimeoutStopSec=3600`, so the workers can complete the current task
   when the service stops.
3. Start the service, then examine its log. If `occ` does not operate, the
   supervisor shows the cause and stops immediately.
4. Adjust the settings in **Administration → Artificial Intelligence**: the
   main switch, the maximum number of workers, the poll interval, and the
   config reload interval.

The README file gives the complete systemd unit, the requirements, and all the
flags and environment variables:
https://github.com/kyteinsky/task_proc_util#setup

taskbook.description:
Taskbook brings tasks, planning, and notes together in a calm, Nextcloud-native interface. Inspired by concepts from the Bullet Journal® method, it focuses on quick capture, a chronological daily log, and lightweight organization without trying to reproduce the method exactly.

Tasks, ideas, notes, and plans can be recorded quickly without interrupting your workflow. Entries for the current day remain visible in one place, including completed tasks, so the daily log also serves as a complete record of the day.

Quick entry, keyboard shortcuts, dashboard integration, and a clean chronological view make everyday organization fast and unobtrusive.

Taskbook is an independent application and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Bullet Journal or Lightcage LLC.

tasks.description: Once enabled, a new Tasks menu will appear in your Nextcloud apps menu. From there you can add and delete tasks, edit their title, description, start and due dates and mark them as important. Tasks can be shared between users. Tasks can be synchronized using CalDav (each task list is linked to an Nextcloud calendar, to sync it to your local client: Thunderbird, Evolution, KDE Kontact, iCal … - just add the calendar as a remote calendar in your client). You can download your tasks as ICS files using the download button for each calendar.

teamhub.description:
**Your users are asking for Microsoft Teams. Your auditor is asking who approved what, and where it is stored. TeamHub answers both from the Nextcloud you already run.**

A Nextcloud Team on its own is a membership list. TeamHub turns that list into a governed workspace: messages, decisions, presence, a timeline and projects on one page per team, beside the Talk conversation, team space, Calendar, Collective and Deck board that team already uses. Deck stays the source of truth for cards, Talk for conversations, Files for documents Ã¢â‚¬â€ TeamHub reads across them, writes your actions back to them, and records what happened.

**Control**
- Teams are created from templates and carry policy profiles Ã¢â‚¬â€ apps, modules and settings decided before anyone joins
- Gates are server-side, not interface-side: every controller method checks membership and role
- No side doors Ã¢â‚¬â€ a team made in Contacts, Collectives or `occ` is not a TeamHub team, and a TeamHub team cannot be deleted from Nextcloud's Teams page
- Bulk rollout from CSV, with a dry run that creates nothing until you confirm
- Restricted means hidden: an action a role may not perform is not rendered at all

**Evidence**
- Append-only per-team audit log Ã¢â‚¬â€ membership, files, shares, resources and configuration, with actor and before/after. Retention 7Ã¢â‚¬â€œ3650 days. Exports as JSON
- Changes made outside TeamHub are pulled in hourly from Nextcloud's own activity and share tables
- ISO/IEC 27001:2022 control report Ã¢â‚¬â€ this instance's live state against the Annex A controls TeamHub can evidence, and the ones it cannot
- Decisions with no delete button; service requests sealed with a re-verifiable SHA-256 chain
- Code integrity checked against a SHA-256 manifest generated at build time

**Residency**
- Runs entirely inside your Nextcloud Ã¢â‚¬â€ no hosted version, no external service, no sub-processor to add to your register
- An instance with an active licence transmits nothing at all

thematiq.description:
Style your whole Nextcloud from one settings page. No CSS, no developer, no rebuild.

Nextcloud's own Theming sets a colour, a background and a logo. Thematiq styles everything else: buttons, tables, status colours, fonts and corner radius. You see each change live before you save it. After saving, every app follows. That includes Files, Talk and Calendar, and Conduction apps such as OpenRegister and OpenCatalogi.

**What you can do**

- **Edit live.** Four tabs cover the login page, content, buttons and typography. Reset any value with one click.
- **Use your own fonts.** Upload the web fonts your organisation has a licence for. They are served from your own server.
- **Save your own themes.** Keep a design as a reusable theme. Or import a published design-system theme and see exactly what was applied.
- **Start from a ready-made theme.** Stock Nextcloud, La Suite numérique, or the house style of a Dutch government organisation. The government themes follow NL Design System.
- **Try it before your users do.** Preview a theme in your own session. Nobody else sees it until you apply it.
- **Set a theme per group.** Give a department its own look. Exclude apps that should keep the default.

**What your IT team gets**

- **Your own branding.** Thematiq works on top of Nextcloud's own Theming. Your name, logo and background stay as you set them.
- **Contrast report.** Check the active theme against the WCAG contrast rules, the web accessibility standard. Use the result in your accessibility statement.
- **Branded e-mail.** Notification e-mails follow your theme. Add an optional footer.
- **Portable configuration.** Export the full setup as one file and import it on another server.
- **2,526 government icons.** From RVO, OpenGemeenten, Gemeente Den Haag and the French DSFR, for every app.
- **Free under EUPL-1.2.** No licence fee per user.

**About the organisation themes.** They copy the house style of the organisation they are named after. That organisation has not endorsed them. Use one only if your organisation may use that house style.

Create a [bug report](https://github.com/ConductionNL/thematiq/issues/new/choose)

Create a [feature request](https://github.com/ConductionNL/thematiq/issues/new/choose)

**Support:** For support, contact support@conduction.nl. For a Service Level Agreement (SLA), contact sales@conduction.nl.

theming_customcss.description:
This app allows admins to customize the appearance of their Nextcloud instance by adding their own CSS rules.

The rules can be added in the admin settings in the "Theming" section. This allows you to easily adjust the look and feel of your Nextcloud instance without having to modify any files on the server.

thesearchpage.description:
🔎 A Search Page for your Nextcloud instance

- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/callmemagnus/nextcloud-searchpage/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Help translate this application](https://app.transifex.com/nextcloud/nextcloud/thesearchpage/)

It works like the existing search widget, uses the same sources to query BUT
displays the results in a more readable and browsable fashion.

The content of the results depends on the other applications installed on
your Nextcloud instance. Every Nextcloud application can become a search
provider and get its results displayed by this application.

Out of the Nextcloud box, you usually get the following providers:

- Apps -- searches for match for in installed application names
- Files -- searches on path and filename
- Tags
- Comments
- Settings

Because of its design, the results depend on the implementation of the providers
in respective application.

Known issues with other applications:

- users -- [by design(?), it always returns an empty array](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues/41274) (it is hidden/disabled in this application)
- fulltextsearch -- does not seem to AND the query terms, OR is usually less relevant
- news -- does not provide a direct link to a feed item.


Don't hesitate to leave a comment here or a rating!

thinkfree.description: This Nextcloud connector integrates Thinkfree Office, a powerful web-based collaborative editor for seamless document viewing, creation, and real-time editing. Designed for teams and businesses of all sizes, it supports word processing, spreadsheets, and presentations with industry-leading compatibility with MS formats. Thinkfree Office is built for effortless deployment across various environments and integrates smoothly with a wide range of platforms and devices. For enhanced security and compliance, it also offers on-premises deployment, keeping all data under the your control.

threedviewer.description:
A comprehensive 3D model viewer that allows you to view, interact with, and analyze 3D models directly within Nextcloud. Supports 20+ formats across mesh, CAD, and BIM families with full material and texture support.

**📦 Format Support:**
- 🎨 Mesh formats: GLB, GLTF, OBJ+MTL, STL, PLY, FBX, 3MF, 3DS, DAE, X3D, VRML, OFF, AMF
- 🏗️ CAD formats: STEP (.step/.stp), IGES (.iges/.igs), BREP (.brep/.brp), FCSTD (FreeCAD) — powered by a shared OpenCascade (OCCT) runtime
- 🏛️ BIM formats: IFC (via web-ifc WASM), BIM (dotbim JSON), 3DM (Rhinoceros via rhino3dm WASM)
- 🧊 WASM loaders lazy-chunk: a 3–7 MB runtime only downloads when the user opens a file of that format; air-gapped deploys ship their own WASM copies (no CDN required)
- 🚀 Enhanced loaders: Significantly improved FBX, VRML, and DAE loaders with better material and texture support
- 📁 Multi-file models: Full support for OBJ+MTL+textures and GLTF+bins+images
- 🗜️ Compression: DRACO geometry and KTX2/Basis texture compression (needs more work)
- 🔧 Centralized format definitions: Single source of truth for all format definitions ensuring consistency
- ✅ Format sync validation: Automated tests ensure format consistency across backend, frontend, and MIME registration
- 📦 Bundle budget enforcement: Automated bundle size checking with historical tracking and CI integration
 - 🛠️ G-code toolpaths: Support for `.gcode`, `.gco`, `.nc`, `.acode` with 3D toolpath visualization (smooth rainbow gradient coloring, travel/retraction filtering, automatic layer detection)
 - 🧩 Extended G-code ecosystem: Recognizes additional variants `.g`, `.gx` (FlashForge), `.g3drem` (Dremel), `.makerbot`, `.thing` with proper MIME mappings

**🎮 Interactive Features:**
- 🎯 3D Camera Controller: Enhanced intuitive circular controller for precise camera navigation with improved controls
- 🔄 Model comparison: Side-by-side viewing with synchronized controls
- 📝 Annotations: Add notes and markers to specific points on models (always readable, faces camera) with customizable visual sizing controls
- 📏 Measurements: Distance and angle measurement tools (with billboard text) with per-user sizing controls for point size, line thickness, and label width
- 🎬 Animation Controls: Play/pause controls for animated models with loop toggle, timeline scrubber, and frame stepping
- ✂️ Cross-Section: Interactive clipping plane to slice models along X/Y/Z axes for interior inspection
- 💡 Lighting Presets: Quick-switch between Default, Studio, Outdoor, Dramatic, and Flat lighting setups
- 🔖 View Bookmarks: Save and restore camera positions with display state (grid, axes, wireframe, background)
- 💥 Exploded View: Animate multi-mesh models outward from centroid with adjustable factor slider
- 🧭 Face labels: Orientation markers (TOP, BOTTOM, FRONT, BACK, LEFT, RIGHT)
- 👁️ Camera projection toggle: Switch between perspective and orthographic views
- ⚙️ Personal Settings: User-specific preferences and settings page in Nextcloud personal settings

**📂 File Browser:**
- 🗂️ Smart navigation: Toggle between Viewer, Folders, Type, Date, and Favorites modes
- 📋 List and Grid views: Switch between compact list view and grid view with customizable default preference
- ⚙️ Default view setting: Set your preferred view mode (Grid/List) in Personal Settings
- ⌨️ Keyboard navigation: Full keyboard support for list view (Arrow keys, Home, End, Enter, Space)
- 🍞 Breadcrumb navigation: Easy navigation back through folder/type/date hierarchies
- 🔄 Lazy loading: Fast navigation with on-demand data loading

**⚡ Export & Tools:**
- 📷 Screenshot capture: Take high-quality PNG/JPEG screenshots of your models
- 💾 Export models to GLB, STL, and OBJ formats
- 🖨️ Slicer integration: Send models directly to PrusaSlicer, Cura, BambuStudio, OrcaSlicer, Simplify3D, Eufy Studio, and AnycubicSlicer with enhanced security (file size limits, MIME validation, rolling expiration)
- 📊 Model statistics panel with detailed information
- 🔲 Wireframe and bounding box visualization
- 📐 Dynamic grid system that adapts to model size and position
- ❓ Help panel with comprehensive in-app documentation

**🚀 Performance & UX:**
- 🖼️ Automatic thumbnails: Smart thumbnail generation with content-aware cropping (configurable in settings)
- 🖼️ Progressive texture loading for improved performance
- 💿 Dependency caching using IndexedDB for faster multi-file loading with live cache statistics (size, entries, hit rate)
- ⚙️ Performance modes with visual quality overlay and automatic suggestions for large models
- 📊 Performance scaling: Automatic performance mode suggestions based on model complexity (triangle count thresholds)
- 📦 Code splitting and dynamic imports
 - 📱 Mobile-optimized UI: Responsive toolbar (icons-only on small screens), full-screen help panel with sticky header, and performance stats hidden by default on mobile (≤768px)
- 🌓 Light and dark theme support with RTL layout
- 🔗 Works with public shares and authenticated users
- ♿ Accessibility features with keyboard navigation and ARIA labels

Built with Three.js for high-performance WebGL rendering. ✨

tickbuddy.description:
Tickbuddy is a daily habit and event tracker. 

Tickbuddy lets you keep track of what happens each day, such as your meditation, exercise, or how many cups of coffee you had. Your scripts and AI agents can also log automatically, for example to record nightly backups. Tickbuddy is flexible: use it for habits, chores, keeping an eye on automations, or anything else that matters to you. Over time, analyse patterns and statistics with the built-in analytics.

Your data is stored in Tickbuddy on your Nextcloud server. These companion apps can all read and write the same data:
- Tickdroid, the Android app, available on F-Droid
- Tickcli, a command-line client for your scripts and automations
- TickLLMe, an MCP server that lets your AI agents log and read your entries

ticketcheck.description:

timemanager.description:
### Time tracking in Nextcloud!
* 📁 **organize time entries** based on tasks, projects and clients
* ⏱ **quickly record** a time entry for your latest tasks

timesister.description:
The server side of TimeSister, a time tracker for macOS: it stores master data such as people, locations, projects and clients as versioned records, checks permissions on the server and keeps calendar backups and the clients' status reports.

Each team builds on one existing Nextcloud group, the team group. There are three roles, called Team Admin, Lead and User in every language: Team Admins are the group admins of the team group, the app keeps Lead and leaving the team. Every member names their time calendar once; the server reads it and hands the team's time entries out by role, so nobody shares a calendar. Leads and Team Admins offer Jobs – shares of a project or work package – to people of the team; the server checks volume and overlaps, and notifications tell who has to answer. The app creates no accounts and no calendars of its own; time entries stay in the users' CalDAV calendars. Only the hours of external persons that a Team Admin imports from a list live in the app's database.

It requires the TimeSister Mac app, where master data, roles and backups are managed. On its own, the app only adds an admin section for teams and status.

twofactor_admin.description:
This two-factor auth (2FA) provider for Nextcloud allows admins to generate a one-time

twofactor_email.description:
### A two-factor provider using email

Nextcloud can ask for a second factor after the password (two-factor
authentication, 2FA). Each kind of second factor comes from a provider app
that a server admin installs. This one emails a one-time code (OTP) - six
digits by default - and asks for it on a second login page.

### Installation and setup

An admin installs and enables this app. The server needs a working mail
setup, because the code travels by email.

A user then switches it on under "Personal settings / Security", which needs
an email address in "Personal info". An admin can switch it on for someone
instead: "occ twofactorauth:enable USERID email".

Nextcloud can also enforce a second factor for everyone or per group, though
never one particular method. Email is a low-friction choice there: the user
confirms one code and is done, with no device to enroll. Check first that
every account has a working address - a user whose address does not work
cannot log in.

Any second factor stops desktop and mobile clients from signing in with the
normal password. Each of them needs an app password instead, created under
"Personal settings / Security".

The user and administrator guides cover all of this in detail.

twofactor_gateway.description: A set of Nextcloud two-factor providers to send authentication codes via Signal, SMS, Telegram, WhatsApp and XMPP.

twofactor_oath.description:
Configurable OATH two-factor authentication for Nextcloud, covering all three OATH algorithms in one provider.

- **TOTP** (RFC 6238), **HOTP** (RFC 4226) and **OCRA** challenge-response (RFC 6287), selectable per token
- Per-token hash algorithm (SHA-1 to SHA-512), digits (4 to 10), TOTP period or HOTP counter, and OCRA suite
- Custom or random secrets, with clear strength presets (128 to 640 bit) and secrets encrypted at rest
- A **Strict RFC** switch for safe, interoperable defaults, without losing the freedom to deviate
- Admin-managed enrollment for whole groups, with **bulk provisioning** (sorting, filtering, live validation), CSV export and paste import
- One-click **import from the bundled twofactor_totp**, so existing users switch over without being locked out
- Issuer icon embedded in the QR code, HOTP resynchronisation, and a software OCRA token for testing

Built for hardware OATH tokens and elevated requirements, alongside the simple, bundled twofactor_totp app. OATH (one-time passwords) is not the same as FIDO2/WebAuthn. See documentation for when to use which.

The following providers are supported and tested at the moment:

* **SAML 2.0**

	* Shibboleth
	* Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS)
	* Authentik

* **Authentication via Environment Variable**
	* Kerberos (mod_auth_kerb)

While theoretically any other authentication provider implementing either one of those standards is compatible, we like to note that they are not part of any internal test matrix.
