verein.description:
Manage the members, membership fees and SEPA direct debits of one or several clubs – inside your own Nextcloud, with the data staying on your server.

- **Several clubs in one installation.** A person can belong to several clubs, each with its own date joined, position and SEPA mandate. Each club has its own bank accounts and creditor identifier.
- **Members:** personal details, position (member, treasurer, board), joined/left, founding member, deceased; CSV import with preview and duplicate check; deactivate instead of delete.
- **Fees:** fee categories per club (including fee-exempt), an annual fee run with preview (optionally pro rata for new members), unpaid/paid/overdue status and payment reminder letters by email (through the Nextcloud mail server) or as PDF.
- **SEPA direct debit** (pain.008.001.02) per club and bank account, validated against the official schema; fees are never collected before they are due, and anything that cannot be collected is listed with the reason. Optionally, members get an advance notice of the collection by email.
- **Permissions per club**, assigned as roles or derived automatically from a member's position via their linked Nextcloud account.
- **My data:** linked members see (and download) what the club has stored about them.
- **Club calendar** with birthdays and membership anniversaries, visible only to the Nextcloud groups you choose.
- **Data protection:** audit log without personal data in plain text, personal data export, anonymization, daily backups with restore.

No extra PHP extensions, tools or system cron are needed. **Please** check the first SEPA file with your bank's validation tool before the first real collection.

vereinsbuchhaltung.description:
**Accounting for nonprofit clubs – fully within your own Nextcloud.**

For treasurers of small and medium-sized clubs who don't run separate
accounting software and don't want their financial data in some provider's
cloud. Your data stays wherever your Nextcloud is hosted.

You don't need to be an accountant: in **simple mode** you record an "income"
or "expense" with amount, date and category – the app handles double-entry
bookkeeping in the background. If you'd rather set debit and credit yourself,
switch to expert mode.

**[▶ The app in two minutes (video, German)](https://youtu.be/eaF-tAQ_OOM)** –
import bank statements, assign transactions, evaluate and produce the annual
treasurer's report.

## The workflow

1. **Import a bank statement** – CSV-CAMT, CAMT.053 (XML) or MT940 from your
   online banking; the app detects the format from the content, the file
   extension doesn't matter. Transactions already present are recognized and
   skipped, even across formats. A watch folder can even pick up new
   statements on its own, without a manual import.
2. **Assign transactions** – every bank entry gets a counter-account. Rules
   handle recurring assignments (rent, membership fees, charges)
   automatically.
3. **Attach receipts** – photo or PDF, either in a Nextcloud folder of your
   choice or stored inside the app. Or as a watch folder: whatever you drop
   into it in the Files app can be picked when booking, and the overview
   reports what is not yet assigned to an entry.
4. **Evaluate and report** – treasurer's report for the general assembly,
   short report for board meetings, exports for the audit.

## What the app can do

- **Double-entry bookkeeping** with a freely definable chart of accounts; a
  standard chart of accounts for clubs is included
- **Treasurer's report** and **short report** as print-ready pages (Ctrl+P),
  optionally with your club's logo and accent color
- **Financial plan** with plan/actual comparison, comparison with the previous year and freezable plan snapshots
- **Structured report** by template, e.g. as a budget for funding bodies or as a result per project
- **Nonprofit status:** spheres following the German four-sphere model
  (ideational, asset management, purpose-related business, commercial
  business) and reserves per § 62 AO
- **Membership fees & SEPA direct debit** (optional, can be enabled as
  needed): member management with CSV import, direct debit mandates on paper
  or electronic, contribution groups with an interval, pre-notification and
  collection as a pain.008 file for your bank with a release before
  submission, bank reconciliation, returned debits with dunning, and a "My
  contribution" area for members – its own tab in the main navigation; if you
  don't need the module, you never see it
- **Open items** – keep track of unpaid receivables with due dates
- **Multi-year trend** and result per reporting group
- **Freely definable fiscal year:** it does not have to match the calendar
  year – October–September, the school year August–July or half-year
  periods (semesters) are just as possible
- **Year-end closing:** a finalized fiscal year can no longer be changed;
  continuous, gap-free posting numbers per fiscal year
- **Change log:** who changed what, and when
- **Roles:** administrator, bookkeeper and auditor – the audit role gets
  read access to everything without being able to change anything
- **On the go:** dedicated view for smartphones, photograph receipts
  directly
- **Annual audit:** all receipts for a year as a ZIP, print-ready quick
  guide for the auditor, completeness check of posting numbers

## Member management & SEPA direct debit (optional)

For clubs that collect their membership fees by direct debit: a tab of its own
("Contributions"), enabled when needed. If you don't need the module, you
never see it.

- **Members:** member list with a record per member, intake assistant, CSV
  import of whole member lists, leaving, information under Art. 15 GDPR and
  anonymization; the email addresses for a bulk mail can be copied with one
  click
- **SEPA mandates:** on paper or electronically via a one-time link, with
  history, suspension, revocation and a warning before they expire
- **Contribution groups:** lower limit and allowed intervals (monthly to
  annual), assignments with a preview, members who pay no fee
- **Collection:** pre-notification by email, release before submission,
  collection file (pain.008) for your bank, timeline of collection dates and
  bank reconciliation with matching suggestions
- **Returned debits & dunning:** reasons in plain language, payment request
  with payment details and a GiroCode per item, dunning levels, fees passed on
  if you wish
- **"My contribution" for members:** maintain contact details, contribution,
  interval and mandate themselves – with a preview and a confirmation email –,
  plus contribution confirmation and data overview
- **Task clipboard:** shows in the header what needs doing next

A **sample club** can be created with one click to try everything out
risk-free, and removed again with another click.

Existing data from "zero Buchhaltung" can be taken over via its xbuc files.

Full manual in German and English: see documentation.

vereinsflieger_login.description:
Let your club members sign in to Nextcloud with their Vereinsflieger credentials.

Independent community integration. Not an official Vereinsflieger product.

virtualoffice.description:
Remote teams lose the small moments: seeing that someone is around, asking a quick question, having a coffee together. Virtual Office gives a Team, a group or a Talk conversation a small shared office in Nextcloud. See who is there, step in as a character and say hi before anyone has to start a call.

- **Knock first:** ask "got 2 minutes?"; they answer Now, In 10 minutes or Later
- **Inside Talk:** open a conversation's office from any message menu, and join the call from there
- **Talk to who's close:** turn on your mic and the people next to you hear you, louder the closer they stand
- **Share the room:** make a coffee together, play music from your Files, keep a desk with a note for the day, or focus together for 25 or 50 minutes
- **Across time zones:** see each person's local time and the hours you all share today
- **Where you work:** offices show up on the Dashboard, in search, in the Smart Picker and on Team pages
- **Your character:** a rabbit, cat, bear or bird in your color, in a large office or a small one for up to 12 people
- **For everyone:** mouse, touch or keyboard, or the people and places list with a screen reader

**Privacy**

Opening an office never makes you visible: you choose Enter office. Only members of the Team, group or conversation can enter. Virtual Office keeps no history of visits or movement. Voice goes directly between browsers and is never recorded.

**Requirements**

Nextcloud 35, with no extra server. Talk adds conversation offices and calls (tested with Talk 25), and its STUN and TURN servers carry voice. Teams adds Team offices, Deck shows due cards on Team boards, and Client Push makes movement instant. Group offices work without other apps. Voice needs HTTPS.

See the office in motion at https://hweihwang.com/virtualoffice/

vulndexbeacon.description:

This provides a continuous overview of connected Nextcloud instances and their security status.

An active VulnDex account is required.

workspace.description:
# Description

Workspace allows managers to :
- Create shared workspaces
- Delegate management of each workspace to users (workspace managers) in order for them to:
    - choose members
    - create groups
    - configure advanced permissions on workspace folders
- All through a simple unified interface, designed to simplify your users' experience and make them autonomous

It is necessary to install the Team folders app for the Workspace app to work.

# App configuration

Before using Workspace, you must configure the app, following these important steps:

- Limit the Workspace app to specific groups : in your "application management" administrator interface, limit the application to the following groups: "GeneralManager" and "WorkspacesManagers".

- Configure Team folders for Workspace:
    - In "Settings" > "Team folders" > "Group folder admin delegation" section, add the group "GeneralManager" to the **first** field, and the group "WorkspacesManagers" to the **second** field

If you are using a major version of Nextcloud lower than Nextcloud 25, please follow the instructions provided on [GitHub](https://github.com/arawa/workspace). 

For more information, please visit [our website](https://www.arawa.fr/solutions/produits-arawa/arawa-workspace-for-nextcloud/) (french content).

For more details, please go to the [admin documentation](https://github.com/arawa/workspace/blob/main/README.md#installation), or [user documentation](https://github.com/arawa/workspace/tree/main/docs/user-guide/from-3.X.X).

x2mail.description:
X2Mail is webmail for Nextcloud with native SSO.

Log in to Nextcloud through your OIDC provider and open Email. X2Mail passes your OIDC token to the mail server via OAuth2 (OAUTHBEARER/XOAUTH2), so users never enter a separate mail password or see a second login form.

X2Mail uses Nextcloud's own APIs. It needs no external services and no database of its own.

### Nextcloud integration
- Contacts: read, create and edit contacts in all your Nextcloud address books
- Files: attach files from Nextcloud Files, save emails and attachments there
- Calendar: add ICS invitations to your calendar, with a warning if the event already exists
- Dashboard: widget for unread mail, with automatic OIDC token refresh
- Search: find emails through Nextcloud Unified Search
- SSO: IMAP access with your OIDC login instead of stored credentials

### Features
- SSO without extra configuration in X2Mail: OAUTHBEARER and XOAUTH2 are detected automatically and the token is refreshed before it expires
- Nextcloud admins manage X2Mail in the Nextcloud settings, without a separate admin password
- Setup wizard with preflight checks for IMAP, SMTP and OIDC, plus token diagnostics
- Nextcloud theme with light and dark mode
- Server-side mail filters (Sieve)
- Multiple sender identities
- OpenPGP and S/MIME
- Command line: `occ x2mail:setup`, `occ x2mail:status`

### Setup
```
occ x2mail:setup --imap-host mail.example.com --domain example.com --sieve
```

### Requirements
- Nextcloud 33 to 35, PHP 8.3+
- Mail server with OAuth2 SASL (OAUTHBEARER) on IMAP and SMTP submission; tested with Dovecot 2.4+ with Postfix, and with Stalwart 0.16+
- `user_oidc` with an OIDC provider; tested with Keycloak

xfiles.description:
X-Files is a photo vault that protects your most sensitive images with an
independent password, completely isolated from Files, Photos, Memories,
WebDAV, and Search.

**Features:**
- Password-protected vault (independent from Nextcloud login)
- Real file isolation via AppData (invisible to other apps)
- Auto-lock after configurable timeout
- Brute-force protection on unlock attempts
- Thumbnail gallery when unlocked
- Recovery key for password reset
- Download recovery key as formatted text file
- Change password and settings from within the vault
- Auto-lock when browser tab is closed

**Security:**
- Images stored in AppData (not in user filesystem)
- Other apps (Files, Photos, Memories) cannot see vault content
- WebDAV and desktop/mobile clients cannot access vault images
- Vault password hashed with Argon2id
- Session-based unlock with configurable timeout
- Brute-force and rate-limit protection

Lock your secrets. Trust no one.

xwiki.description: This application allows you to search and display your XWiki content right from Nextcloud. XWiki is a powerful development platform that allows you to customize the wiki to your specific needs. Using structured data and in-page-scripting you can create macros and applications that allow you to extend the capabilities of your wiki. Note: full functionality requires the Nextcloud extension on XWiki (11.10 or later required).

yoomail.description:
**🚀 YooMail — A high-performance mail app for Nextcloud**

YooMail is a secondary development (fork) of Nextcloud Mail, focused on **realtime delivery** and **instant reading** of emails.

- **⚡ Realtime email delivery** — A built-in Workerman + IMAP IDLE daemon pushes new emails within seconds; no manual refresh or polling required.
- **🚀 Instant body caching** — Message bodies are persistently cached after first render, so reopening a message is nearly instant.
- **📥 Multiple mail accounts** — Personal and company account? No problem, and a nice unified inbox. Connect any IMAP account.
- **🔒 Send & receive encrypted mails** — Using the great [Mailvelope](https://mailvelope.com) browser extension.
- **📬 Deep Nextcloud integration** — Contacts, Calendar and Files.

## Base version

This app is built on top of Nextcloud Mail **5.10.12**, with compatibility fixes for special-use folders (Sent / Deleted / Drafts) on some Chinese mail providers (Tencent ExMail / QQ Mail, NetEase Mail, etc.).
